 The Role 

 We are looking for a Principal Product Manager to lead the strategic evolution of the Auth0 Platform Infrastructure. In this highly visible, high-impact leadership role, you will be the visionary force behind the core infrastructure, consumption models, and platform capabilities that power Auth0’s immense global scale.

 You will own the multi-year strategy for critical platform pillars, with a heavy emphasis on redefining our rate-limiting and platform consumption frameworks. As a Principal product leader, you will navigate multi-dimensional scaling challenges (including the paradigm shift of autonomous AI agents), influence executive stakeholders, and ensure our platform remains the most resilient, secure, and performant identity solution for the world’s largest enterprises.

 What You’ll Do 

- Drive the Long-Term Platform & Consumption Strategy: Define and own the multi-year roadmap for Auth0’s core infrastructure. Align deeply technical platform architecture with broader business objectives, Go-To-Market strategies, and overarching revenue goals.

- Spearhead the Strategic Evolution of Rate Limits & Monetization: Transform rate limits from a protective mechanism into a core business strategy. Pioneer dynamic consumption models, proactive policy-aware observability, and intelligent throttling strategies that align platform costs with customer value, reduce escalations, and unlock new SKUs.

- Architect Global Cloud Resilience & Scale: Champion overarching initiatives for cloud architecture, including Tierless private cloud transitions, Geo HA failover mechanisms, and service-only failovers to guarantee "four nines" reliability while optimizing infrastructure COGS.

- Define the Future of AI Agent Identity & MCP: Lead the industry-level infrastructure strategy for Model Context Protocol (MCP) enablement. Define the standards for how autonomous LLMs and AI agents securely authenticate, consume platform resources at scale, and invoke APIs without destabilizing core human-identity traffic.

- Lead Cross-Organizational Alignment: Serve as the strategic bridge between Engineering, Architecture, Security, and Go-To-Market leadership. Influence without authority across multiple domains, driving consensus among senior engineering leaders and C-level executives.

- Champion Compliance as a Market Differentiator: Ensure infrastructure strategies proactively anticipate stringent global security frameworks , turning security and compliance by design into a competitive advantage for enterprise sales.

 What You Bring 

- Experience: 8–10+ years of product management experience, with at least 3+ years operating at a Principal, Group, or Lead level. Extensive experience managing highly complex, high-scale infrastructure, platform, or deeply backend products at an enterprise SaaS company.

- Strategic Domain Expertise: Deep understanding of distributed systems, cloud-native architectures (AWS, GCP, or Azure), and infrastructure monetization. Proven track record of turning technical constraints (like rate limits and data streaming) into customer-facing value and revenue drivers.

- AI & Next-Gen Tooling Vision: Forward-looking expertise in the Model Context Protocol (MCP), agentic workflows, and securing high-velocity machine-to-machine (M2M) communications at a massive scale.

- Advanced Technical Fluency: Ability to spar with Principal Architects and Engineering Directors on complex topics such as serverless scaling, API gateways, deterministic vs. probabilistic rate-limiting algorithms, and high-availability (HA) database topologies.

- Business & Analytical Acumen: Strong data-driven approach to platform economics. Experience defining operational SLAs, managing infrastructure margins (COGS), and structuring pricing/packaging around platform consumption.

- Executive Leadership: Exceptional communication skills with the ability to distill complex architectural shifts into compelling business cases for the C-suite, while simultaneously providing crisp, actionable requirements to engineering.

 Bonus Points 
 Prior experience driving multi-million dollar infrastructure monetization strategies, deep expertise in Identity and Access Management (IAM), or leading the architectural shift from legacy cloud models to tierless/serverless architectures.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

 Auth0, an Okta company, is an easy to implement authentication and authorization platform designed by developers for developers. We make access to applications safe, secure, and seamless for the more than 100 million daily logins around the world. Our modern approach to identity enables this Tier 0 global service to deliver convenience, privacy, and security so customers can focus on innovation.

 Our commitment to identity inspires and sustains our Diversity, Inclusion, and Belonging strategy as we aim to celebrate and protect the identities of everyone in our network.

 We are hiring a Senior Product Manager to join our MFA team who will help secure logins for thousands of customers and millions of people around the world. Auth0 safeguards applications and user accounts to enable anyone to safely use any technology. The MFA team is responsible for the authentication factors — such as WebAuthn, Passkeys, and Passwordless/OTP — to provide the right level of secure access based on business needs.

 In this role, you will leverage your technical background, good business sense, and ability to partner closely with engineering, product design, and product marketing teams to shape the product roadmap, deliver high-value solutions, and show measurable outcomes.

 This is a high-impact role that requires you to understand the technical aspects of authentication factors, customer use-cases and business challenges across multiple verticals, and how to simplify the experience for end-users who need to authenticate and the development teams that implement identity in their applications.

 A fierce curiosity, developer empathy, and strong collaboration skills are your keys to success.

 Job Duties and Responsibilities :

- Work with engineering and design teams to build actionable requirements and deliver high-value authentication factor solutions

- Define and socialize a roadmap that articulates your product direction and strategy

- Build compelling business cases to support ongoing product delivery efforts

- Become the go-to subject matter expert for your product area

- Develop and test product hypotheses, working in a lean and iterative way

- Prototype and validate early — build lightweight demos, proof-of-concepts, and interactive mockups (including light coding where needed) to test hypotheses with customers before committing to full development cycles

- Define and track KPIs and success metrics for your product area

- Work with cross-functional partners in Product Marketing and field teams to enable successful feature launches and manage the product lifecycle

- Create assets to guide product development work (framing documents, story maps, opportunity canvases, stories for implementation)

- Contribute to the assessment and improvement of processes and practices that can be shared with other product teams

- Leverage AI tools throughout the product development cycle — use AI-assisted tools for research, writing, prototyping, and demo creation to move faster, reduce manual effort, and raise the quality bar at every stage

 Minimum Required Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities: 

- Strong leadership skills and presence

- Technical aptitude and fluency to communicate with engineering teams and customer developers

- Track record of successful delivery of technical enterprise products

- Excellent communication skills with both internal and external stakeholders

- Functional experience in identity management, authentication factors, or security — particularly MFA mechanisms (TOTP, SMS OTP, push notifications, hardware security keys)

- Understanding of API and SDK design principles, including developer experience considerations such as error handling, versioning, and documentation

- 5+ years of experience as a product manager

- Champion for collaborative, iterative product discovery

- Love the work of identifying and deeply understanding customer problems

- Like to get your hands dirty and use the products you build

 Preferred Qualifications: 

- Hands-on technical background: prior software engineering, developer advocacy, or solutions engineering experience

- Familiarity with authentication standards and specifications: WebAuthn, FIDO2/Passkeys, OATH (TOTP/HOTP), OIDC, SAML

- Experience with cryptographic concepts relevant to authentication (public key infrastructure, attestation, challenge-response flows)

- Practical experience analyzing product and behavioral data using SQL, dashboards, or analytics tooling

- Experience working in agile/scrum environments

- Ability to travel within US or Canada

 Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era.  Auth0, an Okta company, is the leading customer identity platform for developers. Our mission is to secure the world’s identities so innovators can innovate. As AI reshapes how applications are built and used, identity and security are becoming critical to enabling safe and trusted agentic experiences.

 Our team builds Auth0 products for Agentic AI with a focus on agent identity, access management, and protocols that extend trust to our customers’ AI products.

 The role is for a highly technical product manager that is adept in developing strong customer-focused product strategies.

 Responsibilities 

- Define and Execute the Identity and AI Product Strategy: Drive the roadmap and execution for Auth0’s AI portfolio with a specific focus on secure identity solutions, including Auth0 for AI Agents. Identify tactical integration opportunities and ecosystem partnerships that secure agentic workflows and deliver immediate value to developers.

- Be an Owner and Builder (0-to-1): Bring a hands-on, entrepreneurial mindset to define, prototype, and launch new identity features for AI applications. Balance rapid experimentation with the engineering discipline required to scale features into secure, production-grade identity standards.

- Collaborate and Influence Without Authority: Serve as the core product owner and direct collaborator for engineering, design, and security teams. Translate the broader AI product vision into concrete, technical requirements, managing the backlog to ensure the timely delivery of developer-friendly identity features.

- Engage Directly with Developers and Customers: Gather direct feedback from the developer community and early adopters. Actively uncover security and identity pain points in AI implementation, validating that Auth0's identity-for-agents features solve real-world problems.

- Be The Identity Standards Expert: Strategize and implement emerging standards in identity and AI, for example focusing on Model Context Protocol (MCP), Dynamic Client Registration (DCR), Client-Initiated Backchannel Authentication (CIBA), and Client ID Metadata Documents (CIMD).

- Drive Cross-Functional Go-To-Market (GTM) Support: Partner closely with GTM teams (Product Marketing, Developer Relations, and Sales) to support successful product launches. Create technical enablement assets, documentation, and messaging to drive the adoption of identity security in AI applications.

 Requirements 

- Senior Product Management Experience: 5-7+ years of product management experience, with a significant focus on Business-to-Business Software-as-a-Service (B2B SaaS) and developer-facing products.

- Deep Technical Acumen and Hands-On Identity Credibility: Strong understanding of identity protocols like OIDC, SAML, as well as AI protocols MCP, CIMD, mTLS, and CIBA.

- Agentic AI Developer Credibility: Deep understanding of the emerging agent ecosystem. Ability to write code, work directly with APIs/SDKs, and build prototypes that validate customer and developer needs. Has defined and shipped successful API/SDK products for developer usage.

- Proven "0-to-1" and Feature Launch Experience: Demonstrated success in building and launching new products, features, or programs from scratch, and executing the technical roadmap to scale them. Strong bias for execution and rapid prototyping. Startup founder or early-stage employee experience is a significant plus.

- Exceptional Product Instincts: Ability to deeply understand developer pain points, security requirements, and identity friction, translating them into compelling, secure, and integrated product experiences.

- Growth Mindset with Technical Depth: An individual contributor who is highly comfortable diving into technical API specifications, data schemas, and identity standards while collaborating on a Go-to-Market (GTM) strategy.

- Collaboration and Influence Without Authority: The ability to drive alignment and lead through influence in a highly cross-functional organization, working daily with engineering, design, product marketing, developer relations, and sales teams.

- Excellent Communication Skills: Consistently demonstrates an understanding of their audience when communicating by appropriately simplifying the message. The ability to concisely articulate complex technical architectures, developer workflows, and product value propositions clearly to both internal engineering teams and external developers.

- Passion for AI and Identity: A genuine enthusiasm for the potential of AI and a deep, demonstrable interest in the future of secure identity for users.

greenhouse:okta:8214073.title: Senior Product Manager, Okta Customer Identity
greenhouse:okta:8214073.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

 Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

 The role

 Okta enables universal, secure access to technology for every user and organization. Okta Customer Identity (OCI) is the identity platform behind that promise for the applications our customers build for their own customers: the login, MFA, and account management layer for millions of end users across B2B, B2B2C and B2C products. OCI sits alongside Okta Workforce Identity (OWI) as one of the two halves of the Okta platform.

 We're hiring a Senior Product Manager to grow OCI's footprint inside our existing enterprise base and to incubate the next generation of platform capabilities. This is a builder's role. You'll spend a good chunk of your time in true zero-to-one territory: sizing a raw opportunity, proving it out with a design partner or two, and turning it into a capability that ships and gets adopted. You'll spend the rest of it as the connective tissue across engineering, design, research, and go-to-market, making sure those bets land in the field.

 What you will own

- New Capability Incubation: Own the pipeline of zero-to-one bets on the Okta’s Okta Customer Identity platform, from a rough problem statement through a validated design and a shipped v1. You'll decide what's worth building before anyone asks engineering to build it.

- Platform Growth: Drive the product side of Okta Customer Identity platform expansion into our existing enterprise base. You'll turn a hypothesis about why they haven't adopted the Okta Customer Identity platform into product changes that remove the reason.

- Cross-functional Delivery: Be the person engineering, design, research, and go-to-market call when a new Okta Customer Identity platform capability needs a decision. You'll write the specs, run the reviews, and keep a dozen loosely connected workstreams moving toward the same launch.

 A day in the life

 Your day splits between zero-to-one thinking and shipping discipline. You might start the morning studying churn or expansion data for a segment we don't serve well yet, trying to figure out whether the gap is a feature gap or a positioning gap. An hour later you're on a call with a design partner customer, walking through a rough prototype and taking notes on what confused them.

 By midday you're in execution mode: reviewing a spec with your engineering lead, debating whether a capability needs its own data model or can extend an existing one, and pushing back on scope that's grown past what the opportunity actually justifies. You write plainly. Your specs read like an explanation to a smart colleague, not a wish list.

 In the afternoon you sync with go-to-market and your PMM partner on how a capability in progress should be positioned once it ships, and you flag anything that changes the pitch. You close the day presenting to a customer or prospect, walking them through what's shipped and what's coming on the roadmap. 

 Responsibilities

- Identify, size, and validate new zero-to-one opportunities on the Okta Customer Identity platform, using customer conversations, usage data, and market signals rather than internal opinion alone.

- Define and execute a roadmap that balances new capability bets against platform reliability, security hardening, and performance

- Write clear, detailed specs and requirements that give engineering and design unambiguous direction, especially in areas with no existing playbook.

- Partner with sales, customer success, and product marketing to turn a shipped capability into an adopted one, including understanding why customers who should adopt haven't.

- Track the CIAM market and competitive moves from Auth0, Microsoft, and Ping, and use that context to sharpen where the Okta Customer Identity platform should and shouldn't compete.

- Be the go-to expert for your area of the Okta Customer Identity platform roadmap in front of customers, executives, and cross-functional partners.

 Required

- 5+ years of product management experience in enterprise SaaS, platform products, or identity and access management, with at least one zero-to-one launch you can speak to end to end.

- A track record of building and executing a strategy that spans multiple teams, and delivering on it, not just presenting it.

- Strong written and verbal communication. You can write a spec an engineer can build from and a one-pager an executive can act on, without changing the substance between the two.

- Strong analytical and decision-making skills. You can build a credible plan from incomplete or conflicting inputs, and explain the assumptions behind it.

- BS in Computer Science, Business, or an equivalent background, with the ability to hold your own in a design review with engineering and architecture.

 Preferred

- Experience with Customer Identity and Access Management 

- Experience partnering with sales or customer success on an attach or expansion motion, not just a net-new sales motion.

- Public speaking experience, ideally in front of customers or at industry events.

- MBA or equivalent graduate business degree.

 Top 3 qualities we are hiring for

- Zero-to-one conviction: You've taken a fuzzy opportunity from "should we even do this?" to a shipped, adopted capability, without a playbook telling you how. You know the difference between not validated yet and not going to work, and you don't confuse the two.

- Decisive action in the dark : You rarely have perfect data or complete requirements. You confidently make high-stakes calls using a mix of telemetry, customer anecdotes, and sharp product intuition. You explicitly name your assumptions, move fast, and revise them in public without ego when new information arrives.

- Unquestioned influence : You lead without relying on a reporting structure. You naturally align engineering, design, GTM, and the field behind your understanding of the customer. You are the definitive, credible voice of the product in CISO boardrooms and internal executive reviews.

 **You must attend in person orientation physically in the Toronto office on the first Tuesday of employment.
**You must go physically into the Toronto office 2 days a week.

greenhouse:okta:8137951.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

 Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

 About the Role 

 As Senior Product Manager, Policies, you own product strategy and execution for Okta's authentication policy roadmap. The Policies team owns how Okta evaluates risk and context to decide when, how, and whether a user, machine, or agentic identity is allowed to authenticate and stay authenticated. This includes Application Sign-On Policy, Global Session Policy, Okta Account Management Policy (OAMP), and Device Signal Collection Policy as well as the underlying Policy Framework, Policy API, and Auth Pipeline that power them.

 Policies is foundational to the entire Okta product portfolio as it's the decision layer that sits between every authentication event and the security experience a customer wants for their end users. You'll work closely with engineering, design, other product teams, and cross-functional stakeholders across Okta's platform to ensure policy capabilities evolve strategically, including how policy changes are rolled out and managed at scale (change management / identity operations).

 What You'll Do 

- Own roadmap and prioritization for your product area, balancing customer requests, platform needs, and market/strategic differentiation

- Collaborate with design and engineering to define, scope, and ship policies that have best-in-class user experience while meeting the security needs of Okta customers  

- Drive product direction for the Policy Framework, Policy API, and Auth Pipeline that underpin every policy evaluation across Okta

- Define how policy changes are managed operationally — versioning, staged rollout, auditability, and rollback — as part of a broader change management and identity operations strategy

- Work directly with customers, Solutions Engineering, Support, and other product teams to understand policy needs and translate them into product requirements

- Use AI tools to accelerate spec writing, competitive analysis, and rapid prototyping to drive roadmap alignment and execution

- Collaborate with global cross-functional teams, including engineering, field teams, tech partnerships, and marketing, to ensure successful launch and adoption of policy-related experiences

- Serve as the subject matter expert, representing Policies in customer escalations, executive briefings, and enterprise prospect evaluations, as well as partnerships with Marketing and GTM counterparts

- Track industry trends in adaptive authentication, risk-based access, and session security to develop solutions differentiated from the competition

 What You Bring to Okta 

- 6+ years experience in product management

- Experience in identity, security, enterprise-scale, platform, or developer products

- Ability to have in-depth technical discussions with engineering teams

- Ability to connect platform-level decisions to Okta's broader business outcomes and market position as a technology leader

- Ability to empathize and dig deeper into customer problems and needs before designing solutions

greenhouse:okta:8041551.description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

 Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

 About the Role 

 We are seeking a Senior Product Manager to drive the vision, strategy, and execution for a key product area within the Auth0 Identity Security product line, with a focused mandate on the rapidly evolving domain of Agentic Security. This role sits at the intersection of product strategy, cross-functional leadership, and agile execution — requiring someone who can both shape long-term direction and deliver with precision.

 We are the team that builds solutions that protect our customer’s Auth0 environments. Our group delivers features such as attack protection, bot detection, adaptive MFA, identity security for AI Agents and related analytics / insights on the effectiveness of our solutions in thwarting attacks from bad actors.

 The ideal candidate brings direct, hands-on experience in agentic security product management, with a deep understanding of how AI agents are built, orchestrated, and secured. This includes practical knowledge of agentic workflows, MCP servers, agentic tooling, and their use through productivity applications such as Claude Code.

 A core focus of this role is runtime security & AI agent classification: building real-time detection, behavioral analysis, and protection capabilities for agentic systems. The successful candidate will have command of the OWASP Top 10 for Agentic AI attack vectors and mitigations, and will bring experience in identifying and responding to threats such as prompt injection, agent intent anomalies, and rogue agent detection — including scenarios where an agent may have been compromised or infiltrated.

 Beyond agentic-native threats, this role demands strong fluency in fraud and risk mitigation, spanning both traditional and emerging attack surfaces. This includes a depth of knowledge across classic vectors — Account Takeover (ATO), resource draining, and fraudulent account creation — as well as their evolving equivalents in multi-agent and autonomous system environments.

 Key Responsibilities 

- Product Strategy & Roadmap: Define and champion a clear product strategy and roadmap, utilizing data-driven prioritization methods to maximize customer value and business impact. Manage inputs from diverse cross-functional stakeholders.

- Customer Experience: Drive customer research (surveys, interviews, data analysis) to identify top opportunities, optimize the end-to-end customer journey, and ensure product value realization.

- Experience Design: Partner with Product Design on prototypes, wireframes, and concepts, continuously improving the usability of both the UI and APIs for technical and business audiences.

- Agile Execution & Delivery: Maintain active, daily collaboration with engineering teams. Write clear user stories, scope work for sprints, and actively participate in Agile cadences. Proactively solve problems and manage ambiguity to ensure on-time delivery.

- Performance Optimization: Drive continuous data analysis and insights into customer adoption. Establish clear hypotheses and baselines for feature launches, then track progress toward strategic targets and drive continuous product iteration based on learnings.

- Commercial Growth & Value: Partner closely with Product Marketing to run targeted customer campaigns. These efforts will drive trial conversions, accelerate Product-Led Growth (PLG) motions, boost retention, and increase high-value usage and adoption.

- Go-to-Market: Proactively monitor the competitive landscape to identify gaps and differentiators. Partner with Product Marketing and pre-sales engineering to refine product positioning, develop engaging customer value messaging, and craft supporting content (blogs, webinars).

- Field & Customer Engagement: Actively engage with the field organization (Sales, Solutions Engineering, Technical Account Managers) to build deep knowledge of the voice of the customer. Drive customer conversations during pre-sales, renewals, and at key events to gather feedback and support adoption.

- AI-Powered Productivity: Drive efficiency and strategic insight by leveraging AI tools for high-value activities, including prototyping, synthesizing customer insights, accelerating competitive and market analysis, and rapidly generating high-quality product documentation.

 Required Qualifications 

- AI Agent Experience:  Significant product experience with AI Agent creation, orchestration and the use of MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers for exposing context, tools, and resources to agents. Ability to use this experience to define how Auth0's should securely authenticate, authorize, and monitor non-human AI principals at runtime.

- Agentic Threat Remediation: You have a strong command of the OWASP Top 10 for Agentic AI, and can articulate how each attack class manifests in real-world agentic deployments. You bring direct experience identifying, triaging, and driving remediation of agentic threats, with particular depth in: prompt injection attacks, agent intent anomalies, and rogue agent detection. 

- Product Management Experience:  5-8 years of experience in Product Management, whether from startup or high-growth company environments. 

- Education : An Undergraduate and/or Masters Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems or a related technical field.

- General Security Industry Experience : Prior working experience in the security, fraud or compliance industries with foundational knowledge of Identity and Access Management (IAM/CIAM) concepts (e.g., OAuth 2.0, OpenID Connect, SSO, MFA, RBAC) and/or familiarity with compliance frameworks relevant to identity security (e.g., GDPR, CCPA, SOC 2).

- Communication : Excellent communication skills (presentation, verbal, and written) and a highly collaborative approach, working with cross-functional stakeholders across the organization.

- Enterprise Software : Demonstrated experience in delivery of global, enterprise software across all aspects of the product lifecycle.

- Results Driven : A clear history of being outcome-driven and achieving tangible business results through the successful delivery of products, features, or capabilities that you have owned.

- Problem Solving : Keen analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities, with a proven capacity to formulate effective action plans even when faced with incomplete, conflicting, or ambiguous inputs.

- Entrepreneurial : Bring an entrepreneurial mindset and a strong intellectual curiosity that drives you to learn and delve deeply into both business and technical aspects of this role.

- Agile Development : Deep experience working successfully with engineering teams in an Agile development environment, including scoping, sprint planning, and backlog management and prioritization.

 Staff Product Marketing Manager, Okta Device Access

 We are seeking a Staff Product Marketing Manager to lead go-to-market strategy for Okta Device Access . This role will own positioning, messaging, launches, field enablement, and lifecycle adoption for a strategic product portfolio at the intersection of identity, endpoint experiences, and security.

 Okta Device Access extends identity security to the first moment of the workday: signing in to a computer. It helps organizations strengthen device-login security, simplify onboarding and account experiences, and enable seamless, secure access from device sign-in to the applications employees need. The portfolio supports Windows and macOS environments and complements customers’ existing endpoint-management investments. 

 The ideal candidate is a strategic, technically credible product marketer who can translate sophisticated identity and platform capabilities into clear customer value, differentiated market narratives, and scalable commercial programs. You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Digital Growth, and Pricing to bring new capabilities to market and drive durable customer adoption.

 Responsibilities

- Own the end-to-end go-to-market and lifecycle marketing strategy for Okta Device Access, including positioning, messaging, launches, field readiness, customer adoption, and expansion.

- Develop a differentiated narrative for securing device sign-in and enabling seamless, passwordless, phishing-resistant access from device to applications.

- Translate complex identity, authentication, device-security, and operating-system integration capabilities into compelling customer value propositions, use cases, and practical field plays.

- Lead cross-functional launch planning and execution, including launch strategy, sales and partner enablement, customer communications, web and content strategy, internal readiness, and post-launch measurement.

- Build and execute adoption programs that help customers advance phishing-resistant access and FastPass adoption, while identifying and addressing deployment and activation friction. FastPass is Okta’s phishing-resistant, passwordless authenticator for secure access to devices and applications 

- Partner with Product and Engineering to bring customer insight into product and GTM decisions, shape roadmap communications, and ensure commercialization and packaging changes are customer- and field-ready.

Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

 Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

 Staff Product Marketing Manager, Access Management and Security 

 Identity is how organizations unlock AI safely. At Okta, we build the trusted, neutral infrastructure that lets every enterprise embrace this new era with confidence. This is career-defining work for builders and owners who move with urgency and execute with excellence.

 Reporting to the Senior Manager of Product Marketing, you will be the product marketer for the secure-access layer that makes Okta indispensable to the largest enterprises in the world. Your charter is to elevate identity from a sign-in utility to the control plane for security in the AI era. You will do tis by pairing deep technical credibility with executive-grade storytelling across strategy, content, and field execution.

 The ideal candidate will be a unique blend of technologist and business strategist—someone who can dive deep into technical architecture while crafting portfolio-level value propositions that resonate with both CISOs and practitioners. Beyond strategy and content, you must be a self-motivated, execution-oriented individual who stays focused on delivering outcomes in a fast-paced environment.

 What you’ll be doing 

 Strategic GTM for core and hybrid access 

 Build and execute the go-to-market strategy for Okta's foundational access services — including secure access to hybrid and on-premises business-critical applications — positioning them as an essential pillar of Zero Trust and AI security.

 Define the market narrative, ideal customer profile, and competitive positioning that drive Global 2000 expansion, a top company priority.

 AI-forward product and content leadership 

- Collaborate to define and advance Okta's point of view on securing human, machine, and AI-agent identities, and publish thought leadership that shapes the category.

- Use AI tooling across your own workflow, including  research, competitive analysis, content generation, and field enablemen, to produce higher-quality assets in a fraction of the time. This is an expectation of the role, not a nice-to-have.

 Technical Evangelism that closes deals  

- Collaborate and drive, along with Technical Marketing, to build demos, reference architectures, and proof kits that stand up to practitioner scrutiny and shorten security evaluations.

-  Act as a spokesperson with CISOs, architects, and analysts, translating deep technical capability into strategic business outcomes.: 

 Cross-functional revenue activation 

- Partner with Product, Sales, and Customer Success to launch offers

- Equip the field with talk tracks and ROI models, and lead deal-acceleration plays on the largest, most strategic enterprise opportunities.

 What you’ll bring to the role 

- Domain Expertise: 8+ years of experience as a product marketer or product manager in cybersecurity or identity management (IAM, AD, or Entra ID). You know who the players are, where the gaps lie, and how to win.

- Hands-on Technical Proficiency: A technologist at heart. You must have a track record of supporting technical evaluations, and you must be comfortable configuring and demoing the product to technical buyers.

- Execution-Oriented Storytelling: Proven ability to take "under-the-hood" technology and turn it into an emotional and urgent business story. You know how to rise above the noise and create a sense of urgency.

- Fluency in the security implications of AI, and a track record of using AI tooling to raise your own throughput.

- Experience influencing cross-functional leaders and driving complex programs to deadline.

 Extra Credit if you have: 

- CS Degree or a strong technical background in systems architecture or engineering.

- Deep experience with modern identity protocols and securing hybrid environments (Cloud and On-Premises).

- Experience in the AI space, specifically regarding the security implications of LLMs and agentic workflows.

ABOUT ZIP

Zip is the AI platform for enterprise procurement — built for humans and agents working together. By orchestrating procurement across teams, tools, and suppliers with the help of AI agents, companies can secure the resources they need to innovate faster than ever before.

The world’s most influential enterprises trust Zip, including T-Mobile, OpenAI, AMD, Mars, Dollar Tree, and more. Together they’ve saved over $8 billion and processed over $500 billion in spend. Zip’s team includes product leaders from Apple, Airbnb, and Meta, as well as former procurement leaders from United Health, Sanofi, MGM Resorts, Discover, and NASA.

Backed by Adams Street, Alkeon, BOND, CRV, DST, Tiger Global, and Y Combinator, Zip has raised $371 million, most recently at a $2.2 billion valuation and has been recognized by Forbes Fintech 50, Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies, Inc. Best in Business, and LinkedIn Top Startups.




YOUR ROLE

We’re looking for a Senior Solutions Consultant to lead onboarding for new customers and drive their implementation of our product. We’re also looking for someone who is excited to be hands-on and influence our product roadmap.

As every business needs our type of product, you’ll work with a variety of new clients and industries as Zip scales. Current clients include Coinbase, Snowflake, Notion, Canva, Samsara, Databricks.




YOU WILL

 - Lead onboarding for new customers, with a heavy emphasis on understanding requirements and creatively configuring the product to solve their problems

 - Responsible for leading the end-to-end implementation for new customers -- roll up your sleeves and build out the customer’s processes from scratch

 - Lead training and Q&A sessions with customers and key stakeholders to empower them to utilize the product without additional ongoing help from Zip

 - Proactive project management across many customers, to manage requirements and tasks across onboardings

 - Collaborate closely with the product and engineering teams to determine which customer requests we should and shouldn’t support, and set expectations with customers

 - Do whatever it takes to make customers happy + successfully onboard them as quickly as possible

 - Continuously improve the post-sales processes to help our customers accelerate the time to value




QUALIFICATIONS

 - 5+ years’ experience working in one of the following roles: Procurement/Sourcing Manager, ERP/P2P Systems Consultant, or managing key customer and stakeholder relationships in a B2B SaaS company

 - Prior experience with the implementation or administration of a procurement tool / ERP (Microsoft Dynamics, SAP Ariba, Sage, Oracle Fusion, Netsuite, etc.)

 - Fantastic communication skills

 - Extreme attention to detail and pride yourself in being incredibly proactive

 - Experience working with product and engineering teams

 - You’re able to push back and still make people happy

 - Very comfortable with software configuration (not necessarily technical skills, which would be a plus)

 - Willing to do whatever it takes to make Zip and its customers happy.

greenhouse:twilio:8263280.description:
Who we are  

 At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to  hundreds of thousands of businesses  and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

 Our dedication to remote-first work , and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
 . 

 Hiring and how we work 

 We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions! 

 Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings. 
 . 

 See yourself at Twilio 

 Join Twilio as a Program Manager, Carrier Operations & Governance — a tech-forward business analyst and program manager within a brand-new function built from the ground up to reshape how Twilio manages, governs, and optimizes its global telecom carrier and wholesale supplier ecosystem.

 About the job 

 This isn't a role that inherits an existing playbook — it's a role that writes one. Twilio is building a highly visible, cross-functional operations & governance team dedicated to optimizing its telecom carrier and wholesale supplier ecosystem. Reporting into leadership that maintains regular cadences with Twilio's CEO, CFO, CRO, and Audit Committee, you will serve as the primary owner of critical end-to-end improvements spanning multiple areas of the business, and build internal operating models that unlock new levels of operational maturity and rigor.

 In this role, you will bring together, understand, and implement the policies, processes, systems, tools, and controls necessary to build a world-class operating environment. You will own the creation and stand-up of the team operating model, cadences, and runbooks while taking direct ownership of the team's internal Run-the-Business (RTB) engine.

 If you thrive in high-visibility environments, love designing systems from first principles, and want to own program execution end-to-end, this opportunity is built for you.

 Responsibilities 

 In this role, you will lead program execution across four core pillars:

 Cross-Functional Governance & Leadership 

- Drive Visible Governance Programs: Serve as the core Program Manager for a highly visible, cross-functional governance initiative spanning multiple areas of the business - including building and operationalizing programs from diagnosis, design, implementation, and change management

- Maintain Executive Visibility: Package and present operational narratives, risks, and performance metrics to cross-functional leadership, feeding into C-suite and Audit Committee reviews.

- Implement Core Infrastructure: Lead end-to-end process improvements across carrier operations — understanding, synthesizing, and deploying cohesive policies, workflows, systems/tools, and data-driven controls.

 Operating Model, Enablement & Team Infrastructure

 An overview of this role

You’ll connect capabilities across GitLab Duo Agent Platform and the wider GitLab product so customers have a cohesive and delightful experience. This is a senior, high-visibility role for a product leader who can shape product direction, work across organizational boundaries, and clearly present recommendations to executive leaders.

 What you’ll do 

- Define the product vision and strategy for GitLab’s end-to-end software factory experience.

- Bring together planning, specification, coding, review, and verification workflows into a cohesive product experience.

- Use strong product and design judgment to make complex workflows clear and useful for customers.

- Strong product design and user experience instincts, including the ability to connect separate capabilities into a coherent experience.

- Experience influencing across functions, resolving competing priorities, and moving work forward without relying on direct authority.

- Clear communication and presentation skills, including experience working with senior and executive leaders.

- An ownership mindset and the ability to make progress in a fast-changing product area with some ambiguity.

 An overview of this role 

 As Principal Product Manager, Orbit, you'll define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for GitLab's software lifecycle context graph. Orbit connects source code and software development lifecycle data into a structured map of systems, relationships, dependencies, and ownership. You'll help engineers, software leaders, and artificial intelligence (AI) agents understand how teams build software and how changes affect the systems around it.

 You'll shape Orbit from its underlying graph model and query experiences through customer value, pricing, packaging, launch, and adoption. This role combines technical product leadership with building a business around software lifecycle context. You'll balance foundational platform work with near-term customer needs, working directly with technical customers and senior Engineering and Design leaders.

 You'll join Anand Ahire's product organization and partner across Product, Engineering, Design, Product Marketing, Sales, Solutions Engineering, and Customer Success, including the teams building GitLab Duo and the broader AI-powered development, security, and operations (DevSecOps) platform.

 What you'll do 

- Define Orbit's multi-year vision and roadmap across graph models and ontology, ingestion and indexing, query and retrieval, developer and agent interfaces, governance, and enterprise readiness. Shape how Orbit works across GitLab.com, Self-Managed, Dedicated, GitLab Duo Agent Platform, MCP-based external agents, APIs, and developer tooling.

- Turn complex platform opportunities into customer problems, measurable outcomes, and investment decisions. Use evidence to decide where to invest, iterate, partner, or stop.

- Partner with Engineering and Design on architecture and implementation tradeoffs across graph data models, indexing, query systems, application programming interfaces (APIs), Model Context Protocol (MCP), authorization, and scale.

- Use AI tools such as Claude Code and GitLab to investigate problems, explore code and data, prototype concepts, and create or review merge requests when that's the fastest way to learn.

- Lead discovery with developers, engineering leaders, platform teams, security teams, and technical executives to validate needs around dependencies, ownership, change impact, vulnerability exposure, pipeline health, and software delivery risk. Build repeatable feedback into roadmap decisions and help customers understand the value of connected graph context over disconnected searches or API calls.

- Define target customers, priority use cases, differentiated value, and the path to product-market fit. Partner with Product Marketing, Sales, Solutions Engineering, Customer Success, Pricing, and Finance on positioning, packaging, pricing, launch, adoption, and expansion.

- Develop business cases and track adoption, retention, usage, customer value, and revenue outcomes. Support executive briefings, analyst conversations, customer workshops, and field enablement.

- Align teams and executive leaders around clear recommendations and tradeoffs without relying on direct authority. Mentor other product managers, share practical frameworks, and represent GitLab's product vision in customer and industry conversations.

 What you'll bring 

- Experience owning complex technical products or platforms at Staff, Principal, or equivalent scope, with a track record of defining vision and roadmaps across multiple teams.

- Deep technical fluency in one or more relevant areas, such as developer tools, DevOps, software delivery, data platforms, distributed systems, knowledge graphs, search, APIs, AI infrastructure, or agentic systems.

- The ability to work credibly with engineers on architecture, data models, APIs, scale, reliability, and security.

- Business judgment and experience in market assessment, product strategy, pricing, packaging, business cases, or commercialization of technical products.

- Experience taking a product, platform, or category from early concept through launch, customer adoption, and iteration.

- A customer-first approach and the ability to build trusted relationships with technical practitioners, engineering leaders, architects, and executives.

- Clear written and verbal communication, with experience explaining complex ideas, influencing across functions, and resolving competing priorities in ambiguous work.

- Practical experience using AI tools in product work, including exploring code and data, prototyping workflows, and creating or reviewing merge requests. You take ownership, learn quickly, and move between strategy and implementation detail.

 In GitLab's Analytics organization, we focus on making Orbit's context available through GitLab experiences, developer tools, MCP, APIs, and the command-line interface (CLI).

You'll work with engineering and cross-functional partners who value technical rigor, clear product thinking, rapid learning, and direct customer contact. As part of GitLab's all-remote organization, we collaborate asynchronously across regions, with a focus on transparency, written communication, and clear decisions.

 An overview of this role 

 As Principal Product Marketing Manager, Competitive, you own GitLab's competitive point of view on AI and agentic software development and serve as the authority on our market differentiation. You consult regularly with sales, product teams, investor relations, industry analysts, and leadership on competitive strategy and roadmap implications while publishing external thought leadership.

 With deep experience in the modern SDLC and agentic tooling, you collaborate with developer advocacy and conduct primary market analysis to drive positioning, field assets, competitive plays, and partnership strategy.

 In your first year, you will establish a defensible AI and agentic narrative and an agile operating rhythm that turns market signals into action.

 Reporting to the Senior Director, Product & Solutions Marketing, you will operate with executive visibility and autonomy, measuring success by win rates, competitive displacements, and market leadership in the AI and agentic category.

 Some examples of projects: 

- Define GitLab's differentiated position against AI-native entrants competing for the SDLC

- Publish thought leadership that shapes how the market frames agentic development

- Assess new entrants and share relevant market-shaping insights across the company

- Shape partnership strategy based on competitive footing

- Arm executives with competitive narrative for customer and board conversations

 What you'll do 

- Own GitLab's competitive positioning for AI and agentic software development end to end, from primary landscape analysis through understanding of competitive tools and developer-level perceptions. And turn that into the narrative the field, analysts, and executives all use

- Own the operating rhythm that converts competitive signal into a position and action within days

- Give Product an opinionated read on what competitive movement means for roadmap sequencing, bringing evidence and a recommendation rather than a summary of what competitors shipped

- Build the compete assets, plays, and objection handling the field uses against named competitors, define the sales motion that moves win rate, then measure whether it did

- Partner with Growth and Campaigns on competitor displacement campaigns, accountable for their contribution to pipeline

- Brief Investor Relations, industry analysts, sales, and executive leadership with the same rigor, owning the competitive-landscape narrative with analysts and PMMs 

- Raise the competitive bar across the PMM team

- Ability to travel if needed and comply with the company's travel policy

 What you'll bring 

- Proven impact at the organizational and industry level

- Deep domain expertise in SDLC, DevSecOps, and agentic software development to engage technical buyers and executive audiences

- Track record of driving competitive positioning that delivers measurable win-rate impact

- Fluency in the AI/agentic coding landscape and competitor exposure areas

- Established thought leadership with industry recognition (speaking, publications, advisory roles)

- Experience briefing executives, investor relations, and industry analysts

- Ability to form and articulate a clear point of view quickly despite incomplete information

- Strong communication skills to translate complex technical concepts into clear narratives

- Practical experience using AI tools within your workflow

- Self-directed, data-driven mindset using win/loss insights to guide strategy

 About the team

 An overview of this role 

 GitLab is building the most comprehensive AI-powered DevSecOps platform, and this role will help shape how teams move from planning to code in an AI-native software development lifecycle.

 As Senior Product Manager, Source Code, you'll shape how planning and managing source code will evolve in an AI-native software development lifecycle. This role is focused on bringing planning and code closer together, so teams can move from requirements and specifications to commits, merge requests, and customer value with speed and quality.

 This area is evolving quickly. We're exploring how AI agents can use specifications, context, and human feedback to build the right thing, not just build the thing right. You'll define new product experiences for spec-driven, human-in-the loop development: how the link between planning intent and the code that implements it gets created, stays accurate as both change, and gets used at review time. The hard part is that this link decays. Code moves, specs might not follow, you will define how to make that connection self-maintaining.

 This is an ambiguous, high-impact opportunity for a product manager who has strong software development lifecycle knowledge, is comfortable working with technical teams, and wants to help create something new in DevSecOps.

 What You’ll Do 

- Define and drive product strategy for experiences that connect planning, source code management, and AI-assisted development.

- Shape workflows where teams and agents move between intent and code in both directions, so a specification can be traced to the merges that implement it and a diff can be read and reviewed against the intent behind it.

- Work with engineering, design, and other product teams to build product experiences that support human-in-the-loop and autonomous development workflows.

- Partner with teams working on demos and prototypes, including near-term work around spec-driven planning and autonomous development modes, including which decisions stay with a human and why.

- Use customer insights, product usage data, and market context to identify opportunities that can deliver customer value quickly.

- Help teams ship fast with quality, balancing near-term execution with longer-term product direction.

- Explore how planning can better account for reviewing code, reviewing test cases, and validating that work produced by agents matches the intended outcome.

- Collaborate across Plan, Source Code Management, Code Review, and AI product areas to reduce friction across the software development lifecycle.

 What You’ll Bring 

- Experience as a product manager working on developer tools, DevOps tools, source code management, planning tools, AI-native products, or related software development lifecycle products.

- Direct, hands-on experience with the source code lifecycle, including branches, merge requests, code review, CI/CD, and releases, whether as a product manager or as an engineer, along with a strong understanding of how software moves from ideas and requirements through planning, coding, review, testing, and delivery.

- Experience working with technical product areas and engineering teams, with enough technical depth to understand developer workflows and tradeoffs.

- A data-forward approach to product management, including experience using data to identify customer impact and guide prioritization.

- Comfort operating in ambiguous spaces where there may not yet be a clear market pattern or established product category.

- Experience building or shipping with AI tools and agents, not just using them, and a point of view of your own on where AI helps and where it does not across the software development lifecycle.

- Ability to think creatively about how AI changes the software development lifecycle and how product experiences should adapt.

- Strong collaboration and communication skills, especially in an all-remote, asynchronous environment.

- A bias toward action and the ability to help teams ship meaningful customer value quickly.

 About the team 

 This role sits within the Product organization and will work closely with teams across Plan, Source Code Management, Code Review, and AI. We are focused on helping GitLab customers plan, build, and deliver software in a faster, more connected way.

 You'll join a group that is rethinking how planning and coding should work as AI changes the speed and shape of software development. Rather than treating planning, coding, and review as separate stages, we're exploring how to bring these workflows closer together so humans and agents can collaborate more effectively.

 An overview of this role 

 As Staff Product Manager, Test & Code Coverage, you'll build product capabilities from initial discovery through launch and adoption. You'll help engineering teams understand why pipelines fail, improve test automation, and use code coverage to make better decisions about software quality and risk.

 You'll turn a technically complex problem space into a focused strategy, roadmap, and developer experience. Working closely with Engineering and Design, you'll explore how agents can diagnose failures, recommend next steps, and help teams recover safely. The goal isn't to add artificial intelligence (AI) for its own sake. It's to reduce manual work and help developers get back to a safe, shippable state without losing trust or control.

 At GitLab, our mission is simple: to enable everyone to contribute to and co-create the software that powers our world. You'll contribute to that mission by making testing and coverage insights more useful across the software development lifecycle.

 What you'll do 

- Define and communicate the Test & Code Coverage product vision, strategy, and outcome-focused roadmap, from discovery through a minimum viable product, beta, launch, and continued iteration.

- Identify customer problems across pipeline failure diagnosis, test automation, test optimization, code coverage, and recovery. Build the case for investment, prioritize foundational and customer-facing work, and reshape or stop initiatives that aren't creating value.

- Work with Engineering to understand pipeline failures caused by flaky tests, testing gaps, environment issues, configuration problems, and coverage blind spots. Connect code changes, tests, pipeline behavior, historical patterns, and risk to help developers find a diagnosis and an actionable next step.

- Work directly with customers to understand how they author, maintain, select, prioritize, and debug tests. Connect test selection, test impact analysis, code coverage, and pipeline intelligence to reduce flaky tests, shorten feedback loops, and focus testing effort where it lowers the most risk.

- Partner with Engineering and Design to prototype agent-driven workflows for failure diagnosis, test authoring and repair, optimization, coverage analysis, and recovery. Make actions reviewable through evidence, confidence, human approval, and safe paths to propose code changes and merge requests. Use AI tools in your own product work to investigate problems, explore code and data, prototype concepts, and accelerate learning.

- Define and measure outcomes such as time to diagnose, time to recover, failure recurrence, test signal quality, and developer confidence. Validate problems and solutions with customers and learn from production usage.

- Partner across Product, Engineering, Design, Quality, Developer Experience, Customer Success, Support, and Product Marketing to connect testing insights with code review, pipelines, and release decisions. Turn customer evidence into clear narratives that support adoption and future investment.

- Lead through clear written communication, prioritization, and product judgment. Influence senior stakeholders, establish repeatable discovery and measurement practices, and mentor other product managers.

 Affirm's Distribution Partnerships program - internally called " 1:Many " - is one of the highest-leverage growth levers at the company. Instead of integrating merchant by merchant, we integrate once into a platform merchants already use, and every merchant on that platform becomes reachable through that single integration. This role is responsible for:

- 
 Own and grow Affirm's partner portfolio  - making it easier and more frictionless for merchants to onboard and offer Affirm as a payment method to their customers. - 
 Partner Acceleration Strategy  - building the durable capabilities that make every future partner integration faster to launch and easier to scale, rather than solving the same problem one partner at a time.

 As a Senior Product Manager, you will work closely with cross-functional teams including commercial, merchant risk, design, product analytics, and engineering to define, launch and grow integrations with platform partners. Effective stakeholder management and ability to successfully navigate organizational dynamics are a must for success. You should be outcomes-driven with a very high bias for action.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, launch, and grow integrations with payment and platform partners.

- Build durable, repeatable capabilities through a Partner Acceleration Strategy that makes future partner integrations faster to launch.

- Build relationships with platform partners to gather feedback and insights on product performance, and use it to drive merchant growth.

- Define and prioritize product features and requirements to improve the customer, partner, and merchant experience.

- Create and manage the product roadmap for the broader 1:Many growth team.

- Develop success metrics/OKRs to measure the effectiveness of these initiatives.

- Partner with commercial and product marketing teams to develop go-to-market strategies for new partner integrations and features.

 What We Look For 

- 5+ years of product management experience

- Proven ability to multiple technical software products from kickoff to post-launch, driving meaningful business impact you can clearly articulate. 

- Skilled in cross-functional collaboration — diving into technical details with engineers, iterating with designers in Figma, and analyzing funnel performance with data analysts.

- Strong organizational and communication skills to navigate complex dynamics and drive alignment. 

- Execution-oriented with a proactive approach to overcoming obstacles and blockers.

- Adept at transforming incomplete or conflicting inputs into clear, actionable plans.

- Demonstrated track record of shipping high-quality products on time. 

- Comfortable engaging in the commercial aspects of product development, including representing the product externally, setting expectations, and influencing outcomes that benefit both Affirm and its partners.

 Millions of people use the Affirm Card, but we don’t yet give them a reason to keep coming back beyond the product itself. You’ll build our consumer loyalty program from scratch: what people earn, how they move up, and why Affirm becomes their default way to pay.

 What you’ll do 

- 
 Own the vision and roadmap for Affirm’s consumer loyalty program, setting the hypotheses, success metrics, and sequencing across multiple quarters

- 
 Launch the first version of rewards and tiers, including earn mechanics, member benefits, redemption, and the surfaces that make the value obvious in app, at checkout, and after a purchase

-

- 
 Own the program economics: reward liability, funding mix across merchant-funded offers, interchange and network incentives, and the case for incremental GMV against cost per member

- 
 Set up the measurement foundation for loyalty, including holdouts, incrementality testing and long-run LTV, then tune earn and burn rates and tier thresholds off what the data says

- 
 Partner with Risk, Credit, Legal, Compliance, Finance and Marketing to design rewards that are compliant and clearly disclosed, with no hidden fees or fine print that surprises people

- 
 Align senior stakeholders and pull together dependencies across Card, Shopping, Servicing and Marketing, leading embedded engineering and design pods through a lot of ambiguity

- 
 8+ years in Product Management, with a track record in consumer mobile apps, fintech, or neobanks

- 
 Built or scaled a loyalty, rewards or engagement program: card rewards, points, tiers, subscription benefits, or something equivalent. You know earn and burn mechanics and what makes a program pay for itself

- 
 History of launching products from scratch, not just optimizing what already exists

- 
 Owned repeat usage, cohort retention or share of wallet as a primary metric, and know which levers actually move them

- 
 Comfortable building the financial model yourself and defending reward cost, funding mix and payback to Finance and leadership

- 
 Strong UX instincts and a high bar for design. You know the difference between a reward that feels good and a badge buried in a settings menu

- 
 Deep fluency in experiment design, incrementality/attribution, and LTV measurement; data chops (SQL/Amplitude-level self-serve) and a bias for shipping, learning and iterating quickly

 Track record shipping consumer financial or regulated products; comfort partnering with Risk/Credit, Legal, and Compliance

ashby:cohere:1d1b300d-254b-48c4-958f-99c.description:
Who are we?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company.  We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!




ABOUT COHERE AND NORTH

Cohere is revolutionizing enterprise AI with North, an agentic AI platform designed to securely deploy AI agents and automations within organizations' infrastructure. North empowers employees to streamline workflows, automate repetitive tasks, and unlock actionable insights while ensuring data privacy and compliance. North combines cutting-edge generative and search models with customizable integrations to drive productivity and innovation at scale.




ROLE OVERVIEW

We are seeking an Agent Harness Product Manager to own the execution layer that makes North agents reliable, capable, and production-ready. This is a role that sits at the intersection of three domains:



Agent Loop and Execution. 

Own the core agent runtime: tool orchestration, parallel execution, sub-agent delegation, sandbox code execution, and failure recovery. You will define how North agents plan and act across long, multi-step workflows and ensure the execution environment is robust enough for the most demanding enterprise tasks. You are expected to engage at the implementation level, contributing to architecture decisions alongside engineering rather than simply handing off requirements.



Context Engineering. 

Own how our Agents manage the context window as a deliberately controlled resource. This includes progressive disclosure of tools and skills, context compaction and summarization, offloading of large payloads to a persistent filesystem, and the instrumentation that keeps agents oriented across extended trajectories.



Model-Scaffolding Co-evolution. 

Own the feedback loop between North's harness and the Modeling Team. This PM is the connective tissue that makes that possible: ensuring harness design decisions are validated by Modeling before they are built, that evals are the shared bridge between both teams, and that as the harness evolves the model evolves with it.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Define and own the roadmap for North's agent harness, including the agent loop, context engineering layer, tool orchestration, sandbox execution, and sub-agent delegation

 - Serve as the primary interface between North engineering and Cohere's Modeling team, ensuring new harness capabilities are validated before being built and that neither team paints itself into a corner

 - Own North's agentic evaluation framework, ensuring evals are compatible with both the North harness and Modeling's training infrastructure, and that they serve as a reliable bridge between product and research

 - Engage enterprise customers to surface real-world agentic failures and translate findings into concrete product and model requirements

 - Partner with the agentic expert modeling team to define goals that maximize the impact of our models and prioritize model capabilities and evals most critical for delivering on those goals. Establish a clear roadmap for our agentic modeling capabilities.

 - Stay current with the open-source and commercial agent ecosystem and drive adoption decisions that keep North's architecture aligned with emerging standards.
   
   


REQUIREMENTS

 - 5+ years of product management experience as a research PM, in agentic AI systems,, or applied ML products

 - Deep understanding of agentic harnesses, including the latest paid and open source offerings.

 - Deep understanding of modern LLM agent architectures, including multi-agent systems, tool-augmented reasoning, memory and retrieval, programmatic orchestration, RAG, and long-horizon execution

 - Strong grasp of agentic evaluation design, including how to measure task completion, failure recovery, and long-horizon reliability, and how to diagnose model vs. scaffolding gaps

 - Technically deep enough to contribute to architecture decisions at the implementation level: comfortable reviewing and shaping design docs, reasoning about async execution patterns, sandboxed environments, filesystem design, and the tradeoffs that come with building harness capabilities into a production platform

 - Ability to flex between ML research conversations and engineering architecture discussions with equal fluency

 - Track record of shipping platform-layer products with demonstrated impact on reliability, performance, or capability.




NICE-TO-HAVES

 - Direct experience in developing and shipping leading agentic harnesses.

 - An active practitioner of agent frameworks who regularly builds with and follows the latest developments in open-source harnesses, coding agents, and orchestration tools in both professional and personal work

 - Hands-on experience with enterprise agentic deployments: multi-tenant orchestration, tool permissioning, audit trails, and compliance requirements

 - Familiarity with infrastructure constraints relevant to enterprise deployments: on-premises environments, scalability challenges, and the operational tradeoffs of running complex agent workloads in restricted or air-gapped settings

 - Prior work at the intersection of research and product, translating nascent model capabilities into shipped product features

 - Background working within or closely alongside an ML research or post-training team.




WHY JOIN COHERE?

 - Impact: Shape how Canada's most important public institutions adopt and deploy frontier AI.

 - Innovation: Work alongside leading researchers and engineers solving complex ML challenges.

 - Growth: Competitive compensation, equity options, and opportunities for professional development.

 - Flexibility: Hybrid work model with offices in key global locations (Toronto, Montreal, New York, San Francisco, London, Paris, and Korea)




FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS:

 - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.

 - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.

 - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

 - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.

 - Annual enrichment benefits:
   
   Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.
   
   Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

 - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)

 - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.




HOW AND WHERE WE WORK:

 - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.

 - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.

 - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.

 - Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly.
   
   

If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply.
