Why This Role?

We're seeking an experienced Program Manager to join Cohere's customer-facing Program Management team, with a focus on Canadian public sector and defence accounts. This is a highly specialized role requiring an individual who understands technical program delivery, the technical complexity of frontier AI models and the unique requirements of government and defence organizations.

You will be the critical bridge between our cutting-edge AI capabilities and the specific needs of Canadian federal departments, provincial agencies, Crown corporations, and defence organizations. You'll navigate complex procurement processes, stringent security requirements, data sovereignty concerns, and regulatory compliance while ensuring our customers successfully deploy and scale our AI solutions.

In this role, you'll collaborate with our Strategic Customer team, Applied ML (AML) Engineering, Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE), Platform, Product, and Go-to-Market teams, serving as the technical program lead and trusted advisor for our most sensitive and high-impact government engagements.



Location: Ottawa required 

Security Clearance: Active Top Secret clearance strongly preferred; candidates eligible and willing to obtain clearance will also be considered.



What You'll Do

Customer Program Leadership:

 - Own end-to-end technical program delivery for Canadian public sector and defence customers, from initial deployment through production scaling

 - Serve as the primary technical program point of contact for government customers, building trusted relationships with departmental CIOs, IT directors, and technical teams

 - Translate complex government requirements (security, compliance, accessibility, bilingualism, data sovereignty) into actionable engineering plans

 - Navigate government procurement processes, RFP responses, and contractual technical obligations.

Strategic Communication:

 - Provide clear, timely, and objective communication across Cohere's engineering organization, customer stakeholders, and government leadership

 - Translate between AI/ML technical concepts and government-appropriate language for decision-makers who may not have deep technical backgrounds

 - Present technical roadmaps and status updates to senior government officials and departmental executives

 - Represent Cohere's technical capabilities in sensitive government and defence contexts.

Complex Program Management:

 - Create and manage project schedules that account for government timelines, security review processes, and ministerial approval cycles

 - Identify and manage dependencies across government departments, security authorities, cloud service providers, and internal Cohere teams

 - Navigate risks unique to government deployments: privacy compliance, Algorithmic Impact Assessments, Treasury Board submissions, security authorizations

 - Drive alignment between product development priorities and specific government requirements.

Technical Delivery & Execution:

 - Ensure on-time delivery of AI solutions that meet government-grade security, privacy, accessibility, and performance standards

 - Coordinate technical work across multiple teams: model customization, security hardening, integration with government systems, bilingual support

 - Establish governance checkpoints appropriate for high-stakes government deployments

 - Problem-solve complex technical challenges in air-gapped, on-premises, or highly regulated environments.



You May Be a Good Fit If:

Required Experience:

 - 6+ years of experience as a customer-facing Technical or Engineering Program Manager in AI/ML consulting, technology transformation, or enterprise software delivery.

 - Excellent executive communication and stakeholder management.

 - Experience working with government, defence, or heavily regulated customers (public sector, defence contractors).

 - Proven track record managing complex, multi-stakeholder technical programs with stringent compliance requirements.

 - Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field; advanced degree or technical certs a plus.

Technical Background:

 - Strong understanding of enterprise software deployment architectures (cloud, on-premises, hybrid, air-gapped)

 - Working knowledge of or experience with modern AI: LLMs, agentic systems, MCP, RAG, fine-tuning, evals, and responsible AI would be a strong differentiator

 - Comfortable discussing API integrations, model inference, data pipelines, and ML operations with technical stakeholders.

Government & Defence Acumen:

 - Deep understanding of how government organizations procure, evaluate, and deploy technology

 - Familiarity with Canadian government requirements: data sovereignty, privacy laws (Privacy Act), accessibility standards, official languages obligations, security classifications

 - Understanding of defence and national security considerations in AI deployment

 - Experience with Algorithmic Impact Assessments or AI ethics frameworks is a strong asset

 - Eligible to obtain Canadian government security clearance (Top Secret preferred)

Nice to Have:

 - Active Canadian government security clearance (Secret or Top Secret) - strong preference for active Top Secret clearance

 - Bilingual (English/French) proficiency

 - Background in or strong familiarity with Canadian defence, intelligence, or critical infrastructure sectors

 - Experience with GC Cloud services (Azure, AWS GovCloud) or Protected B/C environments

 - Project management certification (PMP, PgMP) or government-specific methodologies.



Security Clearance Requirements

This role requires eligibility for Canadian government security clearance.

Strong preference will be given to candidates who currently hold an active Top Secret (TS) clearance, as this will enable immediate engagement with our most sensitive defence and national security customers.

However, we will also consider exceptional candidates who:

 - Currently hold Secret clearance and are eligible for TS upgrade

 - Do not currently hold clearance, but are eligible and willing to undergo the Top Secret clearance process

 - Have a previous government security clearance that has lapsed

Please note that obtaining Top Secret clearance can take 12-18 months. Candidates without active clearance will work on non-classified public sector accounts while the clearance process is underway.



What Makes This Role Unique

This isn't typical program management—it's a highly specialized role at the intersection of frontier AI, national security, and public sector digital transformation. You'll work on some of Canada's most sensitive and impactful AI deployments, helping government organizations harness cutting-edge technology while maintaining the highest standards of security, ethics, and accountability.

If you're passionate about responsible AI adoption, understand the unique constraints and opportunities within government, and want to have an outsized impact on how Canada leverages AI to serve its citizens, this role is for you.

ashby:cohere:41cb2a12-e33a-4368-a9f8-0ae.description:
Who are we?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company.  We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

Why this role?

We’re seeking an experienced Technical Program Manager to join Cohere’s customer-facing Engineering Program Management team. We need someone with curiosity, drive, independence, and leadership, who has hands-on experience working directly with customers and managing projects for enterprise-grade software or enterprise-focused machine learning solutions. In return, you’ll have the unique opportunity to shape Cohere’s operations, collaborate with leading minds in the LLM space, work directly with our Strategic Customers as well as Applied ML (AML) Engineering, Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE), Platform , Product and Go-to-Market teams, and be the “technical” voice of Cohere for the customer. You will get a chance to create extremely high-impact contributions to our fast-growing company, product and culture.

As an Engineering Program Manager/ Technical Program Manager, you will:

 - Communicate: Provide clear, timely, and objective communication across the tech organization, Cohere teams, leadership, and most importantly - our strategic customers and external partners.

 - Optimize: Break down complex issues into strategies, driving engineering alignment with product, business, and marketing while fostering collaboration.

 - Plan: Create and manage program/project schedules, identify dependencies, manage risks, and drive organizational alignment.

 - Execute: Ensure on-time delivery, identify development needs, and establish checkpoints for status updates.

 - Problem solve: Proactively identify and resolve issues, coordinate cross-functional dependencies, and prioritize impacts to schedule and product quality.

You may be a good fit if:

 - You have at least 5 years of experience as an Engineering or Technical Program Manager, with at least 2 years in customer-facing technical delivery and operations focused on enterprise-grade AI software/solutions

 - Knowledge or experience with LLM training or optimization would be a key differentiator

 - You are problem-focused and making customers successful really excites you

 - You are detail-oriented and extremely self-organized. You love enabling people and teams around you, and are excellent at capturing detailed notes/action items during highly technical meetings and tracking progress.

 - You have a Bias for Action - you are very execution focused and you like getting things done.

 - You have experience working with cross-functional teams to get technical products, services or solutions shipped to an internal or an external customer and can independently own tracking and reporting across multiple work-streams, with owners in different time-zones.

 - You are comfortable holding leaders and individual contributors accountable. You can be assertive while remaining diplomatic. You are not afraid to follow up with people to ensure shipping within committed deadlines.




FULL-TIME EMPLOYEES AT COHERE ENJOY THESE PERKS:

 - A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.

 - Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.

 - RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

 - 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.

 - Annual enrichment benefits:
   
   Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.
   
   Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

 - 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)

 - Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.




HOW AND WHERE WE WORK:

 - Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.

 - For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.

 - For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.

Who are we?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company.  We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

About the role 

We're hiring a Chief of Staff to keep Cohere's AI organization running at full speed. You'll report to and support the Chief AI Officer and work to bridge across all teams and functions at Cohere (including research, modelling, product, delivery, security, sales and operations). In any given quarter, the org ships new AI product demos and releases, customer pilots and scaled solutions, security updates, often across regions and time zones. Your job is to make sure the right work priorities win when everything feels urgent, that our plans turn into high-quality shipped work, and that our Chief AI Officer can focus on leading instead of firefighting.

Much of this is operational: the planning calendar, the budget, the headcount plan, the weekly business reviews, the communication strategy (internal and external), the cross-functional handoffs.  Your role is the operating rhythm of the org: meetings, priorities, plans, and the decisions that come out of them.  You will be a member of an experienced, high-performing and supportive leadership team.


What you'll own 

Own the operating rhythm and planning: annual and quarterly planning, goal-setting, and the weekly and monthly business reviews. Drive budget and headcount planning against the slate, and keep both honest as priorities shift mid-quarter.

Keep major programs from colliding or stalling across research, modelling, product, delivery, and security.  Be the person teams come to when it isn't clear who owns a decision, or how to navigate trade-offs.

Be the connective tissue between the Chief AI Officer’s org and the rest of the company: cross-functional planning with product, engineering, security, and finance, so the org's commitments are realistic and its dependencies are visible.

Own and lead special projects: Lead the things that don't fit neatly on any one team's plate: a reorg, a new partnership, a flagship research event, an org-wide planning week. Own them end to end.


Who you are 

You have 12+ years of operating experience, with real time inside an AI/ML organization in a Chief of Staff, business operations, or senior program-operations seat.  You know how to partner with teams shipping fast & often to high-stakes organizations, and you know how to change course with agility when needed.

You understand how AI actually works—at the level of someone who's done it rather than managed it from a distance. You can talk credibly about how a model turns into a product, what data requirements demand from both research and engineering, and where delivery motions usually break. You're fluent in the numbers. Model performance metrics, data pipeline throughput, budget-to-impact.  You don't have to run every program yourself. You do have to understand them well enough that the people who run them respect your judgment.

You hold strategy and execution in the same hand. You can sit in a planning conversation with the Chief AI Officer in the morning and chase down a stuck deliverable in the afternoon.

You thrive in a fast-paced environment, you handle ambiguity with curiosity and confidence, you stay calm when it's messy.  You have a track record of bringing order to a fast, complex org without grinding it to a halt.

You are an outstanding communicator and know how to wield soft power. Clear writing, straight talk, the ability to influence teams and individuals, and the executive presence to represent the Chief AI Officer in high-stakes conversations.

lever:waabi:74ff3e1c-821c-4c31-aada-54f4.description:
Waabi, founded by AI visionary Raquel Urtasun, is the leader in Physical AI. With a world-class team, we're unlocking the next era of autonomous transportation with technology that's powering commercial autonomous trucks and robotaxis. Waabi is backed by and partners with world leaders in AI, automotive, logistics, and deep tech.
 
With offices in Toronto, San Francisco, Dallas, and Pittsburgh, Waabi is growing quickly and looking for diverse, innovative and collaborative candidates who want to impact the world in a positive way. To learn more visit: www.waabi.ai


We are seeking a Product Manager to lead product definition for the hardware platform that carries the Waabi Driver, across autonomous trucks and robotaxi. This is our first dedicated hardware product role, and it requires someone who is grounded in hardware: a product leader who can turn the needs of autonomy, safety, operations, riders, and the public into clear requirements, and who knows enough about hardware to tell an ambitious idea from an impossible one. You will sit at the line between requirements and implementation, laying out scenarios, testing ideas in mock-ups and vehicles, partnering with hardware engineering on high-level solutions, and representing product with our OEM and supplier partners until the product is right end-to-end.
You will...
Own product requirements for Waabi's hardware platform across trucks and robotaxi, turning field and integration feedback into requirements for future revisions and new vehicle platforms.
Define how our vehicles interact with the people around them, including riders, law enforcement, first responders, and the public. This covers exterior communication and signaling, cabin monitoring and security, in-cabin safety, and resilience to tampering and vandalism.
Lead product definition for new hardware programs before engineering kickoff, turning real-world scenarios into requirements with clear acceptance criteria and a plan to verify and validate each one.
Bring an industrial design and human factors perspective to physical touchpoints like displays, lighting, reach, and controls, and validate them hands-on in mock-ups and real vehicles.
Build trusted relationships with OEM and supplier partners, understanding their constraints and processes and keeping requirements aligned across organizations.
Represent hardware credibly in cross-functional product decisions about what's possible, what's costly, and what's out of scope.
Qualifications:
A hardware background, through an engineering degree (mechanical, electrical, systems, or similar) or equivalent hands-on experience, deep enough to earn engineering teams' trust while you work at the requirements level.
8+ years of experience in product management, hardware product, or systems engineering roles on physical products, ideally in automotive, autonomous vehicles, robotics, or complex consumer hardware.
A track record of taking hardware from concept to production, with an understanding of how requirements evolve across prototype and sample stages.
Industrial design experience, through formal training or close work with industrial designers on shipped products, and strong instincts for HMI and human factors.
Strong requirements writing skills. You can turn a messy real-world scenario into a clear, testable requirement, with acceptance criteria and a verification method such as test, analysis, inspection, or demonstration.
Experience building working relationships with OEMs and suppliers, and an understanding of how they develop, source, and deliver hardware.

lever:waabi:01ee26ae-76e5-41df-a5d1-d03d.description:
Waabi, founded by AI visionary Raquel Urtasun, is the leader in Physical AI. With a world-class team, we're unlocking the next era of autonomous transportation with technology that's powering commercial autonomous trucks and robotaxis. Waabi is backed by and partners with world leaders in AI, automotive, logistics, and deep tech.
With offices in Toronto, San Francisco, Dallas, and Pittsburgh, Waabi is growing quickly and looking for diverse, innovative and collaborative candidates who want to impact the world in a positive way. To learn more visit: www.waabi.ai


Waabi's Commercial Product team defines and delivers the end-to-end commercial product that makes autonomous trucking deployable, scalable, and valuable to customers. We sit between autonomy, operations, business development, and customers, turning driverless capability into a real-world product that can be launched, sold, operated, and scaled.
As Waabi rapidly scales from commercial pilots to large-scale driverless deployments, this role serves as the critical integration layer between truck supply, customer commitments, expansion efforts, site activations, and autonomy capabilities. You will manage the execution of the commercial plan, proactively tracking dependencies and mitigating risks to drive clear commercial progress.
We are hiring a Senior Program Manager to own and align the single integrated commercialization plan, ensuring every element converges seamlessly.
While functional program leads manage their respective areas, you will integrate their milestones into the overarching commercial plan. Success relies on sound judgment: identifying critical dependencies, distinguishing real timeline slips, and resolving decision bottlenecks. A year from now, when leadership asks whether we are on track for a launch, a truck delivery or a customer commitment, the answer should be one page, current, and believed by every team on it.
What You'll Do
You will own the integrated commercialization roadmap for trucking and the weekly operating cadence around it. This includes:
Build and own the integrated roadmap that ties customer commitments, OEM truck supply, autonomy and ODD readiness, lane and site activation, Mission Control, operations readiness and Account Management launches to dates, with the dependencies between them made explicit. You own the plan end to end.
Maintain the honest picture: the critical path, the slips, the risks and the decisions needed, surfaced early enough to act on and framed for the people who have to decide.
Lead the execution of key company milestones involving multiple departments at Waabi.
Run the operating cadence, including a weekly cross-functional Truck Program meeting.
Help establish repeatable frameworks, procedures, and decision loops that allow fast and efficient scale.
Produce executive-ready updates and program artifacts.
Communicate clearly with technical, operational, commercial and executive audiences that value first-principles thinking.
What Success Looks Like
Success in this role means the commercial plan converges on purpose rather than by heroics. Specifically, you will have:
Within 90 days, one integrated roadmap that Autonomy, Operations, Sales and Account Management believe, with the Truck Program meeting running off it.
A first driverless launch with no dependency discovered in the final month that was knowable in the first.
Leadership learning about a slip from you, with options, before they learn about it from a customer.
Decisions with a date, an owner and a record, so the same question is not re-decided in three meetings.
Qualifications Required
7+ years in program or product leadership in a complex technical and operational environment (autonomous vehicles, automotive, aerospace, robotics, aviation, defense, logistics or other physical-world deployment).
Track record of integrating programs across teams you did not control, in a business with hardware, software, safety and operations in the loop.
Enough technical fluency to understand why an autonomy or hardware milestone slipped and whether the recovery plan is credible, without needing to be the engineer.
Separates facts, assumptions and risks in how you write and speak; comfortable telling senior people something they do not want to hear, early, with options.
Builds the minimum structure that works and removes or upgrades it when it stops working.
Executive-grade verbal and written communication; most of this role's influence happens in documents and in how a problem is framed.
Set direction for a program others execute, with no direct reports, and being accountable for the outcome anyway.
Strongly Preferred
Ownership mentality: takes initiative and gets into the trenches with key stakeholders.
Varies the degree of detail to the audience and the moment.
Experience running a weekly holistic program review.
Experience taking a physical product from pilot to commercial deployment, where readiness gates and launch dates were real.
Experience working alongside a safety or systems-engineering function on go/no-go decisions.
Experience with OEM or supplier delivery schedules as a dependency in a commercial plan.
Zero-to-one program experience at an early-stage or scaling company.
Nice to have
Direct experience in autonomous trucking, freight or AV commercialization.
Experience working with operations and/or commercial teams.
 
The US yearly salary range for this role is: $140,000 - $180,000 USD in addition to competitive perks & benefits. Waabi US Inc.’s yearly salary ranges are determined based on several factors in accordance with the Company’s compensation practices. Note: The Company provides additional compensation for employees in this role, including equity incentive awards and an annual performance bonus.

greenhouse:tenstorrent:5249598007.title: Staff Technical Program Manager, Data Center Deployment
greenhouse:tenstorrent:5249598007.description:
Tenstorrent is leading the industry on cutting-edge AI technology, revolutionizing performance expectations, ease of use, and cost efficiency. With AI redefining the computing paradigm, solutions must evolve to unify innovations in software models, compilers, platforms, networking, and semiconductors. Our diverse team of technologists have developed a high performance RISC-V CPU from scratch, and share a passion for AI and a deep desire to build the best AI platform possible. We value collaboration, curiosity, and a commitment to solving hard problems. We are growing our team and looking for contributors of all seniorities.

 As a Staff or Senior Staff Technical Program Manager on the Data Center Deployment and SRE team, you will drive complex programs spanning hardware, software, infrastructure, and data center operations. You will connect technical dependencies, operational data, and engineering workflows to improve how systems are deployed and scaled. This role combines deep technical understanding with hands-on program leadership, using automation and data to improve execution, visibility, and decision-making across teams.

 This role is hybrid, based out of Toronto, Canada.

 We welcome candidates at various experience levels for this role. During the interview process, candidates will be assessed for the appropriate level, and offers will align with that level, which may differ from the one in this posting.

 Who You Are 

- A self-directed technical leader who can take ambiguous, cross-functional problems and turn them into structured, executable programs.

- A systems thinker with a strong understanding of computer architecture, operating systems, runtime systems, and the dependencies between hardware and software.

- Hands-on with data, tooling, and automation, with the ability to connect systems and improve the quality and accessibility of program information.

- An effective technical partner who can work deeply with engineering teams while communicating risks, tradeoffs, and decisions clearly to senior leadership.

 What We Need 

- Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.

- 5+ years leading complex technical programs, tooling initiatives, or data-driven engineering operations as a TPM, technical lead, or cross-functional owner.

- Strong understanding of computer architecture and systems, including processors, memory hierarchies, interconnects, operating systems, runtimes, and hardware-software interfaces.

- Technical depth to identify dependencies, evaluate tradeoffs, and drive execution across hardware, firmware, compilers, software, infrastructure, and deployment teams.

- Experience building scalable workflows and automation using APIs, telemetry, data pipelines, dashboards, CI/CD, SQL, Python, scripting, and engineering management platforms, with the ability to translate technical signals, metrics, risks, and dependencies into clear executive-level reporting.

 What You Will Learn 

- How Tenstorrent deploys and operates complex AI hardware and software systems across large-scale data center environments.

- How architecture, firmware, compilers, software, infrastructure, and deployment interact throughout the lifecycle of an AI system.

- How to apply automation and AI-enabled tooling to improve technical program execution, operational visibility, and decision-making.

- How to shape the tooling, processes, and operating model used to scale deployment and SRE programs across Tenstorrent.

 Tenstorrent offers a highly competitive compensation package and benefits, and we are an equal opportunity employer. 
 This offer of employment is contingent upon the applicant being eligible to access U.S. export-controlled technology.  Due to U.S. export laws, including those codified in the U.S. Export Administration Regulations (EAR), the Company is required to ensure compliance with these laws when transferring technology to nationals of certain countries (such as EAR Country Groups D:1, E1, and E2).   These requirements apply to persons located in the U.S. and all countries outside the U.S.  As the position offered will have direct and/or indirect access to information, systems, or technologies subject to these laws, the offer may be contingent upon your citizenship/permanent residency status or ability to obtain prior license approval from the U.S. Commerce Department or applicable federal agency.  If employment is not possible due to U.S. export laws, any offer of employment will be rescinded.

greenhouse:stackadapt:4391710009.description:
StackAdapt is the leading technology company that empowers marketers to reach, engage, and convert audiences with precision. With 465 billion automated optimizations per second, the AI-powered StackAdapt Marketing Platform seamlessly connects brand and performance marketing to drive measurable results across the entire customer journey. The most forward-thinking marketers choose StackAdapt to orchestrate high-impact campaigns across programmatic advertising and marketing channels.

 We are looking for an experienced leader to join our team as Director of Product Marketing. Reporting to the VP of Product Marketing, this is an added leadership role in StackAdapt’s growing marketing organization to lead critical areas of StackAdapt’s product marketing function. During this period of rapid growth, we are looking for a leader to scale our go-to-market motion, help to drive product adoption and retention, and educate our clients and prospects on programmatic, martech concepts, and our platform.  You will be responsible for building, developing, and managing a world-class team of product marketers.

 StackAdapt is a remote-first company, we are open to candidates located anywhere in Canada and the United States for this position and encourage those from all backgrounds to apply. 

 What You'll Be Doing:

- Drive product marketing strategy, collaborating with product, revenue, marketing and executive teams to create successful go-to-market motions. 

- Own product messaging, positioning, value propositions and differentiators to drive exponential growth in each vertical and region. 

- Accelerate AI adoption and enablement across the organization to expand product adoption and win more in each vertical. 

- Build a successful GTM process for all new products, solutions and features, enabling internal teams and driving the narrative of innovation externally. 

- Deeply understand the programmatic industry, market trends, and jobs to be done, including client pain points, usage and buying behavior, and the partner ecosystem.

- Subject matter expert in identifying market opportunities and connecting customer needs to StackAdapt’s product offerings.

- Partner with VP of Product Marketing, CMO and executive leadership to build the category and expand into adjacent markets.

- Provide input and strategy into product roadmap, strategy, and pricing based on market and customer research finding, industry analyst interactions and competitive findings.

- Support the team in setting clear goals and key results. Ensure that those are communicated and visible across the company and progress is shared regularly.

 What You'll Bring to the Table

- Proven product marketing leadership experience having built and scaled world-class product marketing teams through creative strategies, great communication, strong partnerships, and engaging culture.

- Confidence in scaling launch processes and go-to-market (GTM) motions, supporting revenue teams to drive growth and personally owning ambitious revenue targets.

- Prior leadership and working experience in ad tech and martech with deep expertise in digital advertising, data,  b2b, and marketing automation solutions. 

- Domain expertise in building strong categories with compelling messaging, positioning and data-driven storytelling. 

- At least 7 years of experience in a people leadership position has given you a strong set of leadership skills, and a deep understanding of how to build a performance-oriented culture.

 The Creatives team is on a mission to build a one-stop-shop for advertisers' creative production and management needs. We're developing a comprehensive in-house product that lets clients create, enhance, preview, store, and manage CTV, video, audio, DOOH, display, and native ads at scale — whether they start from ready-made templates or build from scratch. By delivering a robust, full-featured in-house solution, we reduce our clients' reliance on costly third-party creative providers and empower advertisers to move faster and more efficiently.

 The next chapter for the team centers on AI-powered content generation and a multi-channel creative experience, with particular focus on AI first video and CTV solutions. It's a high-impact, fast-moving area with significant room to define the product, the technology, and the creative workflows that will set the standard for how advertisers build at scale.

 As a Senior Product Manager on the Creatives team, you'll own a portfolio at the heart of this ambition. This is a 0→1 space that spans multiple teams and disciplines, and you'll set the direction for it: shaping strategy, making the hard calls, and shipping. You'll partner closely with Engineering, Design, Creative Studio, Data Science, and Revenue to translate a bold vision into products advertisers love.

 StackAdapt is a remote first company. This role is open to candidates in Canada and the United States. 

 What You'll Be Doing 

- Own the strategy, roadmap, and end-to-end delivery for a portfolio spanning the video/CTV creative builder, AI-generated and brand content products, and creative integrations with social and partner platforms.

- Demonstrated success leading 0→1 initiatives that span multiple teams — you bring structure and direction to new problem spaces and rally others around a clear plan.

- Experience building products in AdTech, MarTech, or creative platforms, with a meaningful edge for those who've worked on creative-building or generative AI products.

- Strong fluency with AI/ML and generative AI concepts — enough to partner deeply with Data Science and Engineering, reason about capabilities and limitations, and make informed product decisions.

- A technical background (Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent hands-on experience) that lets you discuss technical trade-offs, integrations, and architecture credibly with engineers.

- A keen design and creative sense, balanced with technical depth — you pair an eye for what "great" looks like with the ability to partner closely with engineering on how to build it.

- An excellent cross-functional collaborator who can tailor your approach across Engineering, Design, Creative Studio, Data Science, and Revenue without skipping a beat.

- Clear, structured writing and communication — you distill complex ideas into words that build consensus and align stakeholders around your vision.

- Strong prioritization instincts grounded in reason, clarity, and purpose — you focus the team on the most impactful work and the KPIs you're moving.

StackAdapt is the leading technology company that empowers marketers to reach, engage, and convert audiences with precision. The most forward-thinking marketers choose StackAdapt to orchestrate high-impact campaigns across programmatic advertising and marketing channels.

 We believe that providing objective data on the performance of media dollars creates more committed customers and a stronger concentration of media dollars on our platform. The ability to accurately attribute business outcomes to marketing efforts is the foundation for building that trust. 

 We are looking for a Staff Product Manager to focus on our Attribution stack, determining which ad exposures get credit for customer conversions. This is a foundational role and will deliver the building blocks upon which our reporting and measurement feature stacks are built. 

 This role will report to a Director of Product who also oversees the Reporting, Measurement, and Planning teams. They will work day-to-day with a dedicated team of engineers, designers, and QA.  

 StackAdapt is a Remote First company, we are open to candidates located anywhere in the US and Canada for this position. 

 What you'll be doing: 

- Drive the vision and own the roadmap for our Attribution stack, covering click and view-through attribution, vertical and channel specific attribution models such as CTV and ABM, and several customer-facing reporting and measurement features. 

- Work with our largest and most complex clients to understand their attribution needs and how they think about assigning marketing credit. 

- Drive alignment across the teams that contribute to StackAdapt's attribution story (Data & Analytics, Data Science, Revenue, Product Marketing, etc.) and contribute to internal/external enablement on existing and new attribution methodologies. 

- Responsible for delivery of product specs that capture user needs along with clear direction for the engineer, design, and QA team on how the feature should behave and what success looks like. 

- Success for this role is someone who can drive features through to completion, delivering high-quality results while dealing with ambiguity, and creating products that drive more customer engagement with the StackAdapt platform. 

 What you’ll bring to the table: 

- Strong understanding of attribution methodologies across the broader advertising and measurement industry, beyond individual ad platform reporting, including but not limited to MTA, MMM, incrementally lift studies, geo experiments, CTV attribution, ABM attribution, retail media measurement, and web analytics attribution.

- Demonstrated ownership of vision and roadmap end to end: shaping direction from ambiguous problems, aligning teams, and delivering measurable outcomes.

- High technical fluency: able to translate complex constraints (data pipelines, identity resolution, event-level attribution at scale) into clear product decisions, and explain attribution and measurement concepts to non-technical audiences.

- Bias for action grounded in data: you form hypotheses, ship experiments to test them, and iterate based on what the data says.

- Keen design sense; you’re able to look at a feature and understand it through a user’s eyes. 

- You’ve successfully incorporated LLM usage into your day-to-day to accelerate your work, and understand where these tools can help customers versus where more deterministic methods are appropriate.

greenhouse:varicent:5435569008.description:
At Varicent, we’re not just transforming the Sales Performance Management (SPM) market—we’re redefining how organizations achieve revenue success. Our cutting-edge SaaS solutions empower revenue leaders globally to design smarter go-to-market strategies, maximize seller performance, and unlock untapped potential. Varicent stands at the forefront of innovation, celebrated as a market leader in the  2025 Forrester Wave Report for SPM ,  2023 Ventana Research Revenue Performance Management (RPM) Value Index ,  Gartner Peer Insights ,  2024 Gartner SPM Market Guide , and  G2.  Our solutions are trusted by a diverse range of global industry leaders like T-Mobile, ServiceNow, Wawanesa Bank, Shaw Industries, Moody's, Stryker and hundreds more. Here’s why you’ll thrive at Varicent:

- Innovate with Purpose: Build impactful solutions for customers worldwide. 

- Join Excellence: Work in a diverse, collaborative, and innovative team. 

- Shape the Future: Lead in redefining revenue optimization. 

- Grow Together: Unlock your potential in a supportive environment. 

 Join us at Varicent—where your talent and ambition meet limitless opportunities for success!

 Summary of the Role and Team 

 As Director of Deal Desk & Pricing, you will lead and scale Varicent's Deal Desk function, serving as the central authority for deal governance, pricing operations, quote-to-booking processes, and commercial execution. You'll work closely with Sales, Customer Success, Renewals, Finance, Legal, Product, and Revenue Operations to drive pricing accuracy, data integrity, operational efficiency, and compliance throughout the customer lifecycle. This role combines strategic leadership with hands-on execution — you'll establish the processes, governance frameworks, systems alignment, and team structure that enable scalable growth. This is a people leadership role: you'll manage and grow Deal Desk professionals while improving deal velocity, profitability, forecasting accuracy, and operational excellence.

 What You Will Be Doing 

- Lead and develop the Deal Desk team, including coaching, performance management, capacity planning, and workload prioritization.

- Establish and run Deal Desk operating processes: deal intake, approvals, escalations, service-level expectations, and stakeholder communications.

- Own quote-to-booking governance for new business, renewals, expansions, and cross-sell opportunities, ensuring pricing accuracy and policy compliance.

- Work with Sales and Customer Success on deal structuring, pricing decisions, exception management, and commercial approvals.

- Maintain data integrity and system alignment across Salesforce, CPQ platforms, pricing tools, and related commercial systems.

- Partner with Finance on forecasting activities, revenue recognition requirements, commercial risk assessments, and audit readiness.

- Build and maintain governance frameworks, policies, documentation, and enablement resources that drive consistent business practices.

- Lead process improvement and change management initiatives to reduce deal cycle times and improve scalability and reporting quality.

 What You Bring 

- Demonstrated expertise in Deal Desk, Pricing, Revenue Operations, Commercial Operations, FP&A, Commercial Finance, or related business functions (typically gained over 10–12+ years)

- Experience leading teams, programs, or cross-functional operational functions (typically 5+ years)

- Experience with complex B2B sales motions, including new business, renewals, expansions, and cross-sell transactions

- Expertise in Deal Desk operations, pricing governance, quote-to-booking workflows, commercial approvals, and process design

- Experience working with Salesforce, DealHub CPQ, or comparable CPQ/CRM platforms

- Solid grasp of how pricing structures, commercial terms, ACV, and contract structures impact forecasting and revenue recognition

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a track record of using operational data to improve business processes and decisions

- Ability to influence senior stakeholders across Sales, Finance, Legal, Customer Success, Product, and Revenue Operations

 Success Outcomes 

 First 90 Days 

- Build a working understanding of Varicent's pricing structure, commercial processes, systems landscape, and quote-to-booking workflows.

- Establish strong relationships with Sales, Customer Success, Finance, Legal, Product, and Revenue Operations stakeholders.

- Assess current Deal Desk processes, governance controls, approval workflows, and reporting capabilities.

- Identify opportunities to improve deal execution efficiency, data quality, and process consistency.

 Within 6 Months

ashby:beaconsoftware:71965ed6-44a9-4d11-.description:
Beacon https://beaconsoftware.com/ is building the essential technology infrastructure for the everyday economy: the businesses, organizations, and services that make real life work, and that mainstream tech has largely left behind. We acquire, operate, and grow vertical market software companies — niche, founder-built businesses serving industries that are often overlooked and too profitable to ignore.

Our model is simple: we seek out founders who have built their business by spending years understanding their market and prioritizing their customers' specific needs. We buy great businesses, invest in their continued growth, and hold them permanently — accelerating that growth with an AI-native platform built specifically for vertical market software. No mandate to cut, flip, or roll up into something unrecognizable.

We are not a financial firm. We are technology entrepreneurs and operators who believe the most important businesses in the world are already running quietly in industries most people never think about. Our job is to find them, support the people who built them, and make them better.

Beacon is backed by a diverse base of investors, with $550M+ raised to date, including General Catalyst, Lightspeed, D1 Capital, CPMG, the family offices of the founders of Stripe, DoorDash, and Ramp, and evergreen funds built for the long game.

 

About the role

You'll join Beacon's Portfolio Product team — a cross-functional group of Product Managers, Engineers, Designers, GTM experts, and Data Scientists working directly with our 40+ portfolio companies and counting (at roughly one new acquisition per week) to drive measurable outcomes through AI and software.

 

At the core, every PM at Beacon owns product outcomes for 2 to 5 portfolio companies at a time, acting as a hands-on, founding product leader embedded in each business. You'll sit close to the GM, the operators, and the customers, figure out where the leverage is, and ship software directly into the business. The best PMs don't just deliver for the companies they're deployed at — they compress what they learn into reusable playbooks that spread to every other portfolio company in the same vertical. The ultimate objective is to transform our portfolio companies into unicorns!

 

For the right candidates, this role grows beyond individual ownership. As your vertical scales, you may build and lead a team of PMs, take on hiring and coaching responsibilities, and become the person who sets product vision and standards across an entire industry segment — partnering directly with GMs, founders & operators, and driving planning across the whole portfolio. How much of that path applies to you depends on your background and trajectory, and we'll shape the role around what you bring.

 

This is not a consulting role. We ship software, not slides. The deliverable is a running system.


Key Responsibilities

 - Own product outcomes for 2 to 5 portfolio companies simultaneously, acting as a fractional/founding product leader embedded in each business

 - Lead quarterly and annual planning, helping teams set product visions and translate them into achievable goals

 - Build and maintain roadmaps that balance customer needs, business goals, and technical constraints

 - Drive sprint planning and execution, improving team velocity and predictability over time

 - Develop prioritization frameworks that help CEOs and operators make better product decisions

 - Build customer feedback systems that turn qualitative inputs into actionable roadmap decisions

 - Coordinate feature launches across engineering, sales, marketing, and support

 - Coach developers, designers, and early PMs to think like product managers

 - Distill learnings into cross-portfolio playbooks that scale impact beyond your assigned companies

 - Partner with GMs, founders, and operators to set product vision and translate it into executable roadmaps

 - Contribute to Beacon's broader AI platform by surfacing patterns and opportunities from your companies

 

As your scope grows you may also:

 - Build and lead a team of PMs, hiring, onboarding, and developing them as your portfolio scales

 - Codify cross-portfolio playbooks that turn individual wins into repeatable systems across an entire vertical

 - Set the bar for how great product work looks at Beacon — spec quality, customer discovery, prioritization rigor

 - Own product strategy and outcomes across a defined vertical, not just individual companies

 

What We're Looking For

 - BA/BS degree; MBA a plus

 - 4+ years of product management experience, ideally in B2B SaaS (senior candidates typically bring 7+ years, including 2+ years in a formal leadership role or as a co-founder)

 - Strong fundamentals: roadmapping, sprint planning, spec writing, prioritization frameworks

 - Sharp customer discovery instincts and the ability to identify high-impact opportunities fast

 - Comfortable managing multiple companies and stakeholders simultaneously

 - Ability to influence founders and executives without direct authority

 - For more senior candidates: a proven track record leading and developing other PMs, not just doing great PM work individually

 - Strong systems thinking — you see patterns across companies and know how to turn them into playbooks

 - High autonomy, low ego. You figure things out and get them done

 - Entrepreneurial mindset and genuine comfort with ambiguity

This Role Is Perfect for You If...

 - You are an ex-founder, or have founding PM / early product hire experience at a high-growth startup

 - You want real ownership over how businesses (and, over time, entire industry verticals) get transformed through software and AI

 - You get satisfaction from shipping great product yourself — and, as you grow, from building capability in others

 - You are commercially-minded and curious about private equity, rollups, and how profitable businesses are built


Our Values at Beacon Software

 - Humility: We acknowledge that the path to getting to the right answer involves being wrong along the way. We have strong beliefs which are weakly held. We actively seek new ideas and believe we can learn from anyone at any time.

 - Honesty: We are truth seeking in our approach to business problems. Business is a repeat game and we believe that human relationships generate alpha. We understand that trust is earned over a lifetime and can be lost in an instant.

 - Hunger: We play to win. We hold ourselves to high standards and will not be outworked. We take pride in having a deep sense of responsibility to ourselves, each other, our partners, and our customers. We believe to whom much is given much is expected.

 - Horizon: We seek to build a generational software company. This will take decades. We manage our expectations and those of our partners to take advantage of the 8th wonder of the world - compounding growth.


How We Use AI in Our Hiring Process: To ensure transparency, we want candidates to know that Beacon Software uses Artificial Intelligence and AI-enabled tools to assist with screening, reviewing, organizing and highlighting profiles and applications that match the key requirements for each role.

 

AI does not make hiring decisions: Every application is reviewed by a member of our team, and all decisions throughout the process are made by humans. We use AI to support efficiency and consistency, not to replace human judgment. We are committed to a fair, thoughtful, and equitable experience for every candidate.

About the Role

We are seeking an exceptional Principal Product Manager to build the HTS API Marketplace — the commercial and developer-facing layer through which enterprise partners access Hopper's lodging and cars capabilities.

This is a true 0-to-1 role. You will be the person who defines what it is: how capabilities are packaged and priced, how partners discover and integrate them, and how the marketplace evolves as a platform business. The underlying technical capabilities — connectivity orchestration, pricing and sort, content mapping, the extranet — are owned by dedicated capability teams. Your job is to work closely with those PMs to understand, package, and commercially expose those capabilities as coherent, enterprise-grade API products.

We expect this PM to move fast and build scrappily. You should be comfortable using AI tools and vibe coding to prototype workflows, mock APIs, and test partner experiences before handing off to engineering. The best candidate will reach for a prototype before a PRD.

You will partner with Engineering, Data Science, Commercial, Finance, and Supply — and coordinate tightly with other PMs across the organization — to bring the marketplace from concept to a revenue-generating platform.



This is a fully remote role.




WHAT WOULD YOUR DAY-TO-DAY LOOK LIKE:

 - Define what the HTS API Marketplace is: how capabilities are structured, packaged, and priced across a portfolio spanning HTS Connect, Search Polygons, Autocomplete, Ranking, Content & Property Mapping, Room Mapping, Deduplication/Auction, Pricing, Extranet, Taxes, and Custom Deals Engine.

 - Coordinate with capability PMs — who own the underlying technical systems — to understand each capability's roadmap, constraints, and customization surface, and translate that into externally-consumable API products.

 - Own the commercial model for the marketplace: platform vs. variable fee decisions, take rate structure per capability, enterprise packaging, and the custom deals framework for large partners with differentiated customer segments.

 - Build the developer and partner experience from scratch: API specifications, partner onboarding flows, documentation standards, sandbox environments, and integration tooling that minimizes time-to-first-value.

 - Use AI tools and rapid prototyping to test ideas quickly — mock API responses, prototype partner portals, simulate pricing and ranking configurations — before committing engineering resources.

 - Establish the go-to-market motion for the marketplace: work with Commercial to identify the right partners for each capability, sequence launches, and define what a successful commercial rollout looks like.

 - Own the marketplace revenue P&L: model and track GBV, take rate, and per-capability unit economics in partnership with Finance.
   


AN IDEAL CANDIDATE HAS:

 - 7+ years of Product Management experience, with at least one 0-to-1 product you built from concept to commercial launch.

 - Demonstrated experience building developer-facing or B2B marketplace products, including ownership of API product design, developer experience, and commercial packaging for enterprise customers.

 - AI-native working style: you use LLMs and vibe coding as first-line tools for prototyping, not as novelties. You have built working demos, mockups, or proof-of-concepts using AI before handing work to engineering.

 - Strong understanding of marketplace economics: take rates, supply-side incentives, demand-side optimization, and the design of platform vs. variable commercial models.

 - Ability to coordinate effectively across multiple product teams — you can synthesize roadmaps, surface dependencies, and drive cross-team alignment without owning the underlying engineering.

 - Experience working with external enterprise partners: translating commercial needs into product requirements and managing partner expectations through multi-phase rollouts.

 - Strong fluency with SQL and large-scale transactional or operational datasets.

 - Exceptional written and verbal communication, including the ability to write crisp API and product documentation.

Bonus:

 - Experience in travel commerce (lodging, cars, flights) or adjacent industries such as fintech, ads, or marketplace infrastructure.

 - Background in connectivity, distribution, or supplier technology (GDS, channel managers, OTA APIs).

 - Prior experience in Engineering, Data Science, or a technical role.

 - Familiarity with auction or deduplication mechanics, dynamic pricing systems, or recommendation and ranking models.
   


PERKS & BENEFITS OF WORKING WITH US:

 - Well-funded and proven startup with large ambitions, competitive salary and upsides of pre-IPO equity packages.

 - Hopper covers 100% of the premiums for group insurance plan.

 - Hopper offers life, short term and long term disability coverage.

 - HSA that covers eligible medical and dental expenses.

 - All employees and dependents have access to Dialogue’s telemedicine services, anytime, anywhere.

 - All employees have access to an RRSP plan with automatic pre-tax withdrawals per pay.

 - Please ask us about our very generous parental leave, much above industry standards!.

 - Unlimited PTO.

 - Carrot Cash travel stipend.

 - Access to co-working space on demand through FlexDesk AND Work-from-home stipend.

 - Entrepreneurial culture where pushing limits and taking risks is everyday business.

 - Open communication with management and company leadership.

 - Small, dynamic teams = massive impact.



More about Hopper

At Hopper, we are on a mission to become the leading travel platform globally – powering Hopper’s mobile app, website and our B2B business, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions). By leveraging massive amounts of data and advanced machine learning algorithms, Hopper combines its world-class travel agency offering with proprietary fintech products to bring transparency, flexibility and savings to travelers globally. We have developed several unique fintech solutions that address everything from pricing volatility to trip disruptions – helping people travel better and save more on their trips.



The Hopper platform serves hundreds of millions of travelers globally and continues to capture market share around the world. he Hopper app has been downloaded over 120 million times and has become largely popular among younger travelers – with 70% of its users being Gen Z and millennials.



While everyone knows us as the Gen Z and Millennial travel app, Hopper has evolved to become much more than that. In recent years, we’ve grown into a travel fintech provider, commerce platform, and global travel agency that powers some of the world’s largest brands.



Through HTS, our B2B division, the company supercharges its partners’ direct channels by integrating our fintech products on their sites or powering end-to-end travel portals. Today, our partners include leading travel brands like Capital One, Nubank, Air Canada, and many more.

Here are just a few stats that demonstrate the company’s recent growth:



Billions of dollars worth of travel and travel fintech are sold through Hopper and HTS’ channels every year.



Our fintech products – including Cancel for Any Reason and Flight Disruption Assistance – have exceptionally strong CSAT because the terms are always clear, and customers receive instant, no-questions-asked resolutions.



Almost 30% of our app customers purchase at least one fintech product when making a booking; and consumers are 1.6x more likely to repurchase if they add fintech to their booking vs if they booked just travel.



Given the success of its fintech products, Hopper launched a B2B initiative, HTS (Hopper Technology Solutions), which represents more than 75% of the business.



Through HTS, any travel provider (airlines, hotels, banks, travel agencies, etc.) can integrate and seamlessly distribute Hopper’s fintech or travel inventory on their direct channels. As its first HTS partnership, the company partnered with Capital One to co-develop Capital One Travel, a new travel portal designed specifically for cardholders. Other HTS partners include Air Canada, Uber, CommBank, Nubank, Flair Airlines and many more.



Hopper has been named the #1 most innovative company in travel by Fast Company Hopper has been downloaded over 120 million times and continues to have millions of new installs each month. Hopper is now the #3 largest online travel agencies in North America and 70% of our app customers are Gen-Z and millennials travelers.



Hopper has raised over $750 million USD of private capital and is backed by some of the largest institutional investors and banks in the world. HTS is primed to continue its growth as the leading travel ecommerce provider in a $1 trillion online shopping category. The Hopper app and website will also continue to be the preferred travel provider for Gen Z and Millennials.

Come take off with us!

À propos du poste

HTS Assist est l'assistant d'intelligence artificielle agentique de Hopper pour le voyage, qui résout de vrais enjeux clients comme les changements de vol, les annulations, les remboursements et les réservations, par clavardage et par la voix, pour certaines des plus grandes marques et entreprises de voyage au monde. La voix pose ses propres défis produit, de la latence et de l'alternance de la parole jusqu'au moment de l'escalade vers un humain, et ce poste couvre les deux volets avec la même rigueur. 

À titre de directeur ou directrice principal(e) de produit, vous serez responsable de l'agent orienté client de bout en bout : les conversations, l'interface et l'expérience que nos partenaires offrent à des millions de voyageurs. Il s'agit d'un poste délibérément axé sur le design, où vous serez la personne qui tranche les décisions de design au quotidien, en façonnant directement les parcours et les interfaces en étroite collaboration avec les équipes de design de nos partenaires et notre designer interne.


À quoi ressemblerait votre quotidien

 - Être responsable de la feuille de route de l'agent conversationnel orienté client, tant par clavardage que par la voix, de la couverture des intentions et de la conception des conversations jusqu'aux interfaces que nos partenaires intègrent dans leurs applications et leurs sites web

 - Établir la norme produit pour la voix en particulier, en couvrant la latence, l'alternance de la parole, la gestion des interruptions, la localisation, la voix en temps réel et la qualité de la reconnaissance et de la synthèse vocale, puisque la tolérance d'une personne au téléphone envers une mauvaise expérience est plus faible que celle d'une personne qui clavarde

 - Mobiliser les partenaires d'entreprise à travers la découverte, la définition des exigences et les décisions de lancement, en traduisant leurs besoins en choix de produit qui permettent à un seul produit de servir plusieurs partenaires

 - Collaborer avec l'équipe Solutions partenaires sur la mise en œuvre et l'intégration

 - Piloter le design au quotidien, en travaillant directement dans Figma pour produire des parcours et des maquettes, et collaborer avec l'équipe de design sur les livrables haute fidélité et de production

 - Construire des prototypes fonctionnels à l'aide d'outils de codage par IA lorsque cela est plus efficace qu'une spécification écrite, afin de tester des parcours de conversation et des concepts d'interface

 - Définir et défendre les seuils de qualité avec l'équipe d'évaluation, en couvrant le taux de résolution, le taux de confinement, la justesse des escalades et la qualité des conversations

 - Spécifier en détail le comportement de l'agent, y compris la résolution, le ton, la politique d'escalade, les garde-fous et les cas limites, et itérer à partir des données de conversations réelles

 - Rester proche des équipes GTM, Solutions partenaires et Succès client, afin de faire remonter les apprentissages du terrain vers la feuille de route

Le ou la candidat(e) idéal(e) possède

 - 8 ans ou plus d'expérience en gestion de produit, incluant une responsabilité de niveau principal ou de direction sur un produit orienté client, avec une expérience directe du lancement de produits conversationnels vocaux tels que les systèmes IVR, les robots vocaux ou l'automatisation vocale de centres de contact

 - Une responsabilité directe d'un produit vocal en production, pas seulement d'un produit conversationnel par clavardage ou par texte, avec une bonne connaissance des compromis liés à la reconnaissance et à la synthèse vocale, des seuils de latence et de la gestion de l'alternance de la parole ou des interruptions. Il s'agit d'une compétence exigée

 - Une aisance en design, à l'aise de manipuler des fichiers de design et de produire seul(e) des parcours et des maquettes de base dans Figma, ayant déjà agi comme responsable de design de facto au sein d'une petite équipe

 - La capacité d'écrire suffisamment de code pour faire fonctionner un prototype sans attendre un ingénieur ou une ingénieure, en intégrant les outils d'IA comme partie normale de sa façon de construire

 - Une expérience concrète en développement front-end, ayant déjà bâti ou lancé des interfaces web et étant capable d'échanger de façon crédible avec des ingénieurs

 - Une solide expérience auprès de clients d'entreprise, idéalement dans des industries réglementées, à façonner les exigences et les décisions de lancement au niveau du produit

 - Une approche axée sur les données, ancrée dans les mesures de service à la clientèle et d'automatisation, incluant la résolution, le confinement, la satisfaction client et la qualité des escalades

 - Une bonne connaissance pratique des produits basés sur les grands modèles de langage, incluant la conception des invites et des comportements, les pratiques de qualité en IA et leurs modes d'échec

What would your day-to-day look like

ashby:wealthsimple:87df1a4c-b9b9-4080-b1.description:
BUILD SOMETHING PEOPLE LOVE

Wealthsimple is Canada’s leading financial innovator. The company offers a full suite of simple, sophisticated financial products across managed investing, do-it-yourself trading, cryptocurrency, tax filing, spending and saving. Wealthsimple currently serves more than 4 million Canadians and holds over $155 billion in assets under administration. The company was founded in 2014 by a team of financial experts and technology entrepreneurs, and is headquartered in Toronto, Canada.



We're proud of what we've built — and we're just getting started. Read our Culture Manual https://www.wealthsimple.com/en-ca/culture and learn more about how we work https://www.wealthsimple.com/en-ca/careers.




ABOUT THE TEAM

The Financial Risk team is responsible for protecting Wealthsimple and its clients from fraud while enabling safe, fast, and scalable money movement. We own the Decision Platform — a real-time rules engine that processes streaming data to make fraud decisions across every major payment rail — as well as the tooling and automations that power fraud investigation workflows, transaction decisioning, account restrictions, and deposit holds. Our systems are the infrastructure layer that payment and money movement teams plug into to move money safely.




ABOUT THE ROLE

This is a platform PM role with a dual mandate: prevent fraud by building and tuning real-time interventions and decision rules, and enable fraud investigations by building automations and tooling that make our fraud operations team faster and more effective. You'll own a broad surface area — from the streaming decision engine that blocks fraudulent withdrawals in milliseconds, to the case management system that routes alerts to investigators, to the restriction and suspension frameworks that protect compromised accounts.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the product vision and strategy for the Financial Risk platform, balancing fraud prevention with client experience - every intervention has a cost, and you'll need to make sharp tradeoffs between friction and protection.

 - Drive the roadmap for the Decision Platform, our real-time rules engine that evaluates fraud risk across withdrawals, deposits, e-transfers, crypto transactions, and cheque deposits.

 - Build and improve fraud investigation tooling and automations - including case management workflows, alert deduplication, and enrichment pipelines - that help our fraud operations team investigate and resolve cases faster.

 - Define and evolve the restriction and mitigation framework that enables the right response to fraud signals: suspensions, withdrawal blocks, spend switch blocks, and account-level restrictions.

 - Operate as a platform PM, designing extensible APIs, decision schemas, and integration patterns that payment and money movement teams can reliably plug into as new products and payment rails launch.

 - Partner deeply with Fraud and Data Science teams on fraud model integration, fraud rule development, and the feedback loops that improve detection accuracy over time.

 - Own key risk metrics - fraud loss rates, false positive rates, investigation cycle times, decision latency - and use data to drive prioritization.

 - Break down complex, behind-the-scenes infrastructure projects into discrete phases that deliver value incrementally - this is platform work where the "client" is often another engineering team.
   
   


SKILLS YOU BRING

 - 6-8+ years of product management experience with significant depth in fraud, risk, or trust & safety - you've built fraud prevention systems, investigation tooling, or risk decisioning platforms and understand the cat-and-mouse dynamics of financial fraud.

 - Experience operating as a platform PM: you've built systems that other teams consume, and you know how to balance internal developer experience with business outcomes. You think in APIs, schemas, and extensibility.

 - Strong technical fluency: you can go deep on streaming architectures, workflow orchestration, and ML model integration. You don't need to write code, but you need to reason about system design tradeoffs with engineering.

 - Comfort with breadth: this role spans real-time decisioning, investigation tooling, restrictions infrastructure, and regulatory reporting. You thrive when context-switching across a wide problem space, not when going narrow.

 - Data-driven decision making: you use quantitative analysis to identify fraud patterns, measure intervention effectiveness, and prioritize investments.

 - Experience working with fraud operations teams: you understand investigation workflows, alert triage, case management, and the tooling that makes analysts productive. You've closed the loop between detection and investigation.

 - A shipping mentality: we don't believe in spending forever analyzing and debating. The best way to validate a fraud rule is to ship it, monitor it, and iterate.

 - Strong communication skills: you can translate complex risk and platform concepts for engineering, operations, compliance, and executive stakeholders.

 - Ability to work independently: biasing towards action to drive projects forward across a broad surface area.




WHY WEALTHSIMPLE?

🌸 Top-tier health benefits and life insurance

📈 Long-term group savings with employer match, through Wealthsimple for Business

🌴 20 vacation days, 4 wellness days, and unlimited sick and mental health days per year*

✈️ 90 days away: work outside Canada for up to 90 days per year*

👥 Employee resource groups, including Rainbow (2SLGBTQ), Women of WS, and Black at WS

🌎 We are a hybrid team with over 1,500 employees across North America. The people are one of the best parts of working here: you'll collaborate with incredibly talented, curious, and driven teammates who are deeply committed to doing great work.

*Unlimited paid sick days, Wellness Days and the 90 day away program do not apply to certain roles. 




ICYMI

Technology & Innovation at Wealthsimple: We move quickly and build thoughtfully. That means we're always looking for better ways to work — whether that's new tools, AI, or rethinking how we approach a problem. We don't expect you to have all the answers, but we do expect curiosity and a willingness to evolve alongside the products we're building.



Inclusion Statement: We're building products for a diverse world, and we need a diverse team to do it well. We strongly encourage applications from everyone, regardless of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability status.



Accessibility Statement: We're committed to an accessible hiring experience. If you need any accommodations throughout the interview process, please let us know — we'll work with you to make sure you have what you need. We also welcome any feedback on how we can better accommodate candidates with accessibility needs.



AI in Hiring: We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of our hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our team but don't replace human judgment – all final hiring decisions are made by people. If you have questions about how your data is used, reach out to us.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re looking for a Staff Product Manager to own Wealthsimple’s Connectivity Platform, spanning two critical areas:

 - Brokerage & Bank Linking: How clients securely and reliably connect external financial institutions to Wealthsimple.

 - Public API: How clients and partners securely access and use Wealthsimple financial data outside of Wealthsimple.



Together, these capabilities define how Wealthsimple connects to the broader financial ecosystem, and how every product team inside Wealthsimple builds on the external financial data that flows through it. This role will set the strategy for that platform and turn it into a reliable, scalable and differentiated capability for our clients, our product teams and our partners.



This is a platform role with a meaningful client experience surface. You’ll need to be equally comfortable thinking about APIs, data models and platform architecture as you are designing a client UX or deciding how Wealthsimple should work with an external provider.




ABOUT THE TEAM

The Brokerage & Bank Linking team builds the technology that lets clients link their outside bank and brokerage accounts to Wealthsimple. It owns the automated and manual linking experiences end to end, along with the three connectors behind them: Plaid, Flinks, and WST, our own in-house connector. That makes it one of the highest leverage surfaces in the company, and powers a growing set of experiences built by other product teams.




WHAT YOU’LL OWN

Connectivity Strategy

 - Set the long term vision and strategy for how Wealthsimple connects with the broader financial ecosystem.

 - Define the capabilities we should build ourselves, where we should rely on partners, and where we can create differentiated client value.

 - Develop a roadmap that balances immediate product needs with investments in reusable platform capabilities.

Brokerage & Bank Linking

 - Own the end to end experience for connecting external bank and brokerage accounts to Wealthsimple — automated and manual, including how clients recover when an automated connection fails.

 - Improve connection success, reliability and coverage across institutions, and own the routing strategy that decides which connector handles which institution and flow.

 - Own the client experience, including institution selection, authentication, errors, recovery and connection management.

 - Drive reliability and AI Powered  self-healing so connections detect and recover from failure without manual intervention.

 - Balance conversion against fraud exposure and operational load, making those tradeoffs deliberately with our risk and operations partners.

 - Develop the platform capabilities that allow Wealthsimple products to consume external financial data consistently.

 - Own relationships and product integrations with connectivity vendors such as Plaid and Flinks, and decide where our own connector should lead — including how much of the connector business Wealthsimple should be in long term and where it makes more sense to partner.

Public API

 - Own the strategy and roadmap for Wealthsimple’s Public API and external data connectivity.

 - Make it safe and easy for clients to permission their Wealthsimple financial data to the products and services they choose.

 - Define the platform capabilities required for authentication, consent, permissions, data access and partner integrations.

 - Identify and prioritize the partners and use cases that matter most to Wealthsimple clients.

 - Build toward a world where Wealthsimple is the financial institution where clients have the most control over their financial data.

 - Accelerate wealthsimple and our industry toward open banking.




SKILLS YOU BRING

You’re a strong product thinker who can operate across platform infrastructure, external ecosystems and client experience. You likely have:

 - Experience owning a platform, API, developer product or integrations platform, with a track record on metric-attached outcomes like conversion, success rate or reliability — not only feature delivery.

 - Enough technical depth to work closely with engineers on APIs, authentication, data models, routing and platform architecture.

 - Experience delivering through external vendors or partners whose roadmaps you don’t control, including making thoughtful build versus buy decisions and holding vendors accountable for product outcomes.

 - Comfort treating reliability as product work — error taxonomies, failure recovery, observability, and the operational load a product creates.

 - Experience weighing growth against fraud, risk and compliance, and holding both sides of that tradeoff.

 - The ability to turn a collection of technical capabilities into a clear product strategy and compelling long term vision, and to make the case for investing in it.

 - Strong analytical instincts and comfort using data to understand reliability, conversion, coverage and product performance, including building the measurement where it doesn’t exist yet.

 - Excellent cross functional leadership across Engineering, Design, Security, Legal, Compliance, Operations and external partners.

 - A bias toward simplifying complicated systems rather than layering more complexity on top of them.




NICE TO HAVES

 - Experience with open banking, Canada’s consumer-driven banking framework, or building to a data sharing standard

 - A background in financial data aggregation, whether at an aggregator, a bank, or a fintech consuming one

 - Experience shipping a public API or developer platform as a commercial product, including partner onboarding and support




WHAT GREAT LOOKS LIKE

You won’t just operate Bank Linking and ship API endpoints.



You’ll create a coherent connectivity strategy for Wealthsimple: making it easier for clients to bring their financial life to Wealthsimple, easier to move their financial data where they want it to go, easier for any team at Wealthsimple to build on that data, and increasingly less dependent on the slow pace of connectivity innovation from incumbent financial institutions.
