ABOUT THE TEAM

Our team, Consolidation, owns the first mile of the Wealthsimple relationship: onboarding, the homescreen + first layer of the app, and our Tiers program (Premium and Generation). Our job is to get new clients in the door, funded, and consolidating more of their financial life with Wealthsimple.



Our fastest-growing segment this year were high-net-worth clients. We're seeing real organic pull, and continuing to grow net deposits at the rate we have means winning larger, more complex relationships. Clients who today are typically served by private bankers and expect a level of service, product depth, and recognition that we need to meet and then beat.



That's the mandate for this role: continue to expand Wealthsimple’s growth upmarket. It means evolving our Tiers program into something a high-net-worth client would choose over their bank, and it means using what we know about a client to make a sharper, more personal case for bringing the rest of their financial life here. Convincing millions of Canadians to consolidate their financial lives at Wealthsimple is the mission we've been on for over 10 years, and we're looking for someone who can lead the next phase of this work and own it end to end.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Help define the product vision and strategy for how Wealthsimple wins and serves high-net-worth clients, and own the roadmap to bring it to life.

 - Lead the planning, development, launch, and iteration of a step change in our Tiers program. The service, product depth, and recognition that makes a client choose us as their primary financial institution.

 - Build the personalized experiences that compel clients to consolidate: understanding a client's current financial life and making the case, in-product, for moving it to Wealthsimple.

 - Working across the funding and consolidation funnel end to end, from a client's first session through to a fully consolidated relationship. Crafting the right incentives, onboarding journey, and product experiences along the way.

 - Support a cross-functional team of engineers, designers, and data scientists as we collectively explore new ways of working.

 - Partner deeply with other product teams and departments across the company (e.g. Marketing, Operations, Client Experience, Legal and Compliance, and more). You'll own a meaningful piece of this directly and influence a much larger piece through others.

 - A bias to ship. We don't do endless debate. The fastest way to know if something works is to put it in front of clients — so we ship, learn, and iterate.

 - Enough technical fluency to keep up with engineers — you can talk architecture and tradeoffs, and you're hungry to learn what you don't know yet so you can make better calls.

 - A real belief in financial inclusion — you want to build things that give more people access to financial freedom, not fewer.

 - Bonus: Experience building, shipping, iterating and growing products from 0 to 1 over multiple years. We know building new client experiences that client love will require a sustained multi-year effort.

 - A strong technical partner. You work hand-in-hand with engineering to turn a logical design into a real technical architecture.

 - Comfortable in the grey. You can take raw, messy data (qualitative or quantitative) and pull out the actual problem, the real insight, the requirement that matters.

ashby:koho:3e565168-cacd-40c6-a912-04e62.description:
ABOUT KOHO

We’re on a mission to make financial services better for every Canadian. That means no hidden fees, no predatory interest rates - just financial products designed to help our users spend smart, save more, and build real wealth. We’re a performance organization with a strong heart: we care deeply about outcomes, and everything ties back to our mission - to financially empower a generation of Canadians.

At KOHO, we’re not your average 9-5. We believe real impact comes from people who are trusted, empowered, and supported to do their best work - without sacrificing their lives to do it. We prioritize work-life integration, not just work-life balance. That means asynchronous collaboration, flexible hours, and a remote-first setup built around autonomy and high trust.

KOHO is entering its next chapter - leaner, smarter, more AI-integrated. We’re building for impact, not bureaucracy. If you thrive in environments that value clarity, ownership, and bold thinking, you’ll fit right in.



About The Role

We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to join KOHO’s Growth team. You’ll lead a dedicated growth pod focused on one of our highest-leverage problems: either converting more registered users into active customers, or building product-led channels that acquire users through the product itself.



This is a metrics-driven role with clear ownership and real P&L impact. You’ll run experiments at high velocity, own a specific set of growth KPIs, and work within a cross-functional pod (engineering, design, data) to move them. You won’t be maintaining a feature backlog — you’ll be solving growth problems end-to-end.



What You’ll Be Doing

 - Own growth metrics with clear accountability. You’ll be responsible for specific KPIs tied to user acquisition or activation — metrics that directly impact KOHO’s revenue and unit economics.

 - Run experiments at high velocity. Design, ship, and iterate on growth initiatives weekly. Maintain a rolling experiment backlog with clear hypotheses and success criteria. Learn fast from failures.

 - Build business cases grounded in data. Use quantitative analysis, financial modeling, and CAC/LTV economics to prioritize bets and defend investment decisions to leadership.

 - Lead a cross-functional pod. Work with engineering, design, data, and marketing to ship growth initiatives. Align your team around a single mission and keep execution tight.

 - Identify and reduce friction across the user journey. Whether it’s funnel drop-offs, onboarding bottlenecks, or underperforming growth channels — diagnose root causes and ship solutions.

 - Design and scale growth loops. Think beyond linear funnels. Identify opportunities for compounding, product-led mechanics that reduce acquisition costs over time.

 - Collaborate across the growth org. Work closely with the other growth pod to ensure the full user journey — from first touch to active customer — works as a connected system.

 - Communicate strategy to leadership. Present growth strategy, experiment results, and roadmap decisions to executive audiences through quarterly strategy reviews.



Who You Are

 - 3–5+ years of product management experience, with at least 2 years focused on growth, activation, acquisition, or product-led growth at a consumer or fintech company.

 - Track record of moving growth metrics — whether that’s conversion funnels, referral programs, onboarding flows, or acquisition loops. We want to see specific numbers you’ve moved.

 - Deeply data-driven. You can write SQL when needed, design experiments with statistical rigor, and make decisions based on CAC/LTV modeling rather than intuition.

 - High experiment velocity. You’re comfortable shipping multiple experiments per sprint, learning quickly from failures, and iterating without over-engineering.

 - Cross-functional leader. You’ve led pods or squads (engineering, design, marketing, data) and know how to align a team around a single metric.

 - Strong strategic communicator. You can articulate growth strategy to executives, write compelling business cases, and translate data into narratives that drive alignment.

 - AI-native. You actively use AI tools (Claude, ChatGPT, Perplexity, etc.) in your daily work — for analysis, writing, research, and prototyping.



Nice to Have

 - Experience at a Canadian fintech or a regulated financial services company.

 - Familiarity with product analytics, martech, and BI tools — our core product and growth stack.

 - Experience with A/B testing platforms (Eppo, Optimizely, or similar) and experiment governance.

 - Background in behavioural economics, incentive design, or conversion optimization.

 - Experience with fintech onboarding and KYC optimization — reducing friction in regulated sign-up flows.

 - Experience building product-led acquisition at scale.



The budgeted salary range for this role is $160,000 - $200,000 CAD / year.

At KOHO, we are dedicated to providing pay transparency to all candidates. Compensation at KOHO is determined through various factors including but not limited to: comparable salary market data within Canada, technical skill assessment, a holistic view of previous work history, and internal pay equity with other KOHO team members.




DESCRIPTION DE POSTE EN FRANÇAIS




À PROPOS DU POSTE

Nous sommes à la recherche d’un(e) gestionnaire de produits principal(e) pour se joindre à l’équipe Croissance de KOHO. Vous dirigerez une cellule de croissance dédiée à l’un de nos enjeux à plus fort effet de levier : soit convertir davantage d’utilisateurs inscrits en clients actifs, soit bâtir des canaux axés sur le produit qui permettent d’acquérir des utilisateurs par l’entremise du produit lui-même.

Il s’agit d’un poste axé sur les indicateurs, assorti de responsabilités claires et d’une incidence réelle sur les résultats financiers. Vous mènerez des expérimentations à un rythme soutenu, serez responsable d’un ensemble précis d’indicateurs clés de croissance et travaillerez au sein d’une cellule interfonctionnelle (ingénierie, design, données) pour les faire progresser. Vous ne gérerez pas un carnet de fonctionnalités : vous résoudrez des problèmes de croissance de bout en bout.




CE QUE VOUS FEREZ

 - Prendre en charge des indicateurs de croissance avec une responsabilité claire. Vous serez responsable d’indicateurs clés de performance précis liés à l’acquisition ou à l’activation des utilisateurs, des indicateurs qui ont une incidence directe sur les revenus et l’économie unitaire de KOHO.

 - Mener des expérimentations à un rythme soutenu. Concevoir, lancer et itérer des initiatives de croissance chaque semaine. Tenir à jour un carnet d’expérimentations continu, assorti d’hypothèses et de critères de réussite clairs. Tirer rapidement des leçons des échecs.

 - Élaborer des analyses de rentabilité fondées sur les données. Utiliser l’analyse quantitative, la modélisation financière et l’économie CAC/VVC (coût d’acquisition client et valeur vie client) pour prioriser les paris et défendre les décisions d’investissement auprès de la direction.

 - Diriger une cellule interfonctionnelle. Travailler avec les équipes d’ingénierie, de design, de données et de marketing pour lancer des initiatives de croissance. Rallier votre équipe autour d’une mission unique et assurer une exécution rigoureuse.

 - Cerner et réduire les points de friction tout au long du parcours utilisateur. Qu’il s’agisse d’abandons dans l’entonnoir, de goulots d’étranglement à l’intégration ou de canaux de croissance peu performants, diagnostiquer les causes profondes et mettre en œuvre des solutions.

 - Concevoir et déployer à grande échelle des boucles de croissance. Penser au-delà des entonnoirs linéaires. Repérer les occasions de mécanismes cumulatifs axés sur le produit qui réduisent les coûts d’acquisition au fil du temps.

 - Collaborer avec l’ensemble de l’organisation Croissance. Travailler en étroite collaboration avec l’autre cellule de croissance afin que l’ensemble du parcours utilisateur, du premier contact jusqu’au client actif, fonctionne comme un système intégré.

 - Communiquer la stratégie à la direction. Présenter la stratégie de croissance, les résultats des expérimentations et les décisions relatives à la feuille de route aux membres de la haute direction dans le cadre de revues stratégiques trimestrielles.




VOTRE PROFIL

 - De 3 à 5 ans ou plus d’expérience en gestion de produits, dont au moins 2 ans axés sur la croissance, l’activation, l’acquisition ou la croissance axée sur le produit au sein d’une entreprise grand public ou de technologie financière (fintech).

 - Feuille de route démontrée en matière d’amélioration des indicateurs de croissance, qu’il s’agisse d’entonnoirs de conversion, de programmes de recommandation, de parcours d’intégration ou de boucles d’acquisition. Nous voulons connaître les chiffres précis que vous avez fait progresser.

 - Approche résolument axée sur les données. Vous savez écrire des requêtes SQL au besoin, concevoir des expérimentations avec rigueur statistique et prendre des décisions fondées sur la modélisation CAC/VVC plutôt que sur l’intuition.

 - Rythme d’expérimentation élevé. Vous êtes à l’aise de lancer plusieurs expérimentations par sprint, de tirer rapidement des leçons des échecs et d’itérer sans complexifier inutilement.

 - Leader interfonctionnel(le). Vous avez dirigé des cellules ou des équipes (ingénierie, design, marketing, données) et savez rallier une équipe autour d’un indicateur unique.

 - Communicateur(trice) stratégique hors pair. Vous savez exposer une stratégie de croissance à la haute direction, rédiger des analyses de rentabilité convaincantes et traduire les données en récits qui favorisent l’adhésion.

 - Adepte de l’IA. Vous utilisez activement des outils d’IA (Claude, ChatGPT, Perplexity, etc.) dans votre travail quotidien, que ce soit pour l’analyse, la rédaction, la recherche ou le prototypage.




ATOUTS

 - Expérience au sein d’une entreprise canadienne de technologie financière ou d’une société de services financiers réglementée.

 - Connaissance des outils d’analyse de produits, de technologie marketing (martech) et d’informatique décisionnelle (BI), qui forment le cœur de notre pile technologique produit et croissance.

 - Expérience des plateformes de tests A/B (Eppo, Optimizely ou autres) et de la gouvernance des expérimentations.

 - Formation en économie comportementale, en conception de mesures incitatives ou en optimisation de la conversion.

 - Expérience de l’intégration des clients en technologie financière et de l’optimisation des processus de vérification d’identité (KYC), afin de réduire la friction dans les parcours d’inscription réglementés.

 - Expérience dans la mise en place d’une acquisition axée sur le produit à grande échelle.
   
   


RÉMUNÉRATION

L’échelle salariale prévue pour ce poste se situe entre 160 000 $ et 200 000 $ CA par année.

Chez KOHO, nous nous engageons à offrir une transparence salariale à tous les candidats. La rémunération est déterminée en fonction de plusieurs facteurs, notamment les données comparatives du marché canadien, l’évaluation des compétences techniques, l’expérience professionnelle globale du candidat ainsi que l’équité salariale interne au sein de l’équipe KOHO.

KOHO is for builders.



If you’re energized by challenge, motivated by mission, and want to be part of a team that punches above its weight - we want to hear from you.

 

The KOHO culture is one of collaboration, creativity, and diverse perspectives. We are committed to building and fostering an inclusive, accessible environment for everyone. If you have any questions, concerns, or requests regarding accessibility needs, please contact peopleaccessibility@koho.ca and the People and Culture team will be happy to help.

ashby:float:66203868-beba-4833-8831-aa62.description:
This posting reflects a current, actively recruited opening at Float. All applications are being reviewed on a rolling basis.



ABOUT FLOAT

Float is on a mission to simplify finance for Canadian businesses, empowering them to eliminate complexity and unlock new opportunities. Through our innovative platform, Float enables businesses to streamline financial operations and optimize cash flow, so they can focus on what matters most: growth. 

 

As one of Canada’s fastest growing companies https://www.theglobeandmail.com/business/rob-magazine/top-growing-companies/article-ranking-canadas-top-growing-companies-of-2024/ and top-rated startups in 2025 https://www.linkedin.com/posts/floatfinancial_were-proud-to-share-that-float-has-been-activity-7387093684720300032-2DDz/, 2024 https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/linkedin-top-startups-2024-15-canadian-companies-rise-linkedin-news-llihe/ and 2023 https://lnkd.in/TSU23CA, Float is customer-obsessed, passionate and entrepreneurial, with a team that includes leaders from Uber, Stripe, Shopify, Top Hat, Ada, Doordash, Snowflake, and Wealthsimple.

 

At Float, everyone is an owner, bringing their unique perspective to our team and product. Your voice is important, and we take having a culture based on feedback seriously. We openly share our thoughts and differing opinions so we can continue to improve. We do our best to keep our decision-making decentralized so that all team members feel ownership in our success.

 


OUR PRODUCT

Float is Canada’s intelligent financial operating system, combining modern financial services and software to help businesses spend, save, and grow. Trusted by more than 10,000 Canadian companies, Float provides high-limit corporate cards, automated expense management, next-day bill payments, high-yield accounts, and industry-leading support, all built in Canada, for Canada. Float recently announced our $85 million Series C https://floatfinancial.com/press/float-financial-raises-cad-85-million-series-c, and is backed by world-class investors, including Inovia Capital, Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives, OMERS Ventures, and Silicon Valley Bank.

 

Our team is a collection of ambitious, collaborative and mission-driven people from all walks of life but with one goal: helping Canadian companies not just survive but thrive. And we’re looking for bold innovators to help shape the future of business finance in Canada.




AI USE IN OUR HIRING PROCESS

We use technology, including artificial intelligence (AI), to support parts of our hiring process. This may include AI-assisted scheduling and candidate communications, and AI-generated interview notes, guides or summaries to help our team focus on the conversation. All hiring decisions are made by our hiring team.




ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re hiring a Head of Product Marketing to lead the function responsible for helping customers understand, adopt, and get more value from Float’s growing multi-product platform across the full customer journey. You’ll report to the SVP GTM Strategy & Marketing and lead a team spanning product marketing, lifecycle marketing, and customer marketing, with a mandate that spans acquisition, launch support, product adoption and usage.



This is a high-impact role at the core of the business. It offers the opportunity to refine Float’s product narrative, strengthen adoption across the customer lifecycle, and enable Product, Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing to more effectively communicate and deliver the platform’s value.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Refine Float’s positioning and messaging so the multi-product platform story lands clearly across target audiences and ongoing launches.

 - Build pre- and post-sale programs that improve product adoption and help customers realize more value across the customer journey.

 - Partner with Product on launches, readiness, and activation so new products and features translate into customer understanding and usage.

 - Equip Sales, Customer Success, and Marketing with messaging, playbooks, collateral, and activation tools that improve field effectiveness and adoption outcomes.

 - Build customer programs such as advocacy and advisory motions that strengthen product adoption and the broader commercial flywheel.

 - Use data, experimentation, and customer insight to evolve positioning, lifecycle strategy, and adoption programs over time.

 - Lead and develop a high-performing team with high standards for ownership, clarity, speed, and modern AI-enabled workflows.




ABOUT YOU


HERE’S WHAT SETS YOU UP FOR SUCCESS AT FLOAT: 

 - You Put Customers First, Always. You anchor strategy in real customer pain, understanding, and value realization. You care about whether customers actually adopt and use what the business builds.

 - You Act Like an Owner. You are comfortable owning outcomes, not just functions. You make hard prioritization calls, move quickly in ambiguity, and do what is best for the business.

 - You Think Big and Move Fast. You can shape the longer-term product narrative while still building the systems, playbooks, and programs that move adoption now.

 - You Constantly Learn and Grow. You are a strong market sensor who updates positioning, messaging, and strategy as evidence changes. You are practical and curious about how AI can improve leverage and quality in your work.

 - You Raise the Bar. You hold a high quality threshold for strategy, execution, and talent. You do not settle for polished activity that does not move the business.

 - You Win as a Team. You build trust and clarity across Product, Sales, CS, and Marketing. You can influence without authority and make cross-functional work better, not heavier.




IN ADDITION TO LIVING OUR VALUES...

 - 8+ years of relevant experience across product marketing, customer marketing, lifecycle, enablement, monetization, or adjacent growth work in B2B SaaS, fintech, or transaction-based businesses, with meaningful leadership scope.

 - Direct ownership of measurable outcomes such as acquisition, adoption, expansion, retention, competitive performance, enablement uptake, or other commercial metrics.

 - Strong product marketing craft across positioning, messaging, launches, enablement, and customer / field activation, with evidence that your work changed behavior or results.

 - Experience building systems, not just campaigns including pre-sale and post-sale motions that helped internal teams and customers understand what to do next.

 - Data fluency and experimentation discipline with comfort using analytics, research, and operating judgment to refine strategy over time.

 - Practical AI workflow integration with examples of using AI to accelerate research, synthesis, experimentation, or content iteration while keeping judgment human-led.

 - Leadership and cross-functional credibility with a track record of coaching teams, aligning stakeholders, and raising the quality bar around you.




THIS MAY NOT BE THE ROLE FOR YOU IF:

 - You have strong launch or PMM experience but little direct accountability for acquisition, adoption, expansion, retention, or other measurable business outcomes.

 - You prefer well-established playbooks and stable scope over ambiguity, experimentation, and building new systems from scratch.

 - You are highly strategic but do not enjoy driving execution details, enablement, or cross-functional follow-through.

 - You struggle with direct feedback, healthy conflict, or high-ownership team environments.

 - You are not data-fluent or do not use evidence to sharpen priorities and programs over time.

 - You treat AI as optional, superficial, or someone else’s job rather than a meaningful source of leverage in modern GTM work.




OUR HIRING PHILOSOPHY

We hire for character, curiosity, and learning velocity before credentials. Titles matter less than impact, and every hire is expected to raise the bar for Float as a whole.




WHY YOU SHOULD JOIN

 - Work at one of Canada's fastest-growing fintech companies

 - Make a real impact in a high-autonomy, high-growth role

 - Collaborate with an ambitious and supportive team

 - Competitive compensation, equity options, and benefits

 - Hybrid work model – we are based in Toronto with in-office days for connection and collaboration

 - Enjoy catered team lunches every Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday

 - Bring your pup to our dog-friendly office

 - Thrive in a high-trust, high-performance culture where your work truly matters

 


IN SHORT

At Float, you’ll thrive if you’re bold, curious, and eager to make a real impact. We're building something special—and having a lot of fun along the way. If you’re excited to build, grow, and win together, we’d love to meet you.

 

We’re committed to building a workplace that’s welcoming and accessible for everyone. If you need any accommodations during the hiring process or once you join Float, just let us know! You can reach out to Vic https://www.linkedin.com/in/victoria-boult-b21b2053/ (victoria@floatfinancial.com), and we’ll work with you to make sure you have what you need to succeed.

ABOUT THE ROLE

Float is building the future of Canadian financial services — scaling a credit business powered by modern, innovative underwriting and monitoring infrastructure that will unlock new digital-first credit and financial products for Canadian businesses. Fraud detection, AML compliance, payments operations, and dispute resolution already run on this decisioning backbone today. What’s missing is a single owner. 



As the founding Product Manager for Credit & Risk Engineering, you’ll turn this shared decisioning and monitoring layer into a truly owned product: fast, accurate, and relentlessly efficient as volume scales. You’ll sit at the intersection of Float’s credit roadmap and growth funnel, sequencing a small engineering team across real infrastructure debt and a flagship new build — the FlexLine decisioning engine — while ensuring the systems you own keep Float’s day-to-day risk operations safe and scalable.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own the roadmap and sequencing for the Credit & Risk Engineering squad across three domains — starting with the trade-off between paying down risk infrastructure debt and building the FlexLine decisioning engine.

 - Own the decisioning and automation systems that drive KYB/KYC approval speed and accuracy, delivered so Float's risk operations team can hit its approval-time targets.

 - Own the tooling behind fraud detection, AML compliance, payments operations, and dispute resolution — daily infrastructure the company already depends on.

 - Own risk decision operating cost per account as your team's primary efficiency metric, proving the systems scale without proportional headcount growth.

 - Own the in-app credit experiences — applying for credit, viewing balances and limits, setting up repayments — and their target speed, in support of Float's credit product roadmap.

 - Be the standing source of truth on where the credit product roadmap ends and credit-engineering scope begins, in ongoing partnership with the GM of Credit.




ABOUT YOU


HERE'S WHAT SETS YOU UP FOR SUCCESS AT FLOAT:

 - You Put Customers First, Always. You care deeply about delivering meaningful value. Whether you're building internal systems or customer-facing features, you're always thinking about how to make life better for our users.

 - You Act Like an Owner. You take responsibility for outcomes, step up to challenges, and seek solutions proactively—doing what's best for the business, not just your role.

 - You Think Big and Move Fast. You're energized by building from 0 to 1. You're not afraid to challenge the status quo, experiment quickly, and learn as you go.

 - You Constantly Learn and Grow. You're hungry to improve your craft and open to feedback. You bring a growth mindset to everything you do.

 - You Raise the Bar. You care about doing things well and efficiently. You balance speed with rigor and always look for ways to improve how we work.

 - You Win as a Team. You're a generous collaborator who values communication, context, and shared wins. You lift others up and help make the team stronger.




WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

 - 5+ years of product management experience, with meaningful time personally owning a credit underwriting or risk-decisioning outcome — not just supporting one.

 - A track record building and owning infrastructure or internal-tooling products where another team, not an end customer, is who you're building for.

 - Real comfort operating inside compliance-heavy domains — KYB/KYC, transaction monitoring, fraud, AML, payments operations, or disputes.

 - An automation-first instinct: your default question is how a decision becomes automatic, not what the screen looks like.

 - Experience sequencing a roadmap under real capacity constraints, including saying no to work that looked mandatory.

 - Comfort negotiating and holding scope boundaries with senior, opinionated stakeholders you don't manage.




THIS MAY NOT BE THE ROLE FOR YOU IF:

 - You want to spend most of your time on customer-facing product experiences — this role is almost entirely about the systems behind them.

 - You're energized by visible launches and find debt-paydown or "keep the lights on" work unrewarding — the first phase here is deliberately about stabilizing existing systems before new build.

 - You want one clear manager and one roadmap — this seat drives outcomes for three separate leaders (credit, growth, and risk operations) who each own a piece of the result.




FLEXIBLE WORK MODEL

Float is Toronto-based with a hybrid model: in-office collaboration days, plus occasional in-person time for workflow-discovery sessions. Remote candidates within Canada considered, with occasional travel to Toronto.

You'll size opportunities, build the business case for where the team should invest, and own the reporting that tells product and go-to-market teams what's actually happening. The work runs from writing your own queries through to putting a recommendation in front of leadership. Recent projects in this seat have included protecting card spend through a major payments migration and rebuilding how customer feedback gets synthesized into prioritization.



There's a second half to the job that matters just as much: making the team faster. We want someone who looks at how product decisions get researched and made, finds the parts that are slower than they need to be, and builds the automation to fix them.

 - Size and build the business case for roadmap initiatives, so the team can decide what to invest in with real numbers behind it.

 - Own the reporting and dashboards for the product area — measuring what shipped, and making the results useful to both product and go-to-market teams.

 - Turn customer and field feedback into a prioritization signal the team acts on, rather than a document nobody reads.

 - Lead the analysis behind major forward-looking investment decisions, working across teams to build and present the proposal.

ABOUT FLOAT

Float is on a mission to simplify finance for Canadian businesses, empowering them to eliminate complexity and unlock new opportunities. Through our innovative platform, Float enables businesses to streamline financial operations and optimize cash flow, so they can focus on what matters most: growth. 

 

As one of Canada’s fastest growing companies https://www.theglobeandmail.com/business/rob-magazine/top-growing-companies/article-ranking-canadas-top-growing-companies-of-2024/ and top-rated startups in 2025 https://www.linkedin.com/posts/floatfinancial_were-proud-to-share-that-float-has-been-activity-7387093684720300032-2DDz/, 2024 https://www.linkedin.com/pulse/linkedin-top-startups-2024-15-canadian-companies-rise-linkedin-news-llihe/ and 2023 https://lnkd.in/TSU23CA, Float is customer-obsessed, passionate and entrepreneurial, with a team that includes leaders from Uber, Stripe, Shopify, Top Hat, Ada, Doordash, Snowflake, and Wealthsimple.

 

At Float, everyone is an owner, bringing their unique perspective to our team and product. Your voice is important, and we take having a culture based on feedback seriously. We openly share our thoughts and differing opinions so we can continue to improve. We do our best to keep our decision-making decentralized so that all team members feel ownership in our success.




OUR PRODUCT

Float is Canada’s intelligent financial operating system, combining modern financial services and software to help businesses spend, save, and grow. Trusted by more than 10,000 Canadian companies, Float provides high-limit corporate cards, automated expense management, next-day bill payments, high-yield accounts, and industry-leading support, all built in Canada, for Canada. Float recently announced our $85 million Series C https://floatfinancial.com/press/float-financial-raises-cad-85-million-series-c, and is backed by world-class investors, including Inovia Capital, Growth Equity at Goldman Sachs Alternatives, OMERS Ventures, and Silicon Valley Bank.

 

Our team is a collection of ambitious, collaborative and mission-driven people from all walks of life but with one goal: helping Canadian companies not just survive but thrive. And we’re looking for bold innovators to help shape the future of business finance in Canada.




AI USE IN OUR HIRING PROCESS

We use technology, including artificial intelligence (AI), to support parts of our hiring process. This may include AI-assisted scheduling and candidate communications, and AI-generated interview notes, guides or summaries to help our team focus on the conversation. All hiring decisions are made by our hiring team.



About the Role

We're hiring a Senior Product Manager to own the rails that move money into, out of and across Float: financial ledgering, financial accounts, payment rails (EFT, wires, ACH, cross-border and FX) and card infrastructure. Reporting to the GM, Banking, you'll work across three engineering squads to build and maintain the infrastructure behind our corporate cards, payments, FX and banking products. You'll think about the whole life of a payment — how it starts, how its status is communicated, what happens when it fails or is returned, and how customers and our teams resolve exceptions. You'll work with a designer, eight engineers and a product operations specialist focused on analytics and go-to-market planning.


What You'll Be Responsible For

 - Manage dependencies with banks, networks and processors that move on their own timelines. Escalate risks early, with options attached.

 - Partner closely with Engineering on APIs, data models, ledger interactions, controls and observability.

 - Make trade-off calls across customer experience, speed, reliability, risk, compliance, operational complexity and commercial impact.

 - Coordinate across our card, payments and banking products so infrastructure work supports the whole business.

 - Learn how finance leaders run payroll funding, tax remittance and multi-currency treasury, and work with Design to build accounts, treasury and FX into those workflows.

 - Work with Risk, Compliance, Operations, Finance and GTM from the start, not as approval steps at the end.

 - Keep leadership and partner teams clearly informed across many projects at once.

 - Use AI tools to speed up discovery, analysis, documentation and decision-making.

 - You Raise the Bar. You care about doing things well and efficiently. You balance speed with rigor and always look for ways to improve how we work.

 - You Win as a Team. You're a generous collaborator who values communication, context, and shared wins. You lift others up and help make the team stronger.


What You'll Bring

 - 5+ years in product management, with hands-on experience building and maintaining financial services infrastructure at a startup or scale-up.

 - Direct ownership of financial ledgering, money movement or payments products.

 - Experience leading a major infrastructure change — such as moving volume to a new bank partner or replacing a core system — while keeping customers and compliance whole.

 - Strong project management across external partners with their own timelines.

 - Clear, proactive written communication; people know where things stand before they ask.

 - Comfort with engineering concepts such as APIs, data models, ledgers and observability.

   - Canadian or US payments experience, including EFT/ACH, Interac e-Transfer, bill payments and wires.

lever:policyme:5190b06d-00cf-4429-b65b-7.description:
Overview of the Role We’re on a mission to modernize insurance - making it simpler, more accessible, and customer-first. The insurance industry is a $1T market that’s remained largely untouched by the digital revolution, and PolicyMe is here to change that. As a remote-first, Toronto-based startup with big ambitions, we’re looking for a product leader to help us build the future of insurance in Canada - and beyond. We are now seeking a Principal Product Manager to join our Accounts & Automation team within our product organization. This role will own several areas of scope, including: Defining the strategy and roadmap to make us the go-to provider for all of our customers’ personal insurance needs, including the platform-wide programs and features that drive multi-product adoption Building trust digitally across the products we offer, so customers feel similar levels of confidence and reassurance as they would get when they speak with one our licensed advisors Evolving our accounts product and internal tools to streamline operations and deliver a seamless customer experience end to end. This is a highly strategic and hands-on leadership role that blends product vision, analytical thinking, structured execution, and cross-functional leadership. You will be responsible for shaping long-term product direction while also driving day-to-day execution across multiple complex initiatives. Reporting to the VP of Product, you will work closely with leaders across Engineering, Design, Growth, Operations, Customer Success, and Data to build products that create exceptional customer outcomes and drive meaningful business impact. What you'll be doing:

Define & Own the Product Vision

  • Evolve our product strategy to improve customer delight, retention, referral growth, operational efficiency, and cross-product adoption.
  • Develop a compelling long-term vision for how to make insurance simple for Canadians, from how customers discover new products of ours to how they manage it post-sale.
  • Build and champion a roadmap that balances innovation, operational excellence, and long-term scalability.
  • Develop a deep understanding of customer and operational pain points, using those insights to shape strategy and prioritization.
  • Establish clear OKRs and success metrics that align teams around measurable business and customer outcomes.

    • Solve Ambiguous Problems

  • Take open-ended, unstructured problems and break them down into clear opportunities, strategic priorities, and executable plans.
  • Bring creative, first-principles thinking to solve complex challenges that have not been solved before in the Canadian insurance market.
  • Balance customer needs, technical constraints, operational realities, and business priorities when making product decisions.
  • Lead through ambiguity and create clarity for teams and stakeholders across the organization.

    • Drive End-to-end Execution and Delivery

  • Lead the product team through the full product lifecycle: problem definition, discovery, solution design, scoping, execution, launch, and iteration.
  • While you’ll shape the strategic direction, you’re also highly execution-oriented and willing to dive into the details when needed.
  • Ensure we build the right things, the right way, at the right time by balancing short-term wins with long-term platform investments.
  • Collaborate closely with Product Design and Engineering to build best-in-class customer and internal product experiences.
  • Write clear, actionable product specifications that connect business goals, customer needs, operational requirements, and technical constraints.
  • Coordinate closely with Growth, Customer Success, Operations, and other stakeholders to ensure launches are operationally ready and well-supported.
  • Drive alignment across teams and act as the connective tissue between stakeholders with competing priorities.

    • Measurement, Experimentation and Iteration

  • Define success metrics and measurement frameworks for all major initiatives, including customer engagement, funnel conversion, retention, operational efficiency, and long-term customer value.
  • Design and run experiments to validate hypotheses, de-risk larger investments, and accelerate learning.
  • Partner closely with Data to build dashboards, analyze product performance, and translate insights into actionable next steps - including when to pivot, double down, or sunset initiatives.
  • Use data, customer insights, and business context to continuously refine strategy and prioritization.
    • What we are looking for:
  • 8+ years of product management experience, including experience owning and scaling customer-facing digital products in high-growth environments.
  • Strong track record of leading complex cross-functional initiatives and delivering measurable business and customer outcomes.
  • Experience building both customer-facing D2C products and operational/internal tooling products.
  • Experience building prototypes with AI.
  • Experience scaling products and product practices within high-growth startups or fast-moving technology organizations.
  • Proven ability to define and communicate a compelling product vision that aligns teams and stakeholders around long-term outcomes.
  • Strong business acumen with a deep understanding of how product decisions impact revenue, operations, customer success, retention, and compliance.
  • Exceptional ability to structure ambiguous problems and turn them into clear, actionable plans.
  • Strong operational discipline with the ability to manage competing priorities, maintain momentum, and consistently close loops with stakeholders.
  • Excellent collaboration and stakeholder management skills with high emotional intelligence and a transparent leadership style.
  • Strong documentation and communication skills - able to tailor messaging effectively across executives, engineers, designers, marketers, and operational stakeholders.
  • Comfortable leading initiatives with many moving parts and driving alignment across multiple teams.
  • Strong sense of prioritization and ability to define MVP scope while balancing speed, quality, and long-term scalability.
  • Highly analytical and data-driven, with comfort working with product data, defining metrics, building measurement frameworks, and conducting analyses to inform decisions.
    • Why join us:
  • Generous PTO - 20 vacation days
  • A comprehensive benefits plan with premiums paid in full by PolicyMe
  • Investment in your professional development, including an L&D budget, AI tooling budget, performance reviews twice a year and ongoing feedback to ensure you reach your highest potential
  • An extremely high performing, low-ego, remote-first team that is truly disrupting an old industry
  • Option to work from home or our Toronto-based office (bonus: we cover the costs to bring all our employees in-person twice a year for experiential socials!)
  • Access to stock options based on performance

ashby:trulioo:29ac1954-3d7e-406a-8d1b-54.title: Product Manager (KYB)
ashby:trulioo:29ac1954-3d7e-406a-8d1b-54.description:
Are you ready to embark on a career that truly affects people around the world? Trulioo invites you to be a catalyst for change in the dynamic realm of digital identity verification. As the global front-runner in our industry, we are redefining how businesses grow, innovate and comply online.



Picture yourself at the forefront of innovation, contributing to our award-winning platform that enables organizations worldwide to quickly onboard customers, optimize costs and combat fraud. Fueled by Silicon Valley support, Trulioo stands as the trusted platform that can verify more than 5 billion people and 700 million business entities spanning 195 countries.



But Trulioo is more than a tech company. We are a united force of dedicated experts committed to establishing trust online - and we’re proud to be recognized as a BC Top Employer for the second consecutive year, reflecting our commitment to an inclusive, collaborative, and people-first workplace.



Headquartered in Vancouver and with strategic hubs in San Diego and Dublin, we foster a culture of collaboration and open communication. Our offices support a hybrid model and staff typically work three days per week at a hub location. Join us where excitement meets innovation and contribute to a world where trust and technology unite.



What We Offer

 - Comprehensive Benefits: We provide a robust benefits package for full-time, permanent employees, including health, dental, and vision coverage, retirement plans with company match, paid time off, parental leave, and an annual education & training stipend (equivalent to $1,000 in local currency). Specific benefits may vary by location and will be discussed further during the interview process.

 - Flexible Hybrid Working Environment: Our offices are designed to support both collaboration and flexibility. Enjoy weekly lunches, quality coffee, and regular social events. Many locations also feature parent rooms, on-site gyms, comfortable lounges, and adaptable workstations to support your comfort and productivity.

 - Wellness: We care about your well-being. Team members have access to wellness workshops and events, as well as a complimentary Headspace subscription to help you stay focused, grounded, and energized.

 - Employee Resource Groups: Belonging is an important part of doing your best work. Our ERGs provide an inclusive space, support and community for employees of diverse backgrounds and allies. We host informative, fun sessions and celebrations that are often open to the entire organization.
   
   


POSITION SUMMARY

Trulioo verifies businesses and the people behind them at global scale. Our Business Verification (KYB) product is the system enterprises and high-growth companies trust to onboard merchants, meet regulatory needs, and stop bad actors before they enter the platform - across 195+ countries, with the data, document, and watchlist coverage to back it. 



We're hiring a Product Manager to own the strategy and roadmap for a core area of KYB - setting direction, leading discovery, and shipping new product classes that change how fast and how confidently our customers can onboard a business anywhere in the world. You'll have a point of view on where KYB goes next, defend it with evidence, and change it when the evidence says otherwise. We need a strategic operator who can take new capabilities from concept to launch, adoption, and revenue-generating. 



This role is expected to leverage AI and emerging technologies to improve productivity, enhance decision-making, and continuously optimize how work is performed.



This will be a full-time, permanent position working out of the Vancouver office on a hybrid model (3 days per week in the office). However, this role can be done remotely for the right person.




WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING:

 - Strategy and roadmap for key KYB capabilities - including the prioritization trade-offs, the bets we're making, and the work we're explicitly not doing 

 - Customer discovery to develop a deep understanding of enterprise and SMB onboarding, risk, and compliance workflows, translating customer problems into clear product narratives, business cases, and launch plans 

 - Market and competitive analysis to identify where KYB needs to lead, where parity is enough, and where new product classes should be invented 

 - Detailed technical requirements developed with Engineering and Data teams, including APIs, platform workflows, data needs, edge cases, acceptance criteria, and trade-offs that unblock execution and support global scale 

 - New product launches end-to-end - partnering with Product Marketing, Sales, Customer Success, Solutions Engineering, and Support to land new capabilities with enterprise and SMB customers 

 - Define and manage success metrics such as adoption, conversion, verification rate, match quality, processing time, manual review reduction, revenue impact and customer satisfaction




WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

 -  5+ years in product management, with a track record of shipping work that moved measurable business or customer outcomes 

 - Technical fluency - comfortable specifying API behavior, reasoning about platform and data architecture trade-offs, and engaging with engineers as a peer on scope, edge cases, and build-vs-buy decisions 

 - Analytical rigor - defining the right metrics, instrumenting learning loops, and using data to drive prioritization decisions 

 - Customer discovery - regularly talking to customers and internal teams, synthesizing qualitative and quantitative signals, and separating urgent asks from durable product opportunities 

 - Go-to-market experience taking new products from concept through launch with sales, marketing, and CS - ideally including enterprise selling motions 

 - Stakeholder management and influence without authority across Product, Engineering, Sales, Customer Success, Support, Marketing, and Compliance, including driving durable alignment on difficult trade-offs 

 - AI fluency as a default - you use modern AI tools to accelerate research, drafting, prototyping, and engineering communication 

 - Clear written communication - your strategy docs and PRDs should require minimal interpretation 




NICE TO HAVE:

 - Background in KYB/KYC/AML, merchant onboarding, identity verification, risk, RegTech, financial services, payments, or e-commerce platforms 

 - Experience shipping AI-powered features, including evaluation methodology and reasoning about non-deterministic outputs 

 - Experience with global product surfaces - multi-jurisdiction compliance, localization, or international data sourcing 




INTERVIEW PROCESS:

At Trulioo, we strive to create an interview experience that is transparent, engaging, and respectful of your time. Our process is designed to help us learn more about your skills and experience while giving you insight into our team, culture, and the impact of the work we do.

Here's what you can expect throughout the interview process:

 - Recruiter Interview: 30 minutes

 - Hiring Manager Interview: 45 minutes

 - Panel Interview: 60 minutes

 - Final Leadership Interview: 30 minutes




WHY TRULIOO:

 KYB sits at the center of how the global economy onboards trust. The work compounds: every new jurisdiction, data source, and signal we add changes what's possible for our customers. You'll own a meaningful surface of that, with the autonomy to set direction and the team to actually ship it.


Thriving at Trulioo

At Trulioo, you’re not just an employee. You’re a valued member of our Trulicrew on a journey of professional and personal growth with a world-class organization. With Trulioo, you have the power to revolutionize the intersection of technology, digital trust and online identity to open the global economy to everyone. Together, we can shape the digital future.



We’re on the lookout for exceptional people to empower with trust, autonomy and the freedom to cultivate their potential. Your curiosity, meticulous attention to detail and passion to contribute are highly valued. If that resonates with you, apply today to become a part of our team. Join us in shaping a future where your career isn’t just a journey but also a boundless exploration into the possibilities of technology and digital identity verification. 



Get an inside look at life at Trulioo by following us on LinkedIn https://ca.linkedin.com/company/trulioo, or learn more about us at www.trulioo.com http://www.trulioo.com



If you don’t see yourself fully reflected in every job requirement listed on the posting above, we still encourage you to reach out and apply. Research has shown that minorities and underrepresented groups often only apply when they feel 100% qualified. We are committed to creating a more equitable, inclusive and diverse company and we strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientations, and life experiences to apply.

Trulioo welcomes applications from people with disabilities. Support is available upon request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. Finally, we know from time-to-time emergencies happen and you may need to reschedule an interview - we understand and encourage you to be in communication without worrying about losing the opportunity or your credibility.



Privacy Notice

As part of our job application process, Trulioo collects, processes, and discloses personal data for the purpose of identifying suitable candidates for our job openings. For more detail, please visit Trulioo’s Website Privacy Policy https://www.trulioo.com/website-privacy-policy in the section “When you apply for a job”.

This role is expected to leverage AI and emerging technologies to improve productivity, enhance decision-making, and continuously optimize how work is performed.



This will be a full-time, permanent position working out of the Vancouver office on a hybrid model (3 days per week in the office).




WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING:

Product Strategy & Roadmap

 - Own and continuously evolve the multi-quarter product roadmap for KYC fraud and risk solutions, balancing customer urgency, business value, and technical feasibility.

 - Define product vision aligned with Trulioo's broader platform strategy, contributing to internal roadmap communications and external partner/customer conversations.

 - Conduct rigorous market evaluations and competitive analyses to recommend build, partner, or buy decisions with clear rationale.

 - Identify and seize whitespace opportunities in consumer identity fraud, KYC compliance, and risk decisioning — bringing forward new product bets that could materially expand Trulioo's addressable market.

Discovery & Customer Insight

 - Serve as the primary voice of the customer, regularly conducting discovery interviews with enterprise clients across financial services, fintech, payments, and regulated industries.

 - Collect and synthesize qualitative and quantitative feedback to surface unmet needs, validate hypotheses, and inform prioritization decisions.

 - Partner with Sales and Business Development to engage prospects early in the sales cycle, representing the product and gathering signals on market demands.

 - Monitor product performance metrics, client feedback loops, and support escalations to drive continuous improvement post-launch.

Cross-Functional Execution

 - Lead cross-functional squads — Engineering, Data Science, Design, Legal, and Compliance — to deliver fraud and risk capabilities within expected timelines using agile methodologies.

 - Partner closely with ML and Data Science teams to identify predictive signals, validate model performance, define feedback loops, and deliver explainable risk scores that drive adoption.

 - Decompose complex product problems into incremental delivery milestones, managing trade-offs transparently with stakeholders.

 - Communicate product vision, roadmap updates, and strategic changes clearly to diverse audiences, including executive leadership and external clients.




WHAT YOU'LL BRING:

 - 8+ years of product management experience, with a significant portion focused on KYC, identity verification, fraud detection, or risk decisioning in FinTech, RegTech, Payments, or Financial Services.

 - Deep domain expertise in KYC fraud — including synthetic identity fraud, document fraud, account takeover, and consumer onboarding risk — with a clear understanding of how these differ from KYB risk and compliance workflows.

 - Hands-on experience working with ML and Data Science teams: defining model requirements, interpreting model outputs, managing feedback loops, and translating model insights into product features.

 - Proven track record of owning a product roadmap end-to-end, shipping impactful products in agile environments, and influencing without authority across cross-functional teams.

 - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills; ability to structure ambiguous problems, make defensible recommendations, and break them into deliverable increments.

 - Excellent oral and written communication skills, with the ability to distill complex technical or regulatory topics into crisp narratives for diverse audiences.

 - Experience working with third-party data providers such as credit bureaus, identity data networks, or risk data vendors.

 - Bachelor's degree in a STEM, Business, or related field — or equivalent practical experience.
   
   


NICE TO HAVE:

 - Experience with AML/BSA compliance frameworks, adverse media screening, PEPs/sanctions data, or regulatory reporting.

 - Familiarity with AI/ML Ops practices, LLMs, or agentic AI systems applied to fraud detection or identity workflows.

 - Prior experience integrating fraud APIs, risk orchestration platforms, or decisioning engines (e.g., case management, rules engines).

 - Exposure to global identity data ecosystems across multiple regions (North America, Europe, APAC) and their regulatory nuances.

Our offices support a hybrid model and staff typically work three days per week at a hub location. What We Offer

Specific benefits may vary by location and will be discussed further during the interview process.

A defining part of this role is AI fluency: you will be the executive team’s go-to person for identifying where AI tools can remove friction, accelerate decisions, and free up leadership time and you’ll model that adoption yourself before asking others to follow.

lever:eqbank:ed06b95a-a20e-4a10-a8a5-fd7.description:
Join a Challenger At EQ, we're remaking banking so every Canadian gets ahead, every day. Serving nearly 4 million Canadians from coast to coast, we offer a wide variety of financial services from banking and lending, to trust and credit union solutions.  We've been at this since 1970, challenging the conventions of traditional banking with smarter, faster, and more connected financial experiences. What's kept us moving?  The people behind it all: challengers who ask better questions, push back on old assumptions, and look for a better way forward. If you're driven to help reshape how banking works for Canadians and the businesses that power our economy, this could be your next big opportunity.  We can’t wait to get to know you!  The Work   Reporting to the VP, Decumulation, the Director, Strategy, Risk & Business Operations is responsible for leading the strategic planning, business performance and enablement, governance, and risk management functions for the Reverse Mortgage and Insurance Lending business. Acting as the operational and strategic leader to the VP, Decumulation, this role ensures the business maintains a robust risk and control environment while delivering on growth, profitability, and customer objectives. The Director will oversee enterprise and business-specific risk activities including risk appetite monitoring, credit, operational, compliance, legal, conduct, model, and reputational risks. This leader will act as the primary liaison between the business and corporate Risk, Legal, Compliance, Finance, Audit, Governance and other business related risk functions such as Fraud Management while ensuring the business meets all regulatory, governance, and board reporting obligations. In addition, the Director will lead annual strategic planning, financial forecasting, business performance management, executive and Board reporting, KPI development, , enterprise initiatives, business enablement programs, and the development of new products and growth opportunities. The role requires a unique combination of strategic leadership, analytical rigor, operational execution, governance expertise, and cross-functional influence. The Core Responsibilities:

Strategic Planning & Business Performance

  • Support the development and execution of the annual business strategy, operating plan, and growth priorities for the Reverse Mortgage business.
  • Own business performance management, including KPI development, executive dashboards, forecasting, and financial modeling.
  • Drive strategic business initiatives and investment decisions through business cases, market analysis, profitability assessments and ongoing performance reporting. Lead the execution of initiatives as needed.
  • Key Metrics: Achievement of annual volume, revenue, and profitability targets, Strategic initiative delivery (% completed on time and on budget), KPI and reporting accuracy/timeliness

    • Risk Management & Governance

  • Own first-line risk management activities across credit, operational, compliance, legal, conduct, and reputational risk.
  • Act as the primary liaison between the business and Risk, Compliance, Legal, Audit, and other partners.
  • Lead program development activities such as a the corporate RCM program, risk assessments, issue remediation, governance activities, and committee submissions while ensuring compliance with risk appetite and regulatory requirements. Perform testing of business controls as needed.
  • Key Metrics: Number and severity of audit, compliance, or regulatory findings, completion of remediation actions within agreed timelines, business performance against approved risk appetite metrics.

    • Credit Risk, Portfolio Analytics & Model Governance

    • Oversee LTV model governance, portfolio monitoring, stress testing, and scenario analysis to support risk management and strategic decision-making.
    • Partner with Credit Risk and Finance teams to monitor portfolio performance, concentration risks, and emerging trends.
    • Lead development and reporting of portfolio, risk, and capital metrics for executive and Board audiences.
    • Key Metrics: Portfolio delinquency and loss performance versus plan, timeliness and accuracy of stress testing and scenario analysis, LTV model governance and validation compliance.

      • Executive, Board & Regulatory Reporting

      • Lead preparation of Board, Executive Committee, ERMC, and regulatory reporting packages.
      • Develop clear, data-driven insights and recommendations supporting strategic and risk-related decision-making.
      • Ensure reporting effectively communicates business performance, emerging risks, and mitigation actions.
      • Key Metrics: On-time delivery of Board and committee materials, stakeholder satisfaction with reporting quality and insights, number of material reporting errors or revisions.

        • Business Enablement & Transformation

        • Lead cross-functional business transformation and operational improvement initiatives that enhance scale, efficiency, and customer outcomes.
        • Establish governance frameworks to prioritize, monitor, and measure strategic project delivery.
        • Partner across Technology, Operations, Product, and Finance to remove barriers and accelerate execution. Identify and accelerate opportunities to leverage AI through the risk and all business functions.
        • Key Metrics: Benefits realized from business initiatives, project delivery on time and within budget.

          • New Product Development & Innovation

          • Lead strategic evaluation, business case development, and governance for new products and product enhancements.
          • Coordinate cross-functional assessments involving Risk, Finance, Credit, Legal, Compliance, Operations, and Technology.
          • Ensure new products meet profitability, customer, risk, and regulatory objectives.
          • Key Metrics: New product launches delivered on time, business case outcomes versus forecast, product profitability and adoption rates

            • People Leadership

            • Lead, develop, and coach a high-performing team responsible for strategy, risk, analytics, and business operations.
            • Foster a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
            • Build organizational capability in strategic planning, governance, data analytics, and risk management.
            • Key Metrics: Employee engagement scores, achievement of team performance objectives.
    Let's Talk About You:
    • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, Mathematics, or a related field.
    • 10+ years of progressive experience in strategy, risk management, business management, finance, consulting, or related leadership roles within financial services.
    • Ideally has a mix of Consulting and financial industry experience.
    • Deep understanding of credit risk, operational risk, compliance risk, governance frameworks, and financial services regulatory environments.
    • Experience preparing Executive Committee, Board, and Risk Committee materials.
    • Strong financial modeling, forecasting, and business case development experience.
    • Experience leading strategic planning and enterprise transformation initiatives.
    • Strong analytical skills with the ability to synthesize complex information into clear recommendations and actionable insights.
    • Exceptional stakeholder management skills with demonstrated ability to influence senior executives and cross-functional teams.
    • Advanced proficiency in data analysis, KPI development, dashboard creation, and performance management.
    • Excellent written, verbal, and presentation communication skills.

lever:eqbank:c40c0c17-1c33-4a69-8a82-0b8.description:
Purpose of the Job:  The Lead, Program Governance & Enablement is an individual contributor role within the Integration Management Office (IMO). Working directly with the Senior Director, Program Management, the incumbent plays a key role in driving integration execution, governance effectiveness, and delivery outcomes across the program.  The role is responsible for leading assigned integration workstreams, initiatives, and cross-functional deliverables while also providing governance, reporting, and program management support across the broader integration. The incumbent works with stakeholders across business and corporate functions to drive milestones, manage risks, issues, dependencies, decisions, and actions, and help remove blockers that may impact program delivery.  In addition, the role brings together information from across the program to produce executive materials, governance reporting, and actionable insights for leadership decision-making. The role works closely with senior leaders, workstream owners, and delivery teams to ensure integration commitments are progressing as planned and that emerging issues are identified and addressed promptly.  The role provides broad exposure across the integration, including the Executive Steering Committee, IMO All Hands, leadership updates, the integration program management platform, and consolidated reporting on contracts, Transition Service Agreements, synergies, and benefits.  The role suits an organized, analytically strong individual who can structure problems, work through ambiguity, influence stakeholders, and drive outcomes in a complex environment. Relevant experience may come from management consulting, a Big Four firm, an internal strategy or transformation team, program management, or another demanding environment requiring structured problem-solving, stakeholder management, and executive communication. Main Activities: :
Integration Workstream Leadership
Lead complex integration workstreams and cross-functional initiatives, ensuring milestones, dependencies, risks, and deliverables remain on track.
Partner across business, technology, risk, legal, and operations teams to drive execution and resolve issues.
Provide status updates, recommendations and escalations to leadership while ensuring accountability for outcomes.
 
Executive Materials & Communications
Create executive-level presentations, reports, and governance materials for leadership and steering committees.
Translate complex or evolving information into clear, concise, and decision-focused narratives.
Leverage AI tools to accelerate research, content development and reporting while ensuring quality, accuracy and consistency.
 
Program Governance & Coordination
Coordinate governance processes, meeting materials, timelines, and executive submissions across the integration program.
Track decisions, outcomes, actions, and follow-up activities to ensure effective execution.
Serve as a key partner to program leadership, supporting strategic priorities, executive requests, and operational effectiveness.
 
Program Management Platform & Reporting
Manage and enhance the integration program management platform to improve visibility and collaboration.
Develop dashboards, reporting views, and executive summaries covering milestones, risks, dependencies, and program performance.
Drive automation and AI-enabled reporting solutions to improve efficiency and data quality.
 
RAID, Dependency, Decision & Action Management
Maintain centralized tracking of risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies, decisions, and actions across the program.
Monitor ownership, timelines, blockers, and escalation requirements to support timely resolution.
Provide clear exception reporting and insights to support leadership decision-making and governance.
 
Contracts, TSAs, Synergies & Benefits Reporting
Consolidate and report on contracts, Transition Service Agreements (TSAs), synergies, benefits, and value-capture initiatives.
Partner with Finance, Legal, Procurement, Technology, and delivery teams to gather and align program updates.
Highlight risks, gaps, dependencies, and integration impacts while supporting accurate enterprise-level reporting.
:

Skills & Knowledge

  • Strong problem-solving, analytical, organizational, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Advanced PowerPoint and executive communication capabilities, with the ability to translate complex information into clear, decision-focused narratives.
  • Experience with program governance, RAID and dependency management, dashboards, structured data, and AI-enabled research, analysis, and reporting.
  • Sound judgment, attention to detail, and the ability to influence, navigate ambiguity, and drive actions to completion.

    • Education & Experience

  • 5+ years of experience in program management, transformation, consulting, strategy, governance, integration management, or related fields.
  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Commerce, Finance, Strategy, Technology, or a related discipline.
  • Proven experience developing executive-level presentations, management reporting, and coordinating complex, cross-functional initiatives.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel, and Microsoft 365; experience in consulting, transformations, integrations, financial services, TSAs, contracts, synergies, or benefits reporting is an asset.

    • What Success Looks Like

  • Deliver high-quality executive, governance, and All Hands materials accurately and on schedule.
  • Maintain reliable program reporting across milestones, RAID items, dependencies, decisions, actions, and blockers.
  • Ensure contract, TSA, synergy, and benefits reporting is consolidated, aligned, and linked to program outcomes.
  • Proactively identify risks, gaps, overdue actions, and escalation needs while improving efficiency through automation, templates, and AI.
