amazon:amazon:10559146.description:
This position is part of the AWS Specialist and Partner Organization (ASP). Specialists own the end-to-end go-to-market strategy for their respective technology domains, providing the business and technical expertise to help our customers succeed. Partner teams own the strategy, recruitment, development, and growth of our key technology and consulting partners. Together, they provide our customers with the expertise and scale needed to build innovative solutions for their most complex challenges.

Amazon Web Services is seeking a bilingual (English/French) Solutions Architect to join the Agentic WorkSpaces team in Toronto, Canada. This role requires a professional operating at the intersection of enterprise desktop infrastructure and applied AI—with a primary, clearly defined depth in Agentic WorkSpaces platform architecture (60%), complemented by advisory-level proficiency in applied AI and Large Language Model (LLM) deployment patterns (40%).

The primary mandate is mastery of the Agentic WorkSpaces platform. You will architect, deploy, and optimize Virtual Desktop Infrastructure (VDI) and Desktop-as-a-Service (DaaS) solutions using Amazon WorkSpaces Personal and Core, as well as Amazon WorkSpaces Applications (formerly AppStream 2.0). You will ensure production readiness for enterprise customers, covering network design, identity federation, image management, directory services, protocol optimization, and operational health. This requires "Level 300" depth—you are the definitive technical authority customers rely on to move from assessment to large-scale production.

The secondary mandate is applied AI consulting. You will guide customers through the agentic AI capabilities integrated into Agentic WorkSpaces—including AI agent configuration, foundation model selection via Amazon Bedrock, prompt engineering, tool integration via the Model Context Protocol (MCP), and agent-to-agent (A2A) communication patterns. You will evaluate LLM performance, design agent evaluation frameworks, and advise on deployment models for production AI workloads. This role requires a "200+" level of technical depth—sufficient to lead customer conversations, conduct hands-on demonstrations, and identify when to engage deeper AI engineering resources.

Canada represents a strategic growth market for Agentic WorkSpaces. Federal, provincial, and regulated-sector clients (financial services, healthcare, public sector) require native-level French engagement for procurement, compliance documentation, and day-to-day technical consulting. This role directly serves Canadian public sector and enterprise clients, leading discovery sessions, architecture reviews, and production readiness assessments in both English and French. Toronto offers geographic proximity to Canada's largest concentration of businesses while providing access to bilingual talent.

Availability to travel up to 25%–50% of the time for on-site customer engagements across Canada.
**************************
Ce poste fait partie de l'AWS Specialist and Partner Organization (ASP). Les spécialistes possèdent la stratégie de mise sur le marché de bout en bout pour leurs domaines technologiques respectifs, en fournissant l'expertise commerciale et technique pour aider nos clients à réussir. Les équipes partenaires possèdent la stratégie, le recrutement, le développement et la croissance de nos principaux partenaires technologiques et de conseil. Ensemble, ils offrent à nos clients l'expertise et l'envergure nécessaires pour construire des solutions innovantes face à leurs défis les plus complexes.

Amazon Web Services recherche un architecte de solutions bilingue (anglais/français) pour rejoindre l'équipe Agentic WorkSpaces à Toronto, Canada. Ce rôle exige un professionnel qui opère à l'intersection de l'infrastructure de bureau d'entreprise et de l'intelligence artificielle appliquée — avec une profondeur principale clairement définie en architecture de plateforme Agentic WorkSpaces (60 %), complétée par une proficiency au niveau consultatif en IA appliquée et en modèles de déploiement de grands modèles linguistiques (LLM) (40 %).

Le mandat principal est la maîtrise de la plateforme Agentic WorkSpaces. Vous architecturerez, déploierez et optimiserez des solutions d'infrastructure de bureau (VDI) et de bureau en tant que service (DaaS) en utilisant Amazon WorkSpaces Personal et Core, ainsi qu'Amazon WorkSpaces Applications (anciennement AppStream 2.0). Vous assurerez la préparation à la production pour les clients d'entreprise : conception réseau, fédération d'identité, gestion d'images, services d'annuaire, optimisation de protocole et santé opérationnelle. Il s'agit d'une profondeur de niveau 300 — vous êtes l'autorité technique définitive sur laquelle les clients comptent pour passer de l'évaluation à la production à grande échelle.

Le mandat secondaire est le conseil en IA appliquée. Vous guiderez les clients à travers les capacités d'IA agentique intégrées à Agentic WorkSpaces — notamment la configuration d'agents IA, la sélection de modèles de base via Amazon Bedrock, l'ingénierie des invites, l'intégration d'outils via le Model Context Protocol (MCP), et les modèles de communication agent à agent (A2A). Vous évaluerez la performance des LLM, concevrez des cadres d'évaluation d'agents et conseillerez sur les modèles de déploiement pour les charges de travail d'IA en production. Il s'agit d'une profondeur de niveau 200+ — suffisante pour diriger les conversations avec les clients, mener des démonstrations pratiques et identifier quand engager des ressources d'ingénierie IA plus approfondies.

Le Canada représente un marché de croissance stratégique pour Agentic WorkSpaces. Les clients fédéraux, provinciaux et des secteurs réglementés (services financiers, santé, secteur public) requièrent un engagement en français natif pour l'approvisionnement, la documentation de conformité et le conseil technique quotidien. Ce rôle sert directement les clients du secteur public et des entreprises canadiennes — menantdes découvertes, des examens d'architecture et des évaluations de préparation à la production en anglais et en français. Toronto offre une proximité géographique avec la plus grande concentration d'entreprises au Canada tout en offrant l'accès à des talents bilingues.

Disponibilité à voyager jusqu'à 25 % - 50 % pour les engagements clients sur site partout au Canada.

Key job responsibilities
Agentic WorkSpaces Expertise (60%)
Lead technical discovery sessions with public sector and enterprise clients to assess existing IT infrastructure, identify migration paths, and define production deployment architectures for Amazon WorkSpaces (Personal, Core Managed Instances, Core Bundles) and Amazon WorkSpaces Applications.

Design end-to-end Agentic WorkSpaces architectures covering VPC/network topology, Active Directory federation or AWS Managed Microsoft AD, multi-region resilience, image lifecycle management, and protocol optimization for latency-sensitive workloads.

Lead Technical Validation (TechVal) engagements—defining success criteria, executing structured test plans, validating performance under production-like conditions, and producing outcome reports with clear go/no-go recommendations.

Design migrations from existing VDI platforms (Citrix Apps and Desktops, VMware/Omnissa Horizon) to Agentic WorkSpaces, including application compatibility assessment, user profile migration, and validation of print and peripheral redirection.

Ensure production readiness: capacity planning, monitoring and alerting configuration (CloudWatch, WorkSpaces health APIs), patch management cadence, cost optimization (Reserved Instances, auto-stop policies), and development of operational runbooks.

Build deep relationships with senior technical stakeholders within client organizations—positioning yourself as the trusted advisor they consult before making infrastructure decisions.

Deliver in-person and remote knowledge transfer sessions (workshops, immersion days, bootcamps) to transfer Agentic WorkSpaces operational knowledge to client teams. Agentic AI Consulting (40%)

Guide clients through the capabilities of agentic AI within Agentic WorkSpaces—including AI agent creation, model selection via Amazon Bedrock, prompt configuration, guardrail setup, and tool/action integration.

Evaluate foundation model performance for workspace-specific use cases, balancing latency, accuracy, cost, and compliance requirements. Advise on model selection trade-offs between Anthropic Claude, Amazon Titan, and third-party models available via Bedrock.

Design and deploy Model Context Protocol (MCP) server configurations that expose client tools, APIs, and data sources in a standardized format for dynamic discovery and agent tool invocation.

Design Agent-to-Agent (A2A) communication models enabling multi-agent orchestration across enterprise systems (IT service management, identity operations, document processing, security automation).

Create and advise on agent evaluation frameworks—defining metrics (task completion rate, hallucination rate, P95 latency, cost per invocation), establishing baselines, and executing structured evaluations against production workloads.

Conduct data readiness assessments: evaluate client data landscapes (CRM, knowledge bases, ticketing systems, identity stores), identify gaps, and recommend remediation strategies to ensure AI agents have reliable access to information.

Advise on LLM deployment patterns, including Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), fine-tuning decision frameworks, knowledge base configuration, vector database selection, and chunking/embedding strategies. Cross-functional and Go-to-Market

Create reusable artifacts—reference architectures, implementation guides, sample configurations, prompt libraries, and data readiness checklists—that scale best practices across the SA community and the partner ecosystem.

Provide structured product feedback to the Agentic WorkSpaces and Amazon Bedrock service teams based on real-world customer implementations, directly contributing to roadmap prioritization.

Act as a technical liaison between customers, partners, service engineering teams, and support—ensuring the voice of the customer reaches product leadership with accuracy and urgency.

Author or contribute to publications for AWS customers—such as white papers, blog posts, technical guides, and case studies—that demonstrate Canadian customers' success with Agentic WorkSpaces.
****************************
Expertise Agentic WorkSpaces (60%)
Diriger des séances de découverte technique avec des clients du secteur public et des grandes entreprises pour évaluer l'infrastructure informatique existante, identifier les chemins de migration et définir les architectures de déploiement en production pour Amazon WorkSpaces (Personal, Core Managed Instances, Core Bundles) et Amazon WorkSpaces Applications.

Concevoir des architectures Agentic WorkSpaces de bout en bout englobant la topologie VPC/réseau, la fédération Active Directory ou AWS Managed Microsoft AD, la résilience multi-région, la gestion du cycle de vie des images et l'optimisation des protocoles pour les charges de travail sensibles à la latence.

Mener des engagements de Validation Technique (TechVal) — définir les critères de succès, exécuter des plans de test structurés, valider la performance dans des conditions représentatives de la production et produire des rapports de sortie avec des recommandations claires go/no-go.

Concevoir des migrations à partir de plates-formes VDI existantes (Citrix Apps and Desktops, VMware/Omnissa Horizon) vers Agentic WorkSpaces, incluant l'évaluation de compatibilité des applications, la migration des profils utilisateur et la validation de la redirection d'impression et de périphériques.

Assurer la préparation à la production : planification de la capacité, configuration de la surveillance et des alertes (CloudWatch, APIs de santé WorkSpaces), cadence de correction des bogues, optimisation des coûts (instances réservées, politiques d'arrêt automatique) et développement de guides opérationnels.

Établir des relations approfondies avec les intervenants techniques seniors au sein des organisations clients — vous positionnant comme le conseiller de confiance qu'ils consultent avant de prendre des décisions en matière d'infrastructure.

Dispenser des séances de transfert de connaissances en personne et à distance (ateliers, journées immersion, bootcamps) pour transférer les connaissances opérationnelles d'Agentic WorkSpaces aux équipes clients.

Conseil en Intelligence Artificielle Agentic (40%)

Guider les clients à travers les capacités de l'IA agentic au sein d'Agentic WorkSpaces — incluant la création d'agents IA, la sélection de modèles via Amazon Bedrock, la configuration de requêtes, la configuration des garde-fous et l'intégration d'outils/d'actions.

Évaluer la performance des modèles de base pour les cas d'usage spécifiques aux espaces de travail : équilibrer la latence, la précision, le coût et les exigences de conformité. Conseiller sur les compromis de sélection de modèles entre Anthropic Claude, Amazon Titan et les modèles tiers disponibles via Bedrock.

Concevoir et déployer des configurations de serveur Model Context Protocol (MCP) qui exposent les outils, API et sources de données des clients dans un format standardisé pour la découverte dynamique et l'invocation d'outils d'agents.

Concevoir des modèles de communication Agent-to-Agent (A2A) permettant l'orchestration multi-agents à travers les systèmes d'entreprise (gestion des services informatiques, opérations d'identité, traitement de documents, automatisation de la sécurité).

Créer et conseiller sur des équipements d'évaluation d'agents — définir les métriques (taux de complétion de tâche, taux d'hallucination, latence P95, coût par invocation), établir des bases de référence et exécuter des évaluations structurées par rapport aux charges de travail en production.

Mener des évaluations de préparation des données : évaluer le paysage de données des clients (CRM, bases de connaissances, systèmes de tickets, magasins d'identités), identifier les lacunes et recommander des stratégies de correction pour assurer que les agents IA ont un accès fiable aux informations.

Conseiller sur les modèles de déploiement LLM incluant la génération augmentée par récupération (RAG), les cadres de décision de mise au point, la configuration de la base de connaissances, la sélection de base de données vectorielle et les stratégies de segmentation/intégration.

amazon:amazon:10559423.description:
Amazon Business customers buy at a scale most retail systems were never built for: a school district ordering 2,000 chairs, a contractor ordering 900 boxes of fasteners, a hospital restocking an entire floor. Today those orders often arrive as dozens of separate boxes over many days, and we are rebuilding how Amazon fulfills them.
You will own the product roadmap for bulk and large order fulfillment at Amazon Business. The goal is simple to state and hard to build: a customer places one large order, picks one date, and receives it once, in the form factor that fits their dock and their crew. Getting there means changing how Amazon sources, consolidates, packs and ships large orders, working shoulder to shoulder with the engineering teams that own fulfillment planning and fulfillment center operations. This is a builder role with a funded roadmap and direct exposure to senior leaders across Amazon Business, supply chain and operations.

Key job responsibilities
Own the product roadmap for bulk and large order fulfillment, from customer problem through launch and measured outcome.
Write the documents that get the work funded and built: PRFAQs, business requirements documents, and annual and three year planning inputs.
Act as the requirements owner with partner engineering teams in fulfillment planning and fulfillment center technology, not a ticket filer. Negotiate scope, sequence and dependencies directly with their product and engineering leaders.
Define how Amazon consolidates a large order into as few deliveries as possible, including palletized delivery and customer selected delivery dates.
Define how a request for many individual units can be served from cases and pallets of the same product, working through the inventory, receive and pick changes that requires.
Build the case for dedicated bulk fulfillment capacity, including moving product from suppliers to customers without a putaway step.
Replace manual operator work with automation across sourcing, consolidation and promise, and track the reduction.
Own the metrics: deliveries per order, delivery date accuracy, ship cost per unit and contribution profit per unit. Pull your own data and defend your own numbers.

A day in the life
You will spend your day between customers and builders. Mornings often start in the data, checking how last week's large orders actually shipped and where they fragmented. From there it is working sessions with fulfillment planning and fulfillment center engineering teams on requirements, a review with operations leaders on the manual work still left in the flow, and time with Amazon Business sales and customer teams on what large buyers are asking for. You will write often, and you will present what you write to directors and above.

About the team
Amazon Business (AB) launched in the United States in April 2015 with the vision of delivering a comprehensive procurement solution for business customers of all sizes. In the US, AB now serves Fortune 500 companies, hospital systems, local governments, and education organizations. To support AB's mission, the AB Operations team owns end to end customer experience for AB customers right from checkout to final mile delivery and sits under the broader Global Transportation Services (GTS). We are the Single Threaded WW Ops team driving B2B operations, developing products and programs unique to business customers, and enhancing the business delivery capabilities.

- 3+ years of product management experience
- Experience managing technical products or online services
- Experience in product, program, or project management in leading cross-functional teams in delivery of major new products or services

- Experience building and analyzing cost/benefit scenarios and business cases and communicating results throughout the organization
- Experience working with technical and product stakeholders to define requirements, prioritize features, and influence product roadmaps

Amazon is seeking a Sr. Program Manager on the outbound (OB) transportation planning team. This role will lead short-term planning and our high-volume event (HVE) planning for Canada (Amazon.ca). This is a highly visible role, who engages with multiple partner teams and provides transportation volume plans and recommendations up to the VP level.

-Engage with demand planning to understand and align on topline demand and confidence intervals

-Partner with Middle and Last mile leads to understand changes in each component of the transportation plans

In collaboration with partner networks, the team builds granular plans covering short (Running 12-Week) and long term (up to 5 Year) time horizon. amazon:amazon:10552007.description:
Do you like startups? Are you interested in cloud computing? Yes? 

We have a role you might find interesting. Startups are the large enterprises of the future. These young companies are founded by ambitious people who have a desire to build something meaningful and to challenge the status quo. To address underserved customers, or to challenge incumbents. They usually operate in an environment of scarcity: whether that’s capital, engineering resource, or experience. This is where you come in. 

The AWS Startup Solutions Architecture team is dedicated to working with these early stage startup companies as they build their businesses. We’re here to make sure that they can deploy the best, most scalable, and most secure architectures possible – and that they spend as little time and money as possible doing so. 

We are looking for technical builders who love the idea of working with early stage startups to help them as they grow. In this role, you’ll work directly with a variety of interesting customers and help them make the best (and sometimes the most pragmatic) technical decisions along the way. You’ll have a chance to build enduring relationships with these companies and establish yourself as a trusted advisor. 

As well as spending time working directly with customers, you’ll also get plenty of time to “sharpen the saw” and keep your skills fresh. We have more than 175 services across a range of different categories and it’s important that we can help startups take advantages of the right ones. You’ll also play an important role as an advocate with our product teams to make sure we are building the right products for the startups you work with. And for the customers you don’t get to work with on a 1:1 basis you’ll get the chance to share your knowledge more broadly by working on technical content and presenting at events. 

Key job responsibilities
- Engage directly with startup customers to provide them with technical advocacy as they build their products in the cloud. Ensure that they are spending as little time and money as possible doing so 
- Create plans, in conjunction with other members of customer account teams, to define how you will help your customers with their cloud needs 
- Share your technical knowledge broadly by participating in select, startup-focused, one-to-few and one-to-many sessions with larger groups of customers 
- Work with other teams at AWS (e.g. marketing, training) to contribute to the creation of content that can be delivered to the broader startup community at scale (e.g. on-line videos, and other digital content)

A day in the life
You’ll spend most of your time working with startup co-founders and CTOs, helping them build solutions that can grow with their businesses. Your day might start with a conversation about an AI project, continue with a workshop alongside a development team, and wrap up with a partner discussion about a cloud migration. Along the way, you’ll work together to solve technical problems, manage costs, or bring a product to market faster. Occasionally, you may also share feedback from startups with the teams building our services.

About the team

amazon:amazon:10537815.description:
A fulfillment center can appear to be a chaotic place. With millions of items moving in and out of an area twice as large as your average theme park every day, a quick peek under the roof would reveal a manic scene. You would see associates, machinery, vehicles, robots, and packages flying about at break-neck speeds and accessing a breathtaking number of shelves and bins that store products. In reality, however, this activity is all highly organized and orchestrated by software, with each movement carefully planned and optimized. There are times when mistakes occur though, and products disappear, reappear in strange places, are damaged, or worse. When that happens, how does a fulfillment center operating at that size, speed, and scale recover gracefully and with minimal cost? How do we ensure that we meet our commitments to our customers and merchants? How do we find a needle in a haystack when we’re constantly shuffling the haystack around? And how do we do it at extreme scale in an environment of constant growth?

That’s where we come in, the AFT Quality team. Our goal is to prevent entropy in a system in which there are billions of transactions driven by human and robotic input across hundreds of millions of items every year. We must ensure that the virtual and physical state of the world is aligned inside hundreds of Amazon’s fulfillment centers globally. When our job is done well, mistakes are corrected quickly, and products are always ready to sell and ship.

We operate at a nexus of machine learning, computer vision, robotics, and healthy measure of hard-earned expertise in operations to build automated, algorithmic approaches to solving these problems at minimal cost. We create cutting edge software, building automated processes and workflows in the most complex operational problem space in the business world.

Key job responsibilities
-Define the strategy and roadmap for solving the complex, ambiguous problems that emerge throughout fulfillment operations, driving org-wide alignment on the path forward.
-Partner with customers and stakeholders to shape the requirements and specifications that define new product offerings from the ground up.
-Collaborate with scientists to apply state-of-the-art artificial intelligence technologies, including computer vision, to overcome challenges unique to the scale of the "everything store."
-Own the end-to-end delivery of large-scale programs that advance the organization's long-term goals of improving customer satisfaction and lowering costs.
-Lead high-stakes initiatives that cut across organizational boundaries, uniting disparate teams around a single outcome.
-Communicate initiative status and strategy to senior leadership and stakeholders, keeping them aligned and bought in.
-Engage with executives, principal engineers, managers, scientists, and product owners to drive resolution on contentious technical topics.
-Invent the mechanisms and metrics that turn ambiguous, complex initiatives into measurable, trusted impact.
-Understand system architectures deeply enough to challenge engineering teams, spot risks in technical proposals, and foster simplifications.
-Dive deep into the data or the code to unearth hidden opportunities and crack the toughest problems.
-Mentor TPMs and engineers, participate in promotions for senior employees, and contribute to talent development across the organization.

A day in the life
Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners and their children. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment. The benefits that generally apply to regular, full-time employees include:
1. Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
2. Maternity and Parental Leave Options
3. Paid Time Off (PTO)
4. RRSP Plan

If you are not sure that every qualification on the list above describes you exactly, we'd still love to hear from you! At Amazon, we value people with unique backgrounds, experiences, and skillsets. If you’re passionate about this role and want to make an impact on a global scale, please apply!

About the team
Amazon Fulfillment Technologies (AFT) powers Amazon’s global fulfillment network. We invent and deliver software, hardware, and data science solutions that orchestrate processes, robots, machines, and people. https://tinyurl.com/AFTOverview

AFT’s Quality organmization drives automation programs that leverage computer vision, machine learning, and other innovative technologies to prevent, detect, and correct potential inventory issues impacting fulfillment efficiency and customer satisfaction. We build solutions that ensure Amazon customers can get what they want, when they want it and in perfect condition.

amazon:amazon:10551580.description:
The AI Center of Excellence builds shared AI building blocks - primitives - that change how Amazon's systems work, not what features they ship. We take on the hardest problems first, prove each primitive with one partner on one real problem, then open it up so any team at Amazon can adopt what we've validated without solving it again.

We are looking for a Product Manager - Technical who can own the vision and lifecycle of these primitives, drive them from concept through adoption, and make sound product and technical trade-offs in a fast-moving AI domain.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the product lifecycle for AI primitives end-to-end - from customer discovery and problem framing through vision definition, roadmap prioritization, execution with cross-team dependencies, launch, and post-launch performance optimization

- Define product strategy by understanding problems that cut across multiple teams and personas - translating that into clear principles, requirements, and roadmap priorities that sequence work on evidence

- Drive adoption by partnering with early adopters, generalizing requirements from multiple contexts, and ensuring primitives work for any team without requiring your team to operate them

- Evaluate technical proposals alongside scientists and ML engineers - understanding architecture trade-offs and balancing feature delivery with system health and long-term maintainability

- Make crisp product decisions in ambiguous AI/ML domains where the problem and strategy may not yet be defined - using data, customer insight, and judgment

- Define success criteria that measure the primitive you own, not the partner's business outcome you don't - distinguishing adoption from real impact

- Ensure primitives are findable, adoptable, and valuable - not just built and opened

- Contribute to the team's rhythm of business - planning cycles, business reviews, goal tracking, and operational reporting

A day in the life
Every day brings new challenges. You might work backward from a partner team's pain point to frame a new primitive, review a technical design with scientists to assess whether an architecture can scale, or analyze adoption data to decide what to double down on versus deprecate. Other days, you'll write a vision document for a new capability, find new opportunities across the enterprise, or sit with early adopters to understand how they'd consume a primitive in their pipeline. You'll move between technical discussions with scientists and engineers and alignment conversations with senior managers and directors.

No two weeks look the same. You'll move between customer discovery, technical strategy, and hands-on execution - always building toward primitives that are trusted, consumable, and impactful at scale.

About the team
AICE is a team of scientists and machine learning engineers building the AI primitives that power Amazon's intelligent systems. We develop and harden reusable capabilities for broad consumption by product teams across the enterprise - and partner with those teams to integrate them.

amazon:amazon:10543992.description:
Amazon Ads is dedicated to driving measurable outcomes for brand advertisers, agencies, authors, and entrepreneurs. Our ad solutions - including sponsored, display, video, and custom ads - leverage Amazon’s innovations and insights to find, attract, and engage intended audiences throughout their daily journeys. With a range of flexible pricing and buying models, including self-service, managed service, and programmatic ad buying, these solutions help businesses build brand awareness, increase product sales, and more. Our programmatic advertising platform, the Amazon Demand Side Platform (DSP), is becoming increasingly popular with major advertisers and agencies worldwide. We believe we understand display advertising better than anybody else and want to turn it into a science of its own that all users can leverage for their programmatic advertising. 

Our Amazon DSP team is looking for a Programmatic Solutions Consultant to join Amazon Ads growing team based Toronto, CA. 

As a Programmatic Solutions Consultant, you will manage the end-to-end experience of our enterprise customer, known as programmatic trading desks. You will drive success by developing customer expertise in our programmatic advertising DSP. 

The Programmatic Solutions Consultant has experience in advertising technology and the programmatic advertising domain, and is leveraging this expertise to help our customers meet and exceed their business objectives. In this customer-facing role, you will work closely with programmatic traders at agencies/advertisers, as well as Amazon Ads internal sales, product, and support teams to address customer needs.

Key job responsibilities
* Owning the relationship with programmatic trading desk managers, engaging with multiple customer organizational levels to understand business objectives
* Providing services such as onboarding, trade desk support plans, feature training, continuous product usage consultation, and industry best practices
* Analyzing and interpreting data to identify improvement areas, root causes, and formulate enablement and adoption recommendations
* Driving the evolution of Amazon DSP by assisting customers with product beta participation, capturing customer feedback, and collaborating closely with cross-functional Amazon teams (Product Management, Engineering, Analytics, and Specialists)
* Defining and improving processes and tools for the Programmatic Solutions Consultant team to better serve customers

A day in the life
A typical PSC engagement with our customers could include onboarding new traders, delivering trainings on new product features, assisting a customer with a beta feature, consulting in business strategy and planning discussions, providing oversight in execution of campaign strategy, developing campaign optimization recommendations and monitoring their impact, conducting deep dives to determine root causes of issues and informing customers of the best course of action.

You will advocate for customer in internal forums, provide troubleshooting support and triage when needed, and simplify and propagate customer feedback to inform product and services design. PSCs operate as trusted advisors to customers every day, and ensure customers gradually develop into a proficient users of our DSP, who see Amazon DSP as their preferred means to their goals.

You will be passionate about understanding customer objectives, and address them using our book of services and engagement best practices, to drive adoption of Amazon technologies. Your ownership, curiosity, and domain knowledge will allow you to comprehensively understand the details of our offerings and be able to speak to these to our customers with passion, authority, empathy, and clarity.

About the team
Amazon Ads helps brands create experiences that delight customers and deliver meaningful results. With 300+ million worldwide active customer accounts, and first-party insights based on shopping, streaming and browsing signals, brands can craft relevant campaigns that enhance customer experiences. Our solutions on Amazon.com, services like Twitch, IMDb TV, Alexa, Amazon Music, and partnerships with third-party publishers and exchanges make Amazon Ads the ultimate amplifier for brands to reach the right audiences in the right places, both on and off Amazon. 

Our programmatic advertising platform, the Amazon Demand Side Platform (DSP), is becoming increasingly popular with major advertisers and agencies worldwide. We believe we understand e-commerce advertising better than anybody else and want to turn it into a science of its own that all users can leverage for their programmatic advertising.

Here at Amazon Advertising, we embrace our differences. We are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. We have 13 employee-led affinity groups, reaching 40,000 employees in over 190 chapters globally. We have innovative benefit offerings, and host annual and ongoing learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences. amazon:amazon:10528520.title: Principal Technical Program Manager, MADS
amazon:amazon:10528520.description:
Every day, advertisers and partners worldwide measure the success of their Amazon Ads campaigns through the data Programmatic Reporting delivers: billions of aggregated datapoints that AI agents, machine learning models, and analytics engines around the world now depend on as AI reshapes how advertising is planned and optimized. The Measurement, Ad Tech, and Data Science (MADS) organization at Amazon Ads is looking for a Principal Technical Program Manager to drive the largest, most cross-cutting programs behind that data.

Programmatic Reporting owns Amazon Marketing Stream and the Reporting APIs, the interfaces advertisers and partners worldwide use to consume Amazon Ads measurement data. Behind them sit the pipelines that source, transform, and deliver that data, processing billions of aggregated datapoints on Apache Spark, Apache Iceberg, and AWS. Delivering this data accurately, freshly, and cost-efficiently requires programs that span multiple engineering teams, product management, and partner organizations across several sites and regions.

You take on the programs that don't yet have a shape, where the strategy is still forming, the right sequencing isn't obvious, and what success even looks like has to be defined before anything can be planned. You bring order to that ambiguity across the many engineering, product, science, and partner teams spread over multiple sites and regions, and you build the mechanisms that keep delivery predictable at that scale. The guidance, standards, and operating cadence for how these programs run are yours to shape. You operate with real technical depth: you read the designs, ask the sharp question in an architecture review, and, when the direction is wrong, you challenge the strategy, the architecture, or the way the organization is structured to deliver, and back it with a concrete alternative. You do this as a trusted advisor to the organization's senior leaders: you frame the decision, the tradeoff, and your recommendation for audiences that run from the working team all the way up to the organization's most senior leadership, and you help shape where they invest. And you run programs the way this team builds them: instrumented, automated, agent-assisted. Status, rollups, and dependency tracking largely assemble themselves, freeing your own hours for the judgment calls no tool can make. You influence without authority, and you make the teams around you, and yourself, faster.

Key job responsibilities
- Own end-to-end delivery of the largest, most ambiguous cross-team programs across pipelines, query engines, APIs, and data integration, where the plan has to be created, not just followed.
- Partner with senior and principal engineers, product leaders, and senior leadership to shape strategy and roadmap in ambiguous spaces, defining what the plan should be, not just executing it.
- Build and sequence the program (scope, milestones, success criteria), and drive resolution of risks, blockers, and dependencies before they slip delivery.
- Establish the operating mechanisms, increasingly automated and agent-driven, that keep delivery predictable across sites and regions.
- Advise senior leaders on where to invest and on the org-wide mechanisms and structure needed to deliver at scale.
- Frame decisions and recommendations for audiences from the working team up to the most senior leaders, with a clear point of view and the data behind it.
- Drive technical tradeoffs across data freshness, accuracy, cost, and time-to-market, escalating crisply when alignment is needed.
- Coordinate launches and deprecations of reporting interfaces across engineering, GTM, partner, and solutions-architecture teams.
- Grow the next tier of leaders: mentor TPMs and engineers, raise the bar on delivery practice, and contribute to hiring and promotion decisions.

About the team
The Programmatic Reporting team builds the data interfaces that power how advertisers and partners measure their Amazon Ads outcomes. We own Amazon Marketing Stream and the Reporting APIs, delivering accurate, consistent, and timely data to advertisers and partners worldwide. Our work sits at the intersection of data engineering and developer experience, and increasingly extends into GenAI-powered interfaces and data lake integrations. 

We move fast, think in systems, and obsess over data quality. This role is a chance to take on challenging delivery problems with real room to build the guidance and mechanisms behind them. The team is based in Toronto and partners with teams across multiple sites.

- 7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
- 7+ years of technical product or program management experience
- 5+ years of software development experience
- Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition

- 8+ years of hands-on work managing complex technology projects experience
- Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules

amazon:amazon:10504150.description:
Are you passionate about using AI to change customers' lives for the better? The Alexa International team is looking for a Senior Solutions Architect to drive adoption of Alexa+ across some of our most strategic 3P partners in the Americas, with a focus on Canada, Mexico, and Brazil. 

Alexa+ is Amazon's next-generation personal AI assistant, rebuilt from the ground up on a modern architecture that orchestrates large language models (LLMs), agentic pipelines, and connected services at scale. Available across Echo devices, mobile, Fire TV, and Alexa.com. Alexa+ is designed to get things done through natural, capable, multi-turn interactions.

As a Senior Solutions Architect for the Americas, you'll serve as the technical face of Amazon for our partners, owning the integration lifecycle from first technical engagement through production launch. You'll work hands-on with partner engineering teams to design, validate, and ship integrations that feel native to Alexa+, while building the playbooks, reference architectures, and documentation that will scale the program beyond 1:1 engagement. As a founding contributor, the patterns and practices you establish will define how we work with partners across categories for years to come.

This role sits at the intersection of deep technical execution and strategic influence. You'll translate complex integration requirements into clear business value for partner stakeholders, drive alignment across Amazon's business development teams, product, and engineering organizations, and exercise strong judgment as integration patterns continue to evolve.

The ideal candidate brings hands-on experience with modern integration protocols (including MCP), agentic system design, strong programming skills, and full-stack fluency across backend services, API layers, and front-end rendering. You have a track record of delivering complex multi-party integrations and can move fluidly between a deep technical conversation with a partner's engineering team and a strategic discussion with their leadership.

Key job responsibilities

Technical Delivery & Partner Integration:

• Design and deliver end-to-end partner integration solutions leveraging modern protocols and agentic patterns (e.g., MCP, tool-calling, REST), ensuring experiences feel native to Alexa+ while respecting partner brand and capabilities.
• Work hands-on with partners to assess technical readiness, architect solutions across the full stack — from backend services and API design to front-end rendering — and troubleshoot complex integration challenges across multiple device surfaces.
• Work with internal engineering teams to test and deploy software packages required to onboard partners to Alexa+.
• Exercise strong judgment in ambiguous technical situations, determining appropriate solution strategies and making clear trade-off recommendations (e.g., partial vs. full E2E integration, link-out vs. native rendering).

Frameworks & Scalable Enablement:

• Create reusable integration patterns, technical documentation, and onboarding playbooks that accelerate future partner launches and reduce hands-on SA effort over time.
• Develop reference architectures that leverage horizontal capabilities (compositional rendering, streaming, smart routing) to address common partner needs across categories.

Partner & Product Influence:

• Own technical relationships with partner engineering and product teams, guiding integrations from commitment through launch.
• Collaborate with product leadership during early capability formation, directly shaping the roadmap based on real partner integration learnings.

A day in the life
We're looking for a highly motivated Sr SA to join the Alexa+ International team as we build out the third-party integration program from the ground up. You'll engage in deep technical design discussions, solve novel challenges spanning agentic architectures and front-end rendering, and coordinate feature implementations across partner categories. You'll represent the partner perspective with internal product and engineering teams, using integration learnings, data-driven analysis, and a working-backwards approach to influence roadmap priorities. This is a founding-team role: you'll shape how we work, what we build, and how we scale.

About the team
Our mission is to enable third-party partners to bring their agentic capabilities and services to Alexa+ through the Americas, creating high-quality experiences across consumer categories that help customers get things done. We are a small, high-impact team of technologists bridging BD, internal product and engineering, and external partners. We're in our foundational year — building the integration model, establishing the playbook, and launching our first wave of strategic partners. If you thrive in ambiguity, enjoy building from scratch, and want to shape a program that will scale to hundreds of partners, this is the team.

- 8+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
- 10+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience
- Experience communicating across technical and non-technical audiences, including executive level stakeholders or clients
- Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent, or 8+ years of IT development or implementation/consulting in the software or Internet industries experience
- Must be fluent in English plus one of the following (Spanish, Portuguese, and/or Canadian French).

- Master's degree in engineering or equivalent, or experience in software development

amazon:amazon:10482296.description:
Are you passionate about cutting edge technologies such as artificial intelligence, generative AI, and
ambient computing? The Amazon Alexa International in Toronto team is looking for a Senior Product
Manager to lead the expansion of Alexa+ in Canada. This is your opportunity to work on products that
are making history!

Êtes-vous passionné(e) par les technologies de pointe telles que l'intelligence artificielle, l'IA générative et l'informatique ambiante ? L'équipe Amazon Alexa International à Toronto recherche un(e) Chef de produit senior pour diriger l'expansion d'Alexa+ au Canada. Voici une occasion unique de travailler sur des produits qui marquent l'histoire !

Key job responsibilities
 Define user needs and identify gaps, features enhancements and opportunities to grow the business
 Define creative, high-quality, simple product roadmaps based on team strategy and vision.
 Develop and maintain a deep understanding of the market landscape, customer needs, and
competitive dynamics in Canada across English and French locales.
 Develop detailed, crisp business requirements and user stories that can be used to create product
specifications and architecture for each product and application.
 Translate strategic vision into actionable plans and lead cross-functional teams to execute on
priority initiatives.
 Own the end-to-end customer experience for Alexa Canada across Echo, FireTV, and additional
endpoints.
 Track launches through every step—from experience review and packaging approval, to beta
testing, leadership presentations, and customer launch.
 Manage prioritization and trade-offs among customer experience, performance and operational
support load.
 Continuous monitor customer experience performance, identify gaps and improvement areas and
build improvement plan.
 Work closely with engineering teams and program management to deliver products to the market.
 Proactively identify and resolve strategic issues that may impair the team’s ability to meet strategic,
financial, and technical goals

• Définir les besoins des utilisateurs et identifier les lacunes, les améliorations de fonctionnalités et les opportunités de croissance de l'entreprise. 
• Définir des feuilles de route produit créatives, de haute qualité et simples, basées sur la stratégie et la vision de l'équipe. 
• Développer et maintenir une compréhension approfondie du marché, des besoins des clients et de la dynamique concurrentielle au Canada, tant pour les marchés anglophones que francophones. 
• Élaborer des exigences commerciales détaillées et précises ainsi que des témoignages utilisateurs pouvant servir à créer les spécifications produit et l'architecture de chaque produit et application. 
• Traduire la vision stratégique en plans d'action concrets et diriger des équipes interfonctionnelles pour exécuter les initiatives prioritaires. 
• Être responsable de l'expérience client de bout en bout pour Alexa Canada sur Echo, FireTV et les points d'accès supplémentaires. 
• Suivre les lancements à chaque étape — de la revue d'expérience et l'approbation de l'emballage, aux tests bêta, présentations à la direction et lancement client. 
• Gérer la priorisation et les compromis entre l'expérience client, la performance et la charge de support opérationnel. 
• Surveiller en continu la performance de l'expérience client, identifier les lacunes et les axes d'amélioration, et élaborer un plan d'amélioration. 
• Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes d'ingénierie et de gestion de programme pour livrer les produits sur le marché. 
• Identifier et résoudre de manière proactive les problèmes stratégiques susceptibles de compromettre la capacité de l'équipe à atteindre ses objectifs stratégiques, financiers et techniques.

A day in the life
As a Senior Product Manager, you will have a wide set of responsibilities to ensure our customers are
delighted, including launching new Alexa-powered devices and experiences and making Alexa
continuously smarter. This role is equal parts business strategy, product definition, and program
delivery. You will need to thrive and deliver results in a highly ambiguous, fast-paced, and dynamic
business environment – operating at all levels of the organization. The ideal candidate will use a
combination of outstanding analytical skills, cross-functional understanding, business judgment,
technical expertise, and strategic thinking to define the programs that improve Alexa CA Customer
Experience. You will work closely with many partners such as solution architects, engineering,
marketing, content, business development, and legal to ensure customers have access to a world class
Alexa experience in Canada.

En tant que Chef de produit senior, vous aurez un large éventail de responsabilités pour garantir la satisfaction de nos clients, y compris le lancement de nouveaux appareils et expériences alimentés par Alexa et l'amélioration continue de l'intelligence d'Alexa. Ce rôle combine à parts égales stratégie commerciale, définition de produit et livraison de programme. Vous devrez évoluer et produire des résultats dans un environnement commercial hautement complexe, dynamique et en constante évolution — en opérant à tous les niveaux de l'organisation. Le candidat ou la candidate idéale utilisera une combinaison de compétences analytiques exceptionnelles, de compréhension interfonctionnelle, de jugement commercial, d'expertise technique et de réflexion stratégique pour définir les programmes qui améliorent l'expérience client d'Alexa au Canada. Vous travaillerez en étroite collaboration avec de nombreux partenaires tels que les architectes de solutions, l'ingénierie, le marketing, le contenu, le développement commercial et le juridique pour garantir que les clients aient accès à une expérience Alexa de classe mondiale au Canada.

About the team
The Alexa Canada team's mission is to deliver products and services that are delightful and locally
relevant for Canadian customers. We operate within the broader Alexa International organization,
scaling Alexa globally while advocating for the unique needs of customers in Canada. Our work spans
product launches and feature expansion across both English and French, ensuring that every Canadian
customer experiences Alexa as a trusted companion in their daily life.

La mission de l'équipe Alexa Canada est de fournir des produits et des services agréables et pertinents à l'échelle locale pour les clients canadiens. Nous opérons au sein de l'organisation plus large d'Alexa International, en déployant Alexa à l'échelle mondiale tout en défendant les besoins uniques des clients au Canada. Notre travail couvre les lancements de produits et l'expansion des fonctionnalités en anglais et en français, veillant à ce que chaque client canadien considère Alexa comme un compagnon de confiance dans sa vie quotidienne.

- 5+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience owning technology products
- Experience owning feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- French fluency is mandatory for this role. Do you speak, write, and read fluently in French and English?

- Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders
- Experience in influencing senior leadership through data driven insights
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience with end to end product delivery

amazon:amazon:10480235.description:
Amazon Advertising generated $60 billion+ in revenue in 2025 and continues to grow at 20%+ year-over-year, making it one of the largest and fastest-growing digital advertising businesses in the world. The Campaign Management team builds the software that over a million advertisers use every day to manage, optimize, and scale their campaigns across this ecosystem. Our systems serve hundreds of millions of page views monthly and are used by everyone from small sellers running their first campaign to the world's largest agencies managing thousands simultaneously.

We are an engineering organization based in Toronto, New York, and Seattle. Five specialized teams cover campaign dashboards and analytics, bulk operations at scale, AI-powered experiences, advertiser workflow simplification, and frameworks. Together we own the full lifecycle of how advertisers manage their campaigns on Amazon.

This is an exciting time to join. We are evolving from traditional campaign tooling into intelligent, AI-native advertiser experiences. We shipped our first AI-powered campaign agent to production this year, and the pace of innovation is accelerating. The technical surface area is broad and rewarding: frontend experiences at scale, backend APIs serving millions of advertisers, deep metrics and analytics systems, and emerging AI architectures.

We are looking for a Principal Technical Program Manager to lead our most impactful cross-team programs. You will define strategy for multi-quarter initiatives, drive technical alignment across distributed systems, and partner closely with engineering, product, and science leaders to deliver outcomes that matter for advertisers. You will work directly with Director and VP-level stakeholders and have meaningful ownership over what gets built and how it ships.

The right person for this role brings strong technical depth, thrives in ambiguity, and energizes the teams around them. You will build the mechanisms and operational practices that help a high-performing organization move even faster. This is a high-ownership, high-impact role with direct visibility to senior leadership in one of Amazon's most dynamic businesses, based in Toronto with strong local team and leadership presence.

- 7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
- 7+ years of technical product or program management experience
- 5+ years of software development experience
- Experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition

- 8+ years of hands-on work managing complex technology projects experience
- Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
- Experience with AI/ML or LLM-powered product architectures in production

In this position, you'll work at the intersection of sales, GTM, marketing, and customer and partner engagement, contributing to pipeline generation across multiple sales segments. You’ll serve as the key liaison between Canada CSC and other AWS teams, including Marketing, Partner Marketing, Go-to-Market (GTM), Field Enablement, and sellers, to ensure cohesive and impactful campaign strategy. 

Impact and Scope:
• Contribute to pipeline generation through development, execution and refinement of segment-specific, industry-specific and persona-specific campaign strategies
• Serve as the primary liaison with Marketing, Partner Marketing, Go-to-Market (GTM), Field Enablement, and sellers for prospecting efforts, while aligning business unit activities and go-to-market strategies to support strategic sales plays and organizational goals
• Track and measure the effectiveness of campaign activities against CSC sales results and strategic goals, using data-driven insights to guide and refine future strategies
• Deliver independently while seeking guidance from leadership on strategic matters

Key job responsibilities
• Work backwards from AWS Geo and Service pipeline goals to build campaign prioritization with service-level offers, messaging, and go-to-market execution
• Clarify requirements, customer needs, and priorities to develop effective segment-specific campaign strategies
• Develop detailed campaign project plans, which include: campaign goals, messaging, calls to action, marketing distribution channels, and campaign schedules
• Analyze customer data, seller and customer feedback to support cross-sell/upsell strategies
• Obsess over our end customer’s AWS experience and design campaigns on their behalf
• Identify patterns to improve technical and business solutions within the CSC
• Collaborate with senior/Executive AWS sales leaders to align strategic pipeline generation campaigns with business goals
• Oversee creation and launch of sales and GTM content focused on prospecting
• Model input and output-based goals and measure campaign effectiveness
• Orchestrate cross-functional activities across Sales, Partner teams, and executive stakeholders
• Embody a partner-first mentality
• Provide feedback to AWS sales leadership on campaign strategy and opportunities to optimize
• Support customer-facing sales engagement at live and virtual events, or via direct campaign execution
• Forecast, track, and report campaign effectiveness metrics as well as overall ROI to internal stakeholders. Plus, continually monitor, analyze and tune campaigns to maximize conversion, pipeline, and revenue generation.
• Advise and spearhead technology, mechanisms and tool adoption plans, in support of GTM goals, pipeline and revenue generation
• Drive timely decisions and clear blockers, escalating issues appropriately

- Experience with sales CRM tools such as Salesforce or similar software
- Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities, or experience working with customers with a passion for delivering exceptional service
- Experience working with fast-moving, high-performance teams and driving innovative solutions tailored to unique business environments
- Experience in managing projects related to cloud computing or IT infrastructure

amazon:amazon:10553158.description:
The Alexa Daily Essentials (ADE) team is looking for a Technical Program Manager to drive delivery of home productivity experiences that millions of customers rely on every day.

You'll own programs that span cloud services, device software, and AI/ML-powered features across multiple device surfaces. If you thrive on navigating technical complexity, coordinating across organizations, and shipping features that customers use billions of times a month, this role is for you.

Key job responsibilities
Own end-to-end delivery of cross-functional programs across cloud engineering, device software, design, QA, and product teams
Drive launch readiness for device programs with tight deadlines and multiple dependencies
Partner with engineering to understand system architecture, identify risks early, and make informed trade-off recommendations
Manage cross-org dependencies across platform teams, partner orgs, and central infrastructure, driving commitments to closure rather than waiting on them
Build and maintain launch readiness mechanisms, status reporting, and escalation paths for leadership visibility
Coordinate model migrations, latency initiatives, and quality programs that require deep technical understanding of LLM-based and deterministic systems
Anticipate bottlenecks, drive escalation management, and balance customer experience quality with engineering constraints and timelines
Contribute to operational excellence by partnering with engineering on oncall reduction, automation, and GenAI-driven efficiency investments

A day in the life
You'll work across engineering managers, product managers, designers, and partner teams to ship features on devices launching to millions of customers. You'll track delivery across multiple workstreams simultaneously, dive into technical architecture when needed, flag risks before they become blockers, and keep programs moving through clear communication and relentless follow-through. You'll operate in a fast-paced environment where device launch dates don't move and quality bars are non-negotiable.

- 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
- 3+ years of software development experience
- 3+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules
- Experience managing cross-functional programs and release schedules

- 3+ years of cloud based solution (AWS or equivalent), system, network and operating system experience, or Bachelor's degree in business administration, finance, economics, computer science, data science, engineering, or other related field
- Experience in operational excellence, continuous improvement, or process improvement roles
- Familiarity with AI/ML systems, LLM-based architectures, or agentic workflows
- 5+ years of defining and executing against program timeline & requirements experience

Fulfillment Execution (FX) re-imagines and re-architects outbound fulfillment so customers receive items as quickly as possible at the lowest cost. We build advanced capabilities to fully automate systems and processes at the scale of billions of packages to millions of addresses worldwide.

This is an inherently cross-functional role spanning engineering, operations, finance, and business teams—both local and remote.

Key job responsibilities
Responsibilities

- Gather business and systems requirements from internal customers across Amazon
- Conceptualize solutions, author specifications, and define project scope
- Drive end-to-end delivery—from design through release and post-launch support
- Make appropriate trade-offs to optimize release schedules and outcomes
- Clearly communicate goals, roles, responsibilities, and desired outcomes to partner teams

amazon:amazon:10449448.description:
Are you passionate about innovative technologies such as artificial intelligence, generative AI, and ambient computing? The Amazon Alexa International team in Toronto is looking for a Senior Product Manager to lead the expansion of Alexa+ in Canada. This is your opportunity to work on products that are making history!

Key job responsibilities
- Define user needs through direct customer engagement including user research sessions, beta feedback programs, and analysis of customer support interactions to identify gaps, feature enhancements, and opportunities to grow the business.
- Define creative, high-quality, simple product roadmaps based on team strategy and vision, communicating the "why" through compelling narratives that align senior leadership and cross-functional partners.
- Develop and maintain a deep understanding of the market landscape, customer needs, and competitive dynamics in Canada across English and French locales, including emerging AI/ML capabilities and their implications for product strategy.
- Develop detailed, crisp business requirements and user stories that can be used to create product specifications and architecture for each product and application.
- Translate strategic vision into actionable plans and lead cross-functional teams to execute on priority initiatives, writing clear strategy documents (PRFAQs, one-pagers) that influence organizational priorities.
- Own the end-to-end customer experience for Alexa Canada across Echo, FireTV, and additional endpoints, partnering closely with UX designers to co-create experiences that balance delight, usability, and technical feasibility.
- Track launches through every step from experience review and packaging approval, to beta testing, leadership presentations, and customer launch.
- Manage prioritization and trade-offs among customer experience, performance, and operational support load, using data-driven frameworks and experimentation (A/B testing, holdout groups) to validate decisions.
- Continuously monitor customer experience performance using advanced analytics segmentation, cohort analysis, and causal inference to identify gaps, improvement areas, and build improvement plans with measurable success criteria.
- Work closely with engineering teams and program management to deliver products to the market, demonstrating sufficient technical depth to evaluate architectural proposals, ask incisive questions about AI model behavior, and identify risks in technical approaches.
- Proactively identify and resolve strategic issues that may impair the team's ability to meet strategic, financial, and technical goals.
- Work collaboratively with other product managers to share frameworks, best practices, and institutional knowledge to elevate team capability.

A day in the life
As a Senior Product Manager, you will have a wide set of responsibilities to ensure our customers are delighted, including launching new Alexa-powered devices and experiences and making Alexa continuously smarter. This role is equal parts business strategy, product definition, and program delivery. You will need to thrive and deliver results in a highly ambiguous, fast-paced, and dynamic business environment operating at all levels of the organization. The ideal candidate will use a combination of analytical skills, cross-functional understanding, business judgment, technical expertise, and strategic thinking to define the programs that improve Alexa CA Customer Experience. You bring genuine technical curiosity, you stay current with advances in large language models, agentic AI, and conversational systems, and you translate that understanding into better product decisions. You regularly engage directly with customers through beta programs and feedback channels to ground your intuition in real user needs. You will work closely with many partners such as marketing, technical PMs, solution architects, engineering, content, business development, and legal to ensure customers have access to a world-class Alexa experience in Canada. 

About the team
The Alexa Canada team's mission is to deliver products and services that are delightful and locally relevant for Canadian customers. We operate within the broader Alexa International organization, scaling Alexa globally while advocating for the unique needs of customers in Canada. Our work spans product launches and feature expansion across both English and French, ensuring that every Canadian customer experiences Alexa as a trusted companion in their daily life.

Job Overview

You are responsible for customer experience with considerable complexity where problems, opportunity, and strategy may not be defined. You take the lead on initiatives and deliver independently. You influence strategic direction, customer adoption decisions, and organization priorities through well-crafted written narratives and data-backed recommendations that earn trust with senior leadership.

You champion exceptional customer experiences by defining requirements for Canadian customers and partnership with global stakeholders on roadmap development. You balance constraints—compliance, localization, and accessibility—with customer experience considerations. You establish direct customer feedback loops and regularly validate assumptions through qualitative and quantitative research. You monitor operational health after launch and work with teams to address issues with appropriate urgency.

You demonstrate curiosity and a desire to dive deep into the technical aspects of your product, particularly in AI/ML systems. You evaluate technical proposals for strengths and weaknesses, asking the right questions to identify risks and ensure appropriate trade-offs are surfaced before commitments are made. You understand how AI, including agentic systems and large language models, is reshaping product development and apply this understanding to make better product decisions. You proactively explore new AI capabilities, attend technical deep-dives, and maintain enough technical fluency to be a credible partner to engineering. You use all means possible, including AI, to accelerate development cycles, make better decisions, and unlock new forms of innovation.

You demonstrate high skill at using data to drive decisions. You define success criteria, KPIs, and metrics distinguishing between output metrics such as adoption and outcome metrics such as customer satisfaction and business impact. You design experiments and analyze results with statistical rigor. You analyze usage data, performance metrics, customer behavior, and market trends to inform decisions and prioritize roadmap investments—going beyond surface-level reporting to uncover causal relationships and actionable insights. You use AI capabilities to accelerate insight generation while applying critical judgment.

You collaborate with other product managers, sharing mental models for decision-making, providing feedback on documents and strategies, and helping others grow their technical and strategic capabilities. You raise the bar for the PM community through knowledge sharing and thought leadership.

You communicate with precision and influence—crafting compelling written documents that drive alignment across teams and leadership levels. You tailor your communication to your audience, whether presenting to executives, aligning with engineering partners, or rallying cross-functional teams around a shared vision.

- 5+ years of product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience owning technology products
- Experience owning feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- Do you speak, write, and read fluently in French?

- Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders
- Experience in influencing senior leadership through data driven insights
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience with end to end product delivery

Amazon Selection and Catalog Systems (ASCS) builds and operates the systems behind the world's largest e-commerce product catalog, enabling customers to find, discover, and buy anything they want. The Offers Platform team within ASCS owns the systems that serve product and offering data containing billions of records — the authority for product information, availability, and price — responding to hundreds of billions of requests per day at single-digit millisecond latency.

We are hiring a Technical Program Manager to drive programs across two critical pillars:

- Offer Projections and Insights — Diagnostic, analytics, and Tier-1 aggregation services that power offer intelligence, detail page widgets (buybox, twister, price ranges), and emerging AI-powered shopping experiences

amazon:amazon:10419019.description:
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Serverless Compute team based in Vancouver, Canada. Our team owns the products that make it radically easier for builders to build scalable, reliable, and intelligent cloud applications without managing infrastructure. Our portfolio includes some of the most widely adopted services in cloud computing: AWS Lambda, AWS Step Functions, Amazon EventBridge, and AWS Elastic Beanstalk. Together, these services power millions of customer workloads, from event-driven architectures and workflow orchestration to full application deployment. Our latest innovations are defining how customers build complex, multi-step, AI-native applications on AWS, including durable execution for AI agents and next-generation compute primitives. 

We’re looking for a product manager that’s passionate about solving customer problems and has demonstrated success in turning ambiguous customer needs into successful products. In this role, you will help evolve our serverless services by providing new capabilities and intuitive developer experiences that make it easier to build applications without the need to become an expert in distributed systems. If you're excited by cloud computing, want to help lead from the innovative edge, and have a deep-rooted passion in the evolution of computing and application development platforms, then we want to talk to you! 

As a Senior Product Manager, you will be a critical part of the PM organization that owns the business model and P&L, prioritization of the product roadmap, customer segmentation and pricing, and demand generation for impactful new products. You will work across engineering, business development, and marketing leads to set strategy, define the product, and make difficult, high-judgment trade-offs between features and time-to-market. You will partner with the technical leaders of the organization to ensure the programming model, scalability and reliability promises, and developer experience delight our customers. As one of the team leaders, you will play a key role in hiring additional team members, and help set the vision, values, and culture of this business. 

The breadth of this role is what makes it unique. Depending on your interests and strengths, you could find yourself working on event-driven architectures that connect and integrate cloud-native systems at scale, workflow orchestration and durable execution for AI agents and distributed applications or developer and agent experiences that make building, deploying, and governing serverless applications effortless at any scale.

Further responsibilities include: 
- Author documents relating to product life cycle including product roadmap, business requirements, and functional specifications 
- Prototype new features and experiences 
- Drive product development across teams (primarily Engineering, Operations, Product Management, Business Development, and Marketing) through business requirements, design, implementation, and deployment 
- Work collaboratively with Engineering as an advocate for the needs of our customers 
- Evaluate industry innovations and technology platforms and identify partnership and collaboration opportunities 
- Engage directly with customers to understand their needs and learn what we can build to enable and delight our customers 

What does it take to succeed in this role? Excitement in finding new ways to help a developer do things more efficiently or faster. A deep empathy for developer challenges, balanced with a strategic understanding of business objectives and a creative and inventive mindset to help define what we build. Demonstrated experience leading developer-facing platform efforts, and a strong technical background with familiarity with large-scale systems. Exceptional communication skills to manage the large degree of external interaction with customers and partners the role requires. 

About the team
We are a core part of the AWS Serverless Compute organization with team members in Seattle, Dublin, and Vancouver. Together, we work as one team spanning Lambda, Step Functions, EventBridge, and Elastic Beanstalk. Our shared mission is to make it radically easier for developers to build scalable, reliable, and intelligent cloud applications without managing infrastructure. Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we are building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship. Our senior members enjoy one-on-one mentoring and thorough, but kind, document reviews. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects based on what will help each team member develop into a better-rounded professional and enable them to take on more complex tasks in the future. We are continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That is why you will find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
